1.1: There was a man whose name was called Tseerutsaydan (Antiochus IV Epiphanes) and who loved sin - he would boast in his abundant horses and the stoutness of his troops beneath his authority.
1.2: He had many priests who served his idols which he worshiped and for whom he bowed and offered sacrifice by night and by day.
1.3: But in the dullness of his heart it would seem to him that the idols gave him permanence and Power,
1.4: and in his heart it would seem to him that they gave him authority in all his Rule,
1.5: and again at the time of their embodiment it would seem to him that they gave him all the desired authority also,
1.6: and he would offer sacrifice to them day and night.
1.7: He appointed priests who served his idols.
1.8: While the priests ate from that defiled sacrifice - they would deceive him pretending that the idols ate night and day.
1.9: Again they would make other persons diligent like unto them - that they might offer sacrifice and eat, and again they would make other persons diligent that they might offer sacrifice - and offer sacrifice like as unto them.
1.10: But Tseerutsaydan would trust in his idols that do not profit nor benefit.
1.11: By his times being short - and in his heart dullness - it would seem to him that they created him - that they fed him and that they crowned him - it would seem to him that they created him - for satan had deafened his reasoning lest he know his Creator Who Created him bringing from not living toward living - or lest he with his kindreds would know their Creator Who Created them bringing from not living toward living - that they might go toward the Gehenna of fire forever - it being judged upon all those with him who call them gods without their being gods.
1.12: As they are not ever well ever - it is due that they might be called dead ones.
1.13: As satan's authority which misleads them lodges in that idol image - and as he will tell them what they want to hear - and as he will reveal to them their heart's desire - YAH will judge upon the idols wherein they believed and wherein Adam's children trust - whose reasoning was like unto ashes.
1.14: and they will marvel upon the time they realise that the idols fulfilled what they thought to them - and they will do their accord to their reaching out even up unto sacrificing their daughters and their sons, natural children birthed from them - even up unto spilling their daughter's and son's blood, children that were clean.
1.15: This did not sadden them - for satan has savoured their sacrifice to the idols in achieving his evil accord - that he might lower them toward Gehenna like as unto him - where there are no exits up until eternity - where he will receive tribulation.
1.16: But that Tseerutsaydan was arrogant - he had fifty idols worked in male images and twenty worked in female images,
1.17: and he would boast in those idols which have no benefit - he would altogether glorify them while he offered sacrifice morning and evening,
1.18: and he would command persons that they should offer sacrifice to the idols - and he would eat from those defiled sacrifices - and he would command other persons that they should eat from the sacrifices - he would especially incite to evil.
1.19: He had five houses built for his beaten-worked idols that were iron and brass and lead,
1.20: and he ornamanted them in silver and gold - he veiled curtains around the houses for them and founded a tent for them.
1.21: He appointed keepers for them there - he would continually sacrifice forty to his idols - ten fattened oxen - ten sterile cows - ten fattened sheep ewes - ten barren goats - along with winged birds.
1.22: But it would seem to him that his idols ate - he would present for them fifty feeqen of grapes and fifty dishes of wheat kneaded with oil,
1.23: and he told his priests: - "take and give them - make my idols eat what I have slaughtered for them - and make them drink the grapes I presented to them - and if it is not enough for them - I will add more for them."
1.24: And he would command all that they should eat and drink from that defiled sacrifice.
1.25: But in his evil malice he would send his troops who traveled in all the kingdoms - that as it were there was one who neither sacrificed nor bowed - they might separate and know and bring him - and might punish him by fire and by sword before his face - that they might plunder his money and might burn his house in the fire - that they might destroy all his possessions he had.
1.26: He said, "For they are kind and great ones - for they have created us in their charity - and I will show punishment and tribulation to him unless he worships my idols and offers sacrifice to my idols,
1.27: and I will show him punishment and tribulation - for they have created Earth and Heaven and the sea that is wide and moon and sun and stars and rains and winds and all that live in this world to be food and to be satiety for us."
1.28: But persons who worship them shall be punished in hard tribulation - and it will be dreadful for them.

2.1: There was a man born from the tribe of Benjamin whose name was called Maccaebeus.
2.2: He had three children who were handsome and true warriors - they were loved best among all persons in the country of Midian which Tseerutsaydan ruled,
2.3: and like as unto the king commanded his troops upon the time they found them: - "Do you not bow to Tseerutsaydan's idols? Do you not offer sacrifice?
2.4: But if you refuse - we will seize and take you to the king - and we will destroy all your possessions like as unto the king has commanded."
2.5: These youths who were handsome replied to them saying - "As to Him to Whom we bow - there is my Father's Creator Who Created Earth and Heaven and what is within her - the sea and moon and sun and clouds and stars - He is the true Creator Whom we worship and in Whom we believe."
2.6: And these youths were four - and the king's servants who carry shield and spear were a hundred,
2.7: and upon the time they decided that they might seize these holy ones - they escaped from their hands and there were none who touched them - as those youths were true warriors in Power - they went seizing shields and spears.
2.8: And there was of them one who strangled and killed a panther - and at that time he strangled it like unto a chicken,
2.9: and there was one of them who killed a lion with a rock and striking it once with a stick,
2.10: and there was one of them who killed a hundred persons - striking at once with a sword - and the names of those they hunted were thus - they were from the countries of Babylon and Midian,
2.11: and they were warriors in Power - and they had a manner of being loved and comeliness,
2.12: and again their features of comeliness were wondrous - but it was because they worshipped YAH and because they did not fear death - this is the reason their comeliness surpassed all.
2.13: And upon the time they evaded the troops - there was none who were able to seize them - but they who were warriors escaped proceeding toward a lofty mountain,
2.14: and those troops returned toward the city and shut the fortress gate - they terrorized the people saying - "Unless you bring those warriors the Maccabeans - we will burn your city in the fire - and we will send word toward the king and destroy your country."
2.15: And at that time the people of the country - both rich and poor ones and daughters and sons - orphans and widows - everyone proceeded and shouted together - and they straightened their necks toward the mountain and shouted toward them saying - "Do not destroy us - and do not bring destruction to our country upon us."
2.16: At that time the warriors wept together - and they feared - rising to YAH,
2.17: turning their faces Eastward and stretching forth their hands they begged to YAH together - "Lord - should we refuse these men who demolish Thy Command and Thy LAW?
2.18: Yet he believes in silver and gold and in the stone and wood that a person's hands worked - but we do not desire that we might hear that criminal's words - who does not believe Thy LAW" they said.
2.19: "When Thou are the Creator Who saves and Who kills - he makes himself like unto the idols that he thinks created him - as for him - he is it who spills a person's blood and who eats a person's flesh.
2.20: But we do not desire that we might behold that criminal's face nor hear his word" they said.
2.21: "However if Thou commanded us - we will go toward him - because we believe in Thee - we will pass and give our body to death - and upon the time he says 'Offer sacrifice to my idols' - we will not hear that criminal's word.
2.22: But we believe Thee - Lord Who examines the kidneys and the understanding - my father's Creator - Abraham and Isaac and Jacob who did Thy Accord and lived firmed up in Thy LAW.
2.23: Thou examine a person's thoughts and help the sinner and the righteous one - and there is nothing hidden from Thee - and he who takes refuge is revealed alongside Thee.
2.24: But we have no other Creator apart from Thee.
2.25: That we might give our body to death because of Thy glorified Name - however be Power and Firmness and a Shelter for us in this Work and we are ruled by Thee,
2.26: and upon the time Israel entered Egypt Thou heard Jacob's plea - and now glorify us God - we beg Thee."
2.27: And at this time two men whose features were quite handsome were beheld by the warriors standing before them - at this time terrible fire swords like as unto lightning alit and cut their necks and killed them - and at that time they arose being whole as unto before.
2.28: Their feature's comeliness became more handsome and they shone more than the sun - and they became more handsome than aforetime.

3.1: You shall behold these before you these are YAH's servants - 'Abya - Seela - Fentos who were dead and arose - so you have an example that you might arise likewise after your death - and your faces shall shine like as unto the sun in the Kingdom of Heaven,
3.2: and they went with those troops and received martyrdom there.
3.3: At that time they desired - they praised - and they bowed to YAH - death did not frighten them and the king's punishment did not frighten them,
3.4: and they went toward those troops and became like unto a sheep that has no blemish - yet they did not frighten them - and upon the time they arrived against them - they seized and beat them and bound and whipped them - and they delivered them to the king and they stood before him,
3.5: and the king answered to them saying - "Why will you stubborn ones not offer sacrifice and bow to my idols?"
3.6: Those brethren who were cleansed from sin - who were honoured and chosen and Irie - and who shone like unto a jewel whose value is astonishing - Seela and 'Abya and Fentos answered to him with one word.
3.7: They told that king who was a curse - "As for us - we will not bow nor sacrifice to defiled idols that have no knowledge nor reasoning."
3.8: And again they told him - "We will not bow to idols that are silver and gold that is a person's handiwork - that are stone and wood - that have no reasoning nor soul nor knowledge - that do not benefit their friends nor harm their enemies."
3.9: And the king answered to them saying - "Why do you say thus - as they know who insults them and who wrongs them - why do you insult the divine idols?"
3.10: They answered to him saying - "They are like as unto a trifle alongside us - as for us - we will insult them and will not glorify them."
3.11: And the king answered to them saying - "I will punish you like as unto your evil work in proportion - I will destroy your feature's comeliness with whipping and hard tribulation and fire,
3.12: and now tell me whether you will give or will not give sacrifice to my idols - for if this does not happen - I will punish you by sword and by whipping."
3.13: They answered to him saying - "As for us - we will not offer sacrifice nor bow to defiled idols" - and the king commanded them that they might beat them with a fat stick - and again that they might whip them with a whip - and after it - that they might shred them up until their inner organs were seen,
3.14: and after this they bound and kept them a while in the jailhouse until he was forced to offer a reward and punished and killed them.
3.15: They roughly took them and bound them imprisoned securely in the prisonhouse - and they sat in the prisonhouse three nights and three days,
3.16: and after this third day the king commanded that a Proclamation speaker might decree that the counselors and nobles - the country's elders and officials - might be gathered,
3.17: and upon the time the king Tseerutsaydan sat in the square - he commanded that they might bring those honoured ones - Seela and 'Abya and Fentos - they stood before him being wounded and bound,
3.18: and the king told them - "When you sat these three days - has your mind changed - or are you in your former evil?"
3.19: And those honoured YAH's soldiers answered to him saying - "As to that cruel treatment - we will not agree that we might worship the idols filled of sin and evil that thou regard."
3.20: And that criminal vexed and commanded that they might stand them up in a lofty place and might renew their wounds - and their blood flowed upon the Earth.
3.21: And again he commanded that they might burn them with a torch lamp and might char their flesh - and his servants did like as unto he commanded them - and those honoured men told him - "Thou who think not of YAH'S LAW - hearken - our reward shall abound in the measure whereby thou multiply our punishment."
3.22: And again he commanded that they might bring and send upon them bears and tigers and lions that were vicious beasts before they ate their food - that they might utterly eat their flesh with their bones,
3.23: and he commanded the persons who keep the beasts that they might send the beasts upon them - and they did like as unto he commanded them - and they bound those honoured martyr's feet - and again they maliciously beat and bound them with tent stakes.
3.24: And those beasts were propelled over to them while they roared - and upon the time they arrived toward the martyrs they hailed and bowed to them.
3.25: They returned toward their keepers while they roared - and they frightened their keepers - they took the beasts toward the square until they delivered them before the king,
3.26: and they killed seventy five men from the criminal's army there.
3.27: Many persons panicked - with one suffering upon another in fear - up until the king quit his throne and fled - and they seized the beasts with difficulty and took them toward their lodging.
3.28: Seela's and 'Abya's and Fentos' two brethren came and released them from the imprisonment - they unbound them and told them - "Come let us flee lest these heathen and criminals find us,
3.29: and those martyrs answered their brethren saying - "It is not fitting that we might flee after we are set up for a testimony - and if you are afraid - go fleeing."
3.30: And those their little brethren said - "We will stand with you before the king - and if you die we will die with you."
3.31: And after this the king entered his lordship hall's balcony and caught sight of these honoured men not released and that all the five brethren stood together - those chiefs who oversee the troops questioned if they were brethren and told the king - and the king vexed and shouted like unto a boar of the wilderness,
3.32: and up until the king offered money to punish all the five brethren - he commanded that they might seize and cast them in the prisonhouse - they placed them in the prisonhouse binding them in a secure imprisonment treated roughly with a hollow stalk.
3.33: And the king Tseerutsaydan said - "These youths who erred have wearied me - why should these men's reasoning harden? and they work evil and are like unto Power and firmness - if I say - "They will return" - they will make their thoughts evil,
3.34: and I will bring the hardship upon them like as unto their work's evil measure requires - and I will burn their flesh in the fire that it might be charred ash - and upon that I will scatter their flesh's ash like as unto dust upon the mountains."
3.35: And after he spoke this he waited three days and commanded that they might bring those honoured men - and upon the time those honoured men approached he commanded that they might burn a fire within the great pit furnace - and that they might add within it a malicious work that enflames the fire and whereby they boiled a vat - the fat and soapberries - sea foam and resin and the sulfur,
3.36: and upon the time the fire flamed in the pit the messengers went toward the king and they said - "We did what thou commanded us - send the men who will be cast in."
3.37: And he commanded that they might receive and cast them in the fire pit - and the troops did like unto as the king commanded them - and upon the time those honoured men entered into the fire they gave their souls to YAH.
3.38: And when the persons who cast them beheld - Angels received and took their souls toward the Garden where Isaac and Abraham and Jacob are - where Irie Ites are found.

4.1: And upon the time that criminal beheld that they were dead - he commanded that they might burn their flesh in the fire until it was ash and that they might scatter them in the wind - but the fire was not able to burn even the corpse's hair from the corpse's side - and they sent them forth from the pit,
4.2: and again they flamed fire over them beginning from morning up until evening - and it did not burn them - so they said - "and now come let us cast their corpses seaward."
4.3: And they did like unto as the king commanded them - they cast them upon the sea - even if they cast them seaward adding great stones and iron hearthstones and a millstone whereby a donkey grinds by turning - they would not sink into the sea - as YAH's Spirit of Support had lodged in them - they floated upon the sea yet they did not sink - it failed him to destroy them by all the malice that was instigated upon them.
4.4: "As this their death has made me weary more than their life - I will cast their corpses to beasts that they might eat them - yet what more shall I do?" he said.
4.5: And the troops did like unto as he commanded them - vultures and beasts did not touch their corpses - birds and vultures veiled them with their wings from burning in the sun and the five martyr's corpses sat fourteen days,
4.6: and upon the time they beheld them - the bodies shone up like unto the sun - and Angels encircled their corpses like as unto the light encircling the Tent.
4.7: He sought counsel - he lacked what more he should do - and after this he dug a grave and buried the five martyr's corpses.
4.8: And when that king who transgressed YAH'S LAW had reclined upon his bed at night, the five martyrs were beheld by him standing before him at night, distressing him and wielding swords.
4.9: As it had seemed to him that they entered toward his house at night in a breach - upon the time he awoke from his slumber he feared and desired that he might flee from the bedchamber toward the hall - and as it had seemed for him that they would kill him seeming that they committed a breach upon him - he feared and his knees trembled,
4.10: because of this thing he said - "My lords - what do you desire? as for me - what should I do for you?"
4.11: They answered to him saying - "Are not we whom thou killed burning in the fire and we whom thou commanded that they might cast upon the sea? As YAH has kept our bodies because we believed in Him - it failed thee to destroy us - as a person who believes in Him will not perish - give the glory and praise due to YAH - and we also who believed in Him did not commit dishonor in the tribulation.”
4.12: "As I did not know that a punishment like unto this would find me - what reward should I give you because rather it seems I did an evil thing upon you?
4.13: And now take from me the reward I give you - lest you take my body in death and lest you lower my body toward Sheol when I am alive.
4.14: As I have wronged you - forgive me my sin - because it is your Father YAH'S LAW'S Mercy" he told them.
4.15: And those honoured martyrs answered to him saying - "Because of the deed wherefore thou did an evil thing upon us - as for us - we will not repay thee an evil thing - as YAH is He Who brings hardship upon a soul - as for Him Who will pay thee hardship - there is YAH.
4.16: However we were made visible to thee being revealed that we were well - for thy time being short and because of thy wisdom deafness - as to it seeming to thee that thou killed us - thou prepared a benefit to us.
4.17: But thy idol's priests and thou will descend toward Gehenna where are no exits forever.
4.18: Woe to thy idols to whom thou bow having ceased bowing to YAH Who Created you when you were scorned like unto spit - and to you who worship them - and you do not know YAH Who Created you bringing from not living toward living - are you not who is beheld today like unto smoke and tomorrow who perishes?"
4.19: And the king answered to them saying - "What will you command me that I might do for you - all that you desire?"
4.20: "It is to save thyself lest thou enter toward the Gehenna of fire - yet it is not to save ourselves who instruct thee,
4.21: for your idols are silver and gold - stone and wood - that have no reasoning nor soul nor knowledge - that a person's hand worked.
4.22: But they do not kill - they do not save - they do not benefit their friend - they do not harm their enemy - they do not debase - they do not honour - they do not make wealthy - they do not impoverish - they mislead you by a demon's authority - who does not aspire that one person might be saved - yet they do not uproot nor plant.
4.23: They especially do not seek that the persons like unto you might be saved from death - you dull-hearted ones for whom they seem that they created you - when you are they who created them.
4.24: As a satan's and demon's authority has lodged in them - they shall return a thing to you like as unto you wanted - that it might drown you within the sea of Gehenna.
4.25: But thou - quit this thy error and make this also be thy reward because of our dead standing - that we might benefit our souls by you worshipping our creator YAH" they told him.
4.26: But he was alarmed and was completely astonished - and as all five were manifest to him drawing their swords - he feared - and because of this thing he bowed to them.
4.27: "Hence I know that after death ones who are dust and died they will truly arise - as for me - only a little has remained but for me to die."
4.28: After this they were hidden from before the king's face - from that day onward Tseerutsaydan who was immensely arrogant quit the worshipping of his idols,
4.29: as they had misled him many times - he would be Irie in his idols and his mistaken reasoning - and he misled many persons like unto him up until he quit following them and worshiped YAH Who Created him - yet it was not only him who erred,
4.30: and they would sacrifice their daughters and their sons to demons - yet they worked a bewitching and confusion that is their understanding agreement - that their father satan taught them that he might make a bewitching and confusion that YAH does not love.
4.31: They marry their mothers - and they abuse their aunts and their sisters - they abuse their bodies while they worked all that resembled this filthy Work - as satan has solidified the crooked person's reasoning - they said - "We will not return."
4.32: But that Tseerutsaydan - who did not know his creator - was completely arrogant - and he would boast in his idols.
4.33: If they say - "How will YAH give the Kingdom to the person who does not know Him in LAW and in Worship?" - if they will utterly return toward Him in repentance - as He tests them thus - it is because of this.
4.34: But if they utterly return in repentance He will love them - and He will keep their Kingdom - but if they refuse a fire will punish them in the fire of Gehenna forever.
4.35: But it would be due a king to fear his Creator YAH like unto his lordship's acclaim - and it would be due a judge to be ruled to his Creator while he judged goodly judgment like unto his Rule's acclaim,
4.36: and it would be due elders and chiefs and envoys and governors to be commanded to their Creator like unto their lordship's abundant measure.
4.37: As His is the Heaven and Earth - the Lord Who Created all the Creation - because there is no other Creator in Heaven nor Earth who impoverishes and makes rich - He Who honours and debases.

5.1: "The one warrior from the sixty warriors was proud - YAH made his body beginning from his foot up until his head to swell with one spoon of sulphur - he died in one plague,
5.2: and again Hiram who built an iron bed was proud arising from his powerfulness in abundance - and YAH hid him in death,
5.3: and again Nebuchadnezzar was proud saying - 'There is no other king besides me - and I am the creator who makes the sun rise in this world' - and he said thus arising from his arrogance in abundance,
5.4: and YAH separated him from people and sent him toward the wilderness seven years - and he made his fortune with the birds of Heaven and beasts of the wilderness up until he knew that it was YAH Who created him,
5.5: and upon the time he knew Him in worship - He again returned him toward his kingdom - who it is who is not of Earth - being brazenly proud at YAH Who created him?
5.6: How about those who demolish HIS LAW and His Order and whom Earth did not swallow?
5.7: And thou Tseerutsaydan desire that thou might be puffed up at thy creator - and again thou have that He might destroy thee like unto them - and might lower thee toward a grave arising from thy arrogance,
5.8: and again after they entered toward Sheol where is weeping and gnashing of teeth - that is darkness in perfection - thou have that He might lower thee toward the deep pit Gehenna where are no exits forever.
5.9: As for thou - thou are a man who will die and be forgotten tomorrow like unto arrogant kings who were like unto thee - who quit the world of the living.
5.10: As for me - I say - 'Thou are a demolished ruin - but thou are not YAH - for YAH is He Who created Earth and Heaven and thee.'
5.11: He debases arrogant ones - He honours them who were debased - He gives solid purchase for persons who are wearied.
5.12: He kills thriving ones - He raises up the persons who are Earth - who are dead buried in the grave,
5.13: and He sends servants forth free in Life from the dominion of sin.
5.14: O king Tseerutsaydan - why do thou boast in thy defiled idols which have no benefit?
5.15: But YAH created the Earth and Heaven and the great seas - He created the moon and sun - and He prepared times.
5.16: Man forages from his field - and when it is time he ploughs up until dusk - and Heaven's stars live secure by His Word,
5.17: and He calls all in Heaven - there is nothing done without YAH knowing it.
5.18: He commanded the Angels of Heaven that they might serve Him and might praise His glorified Name - and Angels are sent to all persons who inherit Life.
5.19: Rafael was a servant who was sent toward Tobit - and he saved Tobias from death in Raguel's country,
5.20: holy Michael was sent toward Gideon that he might draw his attention by gold that he destroy Ishmaelite persons; and he was sent toward the prophet Moses upon the time he made Israel cross the Red Sea.
5.21: As only YAH has said - he led them - there were no strange idols with them,
5.22: and He sent them forth toward the abundance of the Earth,
5.23: and He fed them His plantation grain - as He has earnestly loved them - He cherished them feeding them honey that solidified like as unto a rock,
5.24: and that thou might completely keep His kindreds by what is due - and that thou might do YAH'S Accord Who Created thee - He crowned thee Tseerutsaydan giving you authority upon the four kingdoms,
5.25: for He has crowned thee making you loftier than all - and thy creator certainly crowned thee that thou might love YAH,
5.26: and it is correct that thou might love thy creator YAH like as unto He loved thee - like as unto He trusted thee with all the people - and thou - do YAH'S Accord that thy time might abound in this world and that He might live with thee in Support,
5.27: and do YAH'S Accord that He might stand for thee being a Guardian upon thy enemies - and that He might seat thee upon thy throne - and that He might hide thee under His Wing of Support.
5.28: As for if thou do not know - YAH chose and crowned thee upon Israel like unto as He chose Saul from Israel's children when he kept his father's donkeys - and He crowned him upon his kindred of Israel - and he sat with Israel upon his throne,
5.29: and He gave him a lofty fortune separating him from his kindreds - YAH crowned thee upon His kindreds - and as from henceforth onward - hearken - keep His kindreds.
5.30: As YAH has appointed thee over them that thou might kill and might save - keep them in evil things - and them who work a goodly thing - and them who work an evil thing upon a goodly thing" he told him.
5.31: "And as YAH has appointed thee upon all that thou might do - do His Accord - be it while thou are whipped or while thou are saved - repay their evil work - they who work goodly work and they who work goodly work and evil work,
5.32: for thou are a servant of YAH Who rules all in Heaven - and thou - do YAH'S Accord that He might do thy accord for thee in all thy thoughts and in all thou begged while thou sweet-talked before Him.
5.33: There are none who rule Him - but He rules all.
5.34: There are none who appoint Him - but He appoints all.
5.35: There are none who dismiss Him - but He dismisses all.
5.36: There are none who reproach Him - but He reproaches all.
5.37: There are none who make Him diligent - but He makes all diligent - Heaven and Earth's rulership is for Him - there is none who escape from His authority; all are revealed alongside Him - yet there is none hidden from His Face.
5.38: He beholds all - but there are none who behold Him - He hears the person's prayer who prays toward Him saying 'Save Me' - for He has created man in His Image - and He accepts his plea. 39. As He is a King Who lives up until eternity - He feeds all from His unchanging Nature.

6.1: As He truly crowns the kings who do His Accord - the kings authored forthright things because of Him.
6.2: As they have done YAH'S Accord - they shall radiate in Light that is not measured, Isaac and Abraham and Jacob - Solomon and David and Hezekiah lodging in the Garden where all splendid kings are whose lodging was Light.
6.3: Heaven's Hall is what perfectly shone - yet Earth's halls are not like unto Heaven's Hall - its floor - whose visage is silver and gold and jewel in aspect - is clean,
6.4: and its features that perfectly shine cannot be searched by a person's reasoning - Heaven's Hall is what shines like unto jewels.
6.5: Like as unto YAH knew - Who is a Knower of Natures - the Heaven's Hall that He created is what a person's reasoning does not comprehend and what shines in perfect Light - its floor - that is worked in silver and gold - in jewels - in white silk and in blue silk - is clean.
6.6: It is quite totally stunning like unto this.
6.7: Righteous ones who held fast in observance and virtue are those who shall inherit it in YAH'S Charity and His Pardon,
6.8: and there is healing Water that flows from it - and it outshines like as unto the sun - and there is a Light tabernacle within it - and it is encircled by grace's fragrance.
6.9: A Garden of fruit that is beautiful and loved - whose features and taste are different - is around the House - and there are oil and grape vineyards there - and it is wholly beautiful - and its fruit fragrance is sweet.
6.10: When a flesh and blood person enters toward it - his soul will have to separate from his flesh from the Irie Ites abundance that is in it arising from its fragrant savour.
6.11: Resplendent kings who did YAH'S Accord shall be Irie there - their honour and their place is known in the Kingdom of Heaven and they live solidified forever - where well-being is found.
6.12: He showed that their lordship upon Earth was famed and honoured - and that their lordship in Heaven is famed and honoured; they shall be honoured and lofty in Heaven like as unto the honour that they yielded to Him in this world - if they work goodly work in this world they shall be Irie.
6.13: But kings who were evil in their Rule and their kingdoms that YAH gave them - they do not judge truthfully by what is due - as they have ignored the destitute and poor one's cries - they do not judge Truth and save the refugee and the wronged orphan child.
6.14: They do not save the destitute and poor ones from the wealthy hand that robs them - they do not divide and give from their food and satiate them who are an hungered - and they do not divide and give from their drink and give drink to the persons who thirsted - and they did not bend their ears toward the poor one's cry,
6.15: and He shall take them toward Gehenna which is a dark ending - upon the time that lofty Day shall arrive upon them when YAH shall come - and upon the time His wrath is done upon them like as unto David spoke in his Praises 'Lord - do not chastise me in Thy judgment and do not admonish me in Thy chastisement' - their problems and their debasement shall abound like unto their fame and abundant measure.
6.16: When there are nobles and kings who rule this world in this world - these are persons who do not keep thy law.
6.17: But YAH Who rules all is there in Heaven - all person's souls and all person's welfare has been secured by His authority - He Who gives honour to persons who glorify Him - for He absolutely rules all - and He loves the persons who love Him.
6.18: Earth and Heaven are His - He examines and knows what the kidney conveyed and what the heart thought - and to a person who adjured toward Him with a pure reasoning - He shall give him his plea's wages.
6.19: He shall destroy arrogant powerful ones - who work evil works upon the orphan child - and upon widows.
6.20: It is not by thy Power that thou seized this kingdom - it is not by thy being able that thou sat upon this throne - He loved to test thee thus, that it be possible for thee to rule like unto Saul who ruled his kindreds in that season - and He seated thee upon the throne of the kingdom - yet it is not by thy Power that thou attained this kingdom - it is when He tests thee like unto Saul who ignored the prophet Samuel's word and YAH'S Word and did not serve his army by fasting nor kill the Amalekite king - yet it is not by thy being able that thou seized this kingdom,
6.21: and YAH told the prophet Samuel - 'Go - and as they have saddened Me by demolishing My LAW and worshipping idols and bowing to the idols and by their high places and by all their detested works without benefit - tell Saul - Go toward the Amalekite's country and destroy their hosts and all the kings possessions including persons and all livestock.'
6.22: They were those that grieved YAH - because of this thing He sent Saul that he might destroy them.
6.23: But he saved their king from death - and he saved many livestock and beauties and daughters and handsome youths from death - 'As he has scorned My desire and as he did not hear My Command - because of this thing' - YAH told the prophet Samuel - 'Go and divide his kingdom,
6.24: and in his stead - anoint David the Son of Jesse that he might reign over Israel.
6.25: But upon him stay a demon who will strangle and throw him.
6.26: As he has refused as I gave him a kingdom that he might do as I Accord - upon the time he refused Me to do My Accord I dismissed him from his kingdom that was due him' - but thou - go and tell him saying - 'Will thou thus ignore YAH Who crowned thee over His kindred Israel - Who seated thee upon His Lordship's Throne?'
6.27: But thou - tell him - 'Thou did not know YAH Who gave around this much honour and renown' he told him,
6.28: and the prophet Samuel went toward king Saul and entered toward him sitting at a dinner table - and the Amalekite king Agag was sat upon his left.
6.29: 'Why did thou utterly ignore YAH Who commanded to thee that thou might destroy the livestock and the persons?' he told him,
6.30: and at that time the king feared and arose from his throne and said to Samuel 'Implore for me' he seized his clothes - and Samuel refused to return - Samuel's clothes were torn,
6.31: and Samuel told Saul - 'YAH has divided thy kingdom.'
6.32: And again Saul told Samuel before the people - 'Honour me and atone my sin for me before YAH that He might forgive me' - and as he has feared JAH'S Word Who created him - but as he did not want to kill the king - Samuel refused to return in his word,
6.33: because of this thing Samuel pierced the Amalekite king Agag before he swallowed what he was chewing,
6.34: and a demon seized that same Saul who demolished the LAW of YAH - and because He is the King of Kings Who rules all - YAH struck upon his head the king who works sin - and it did not shame him,
6.35: for His is all the creation, a Lord Who dismisses all the noble's and king's authority who do not fear Him - and there is none who rules Him.
6.36: Like as unto He spoke saying - 'David's kindred shall prosper in renown and honour - but Saul's kindred shall shame in debasement' - He destroyed the kingdom from Saul and his children,
6.37: because it saddened Him - and because He destroyed the criminals who saddened Him by their evil work - YAH revenged and destroyed Saul's kindred - for a person who does not revenge YAH'S enemies - he is YAH's enemy.
6.38: When it is possible for him to revenge and destroy - and when he has authority - a person who does not revenge and destroy the sinner and does not revenge and destroy a person who does not keep YAH'S LAW - he is YAH's enemy - and He destroyed Saul's kindred and children.

7.1: And whether thou be a king or a ruler - of what importance are thou?
7.2: Is it not YAH Who Created thee bringing from not living toward living - that thou might do His Accord and might live hardened by His Command and might fear His judgment? Like as unto thou vexed upon thy servants and governed over them - likewise there is also YAH Who vexed upon thee and governed over thee.
7.3: Like as unto thou beat without mercy persons who worked sin - likewise there is also YAH Who will strike thee and lower thee toward Gehenna where are no exits up until eternity.
7.4: Like as unto thou smite him who was not obedient to thee and did not bring a tribute to thee - why is it that thou do not introduce a tribute to YAH?
7.5: As He it is Who Created thee in order that thou treasure that they might fear thee - and Who crowned thee upon all the Creation that thou might keep His kindreds for truth - why is it that thou do not fear thy Creator YAH?
7.6: Judge by what is due and true like as YAH appointed thee - yet do not be influenced and favour for small nor great - whom will thou fear other than Him? keep His Worship and the Ten Commands.
7.7: Like unto as Moses commanded Israel's children saying - 'I have set before thee Water and fire - reach thy hand toward what thou desire' - do not go toward the rightward nor the leftward.
7.8: Hear His Word that I tell thee - that thou might hear His Word and might do His Command - lest thou say - 'She is beyond the sea or beyond the deep or beyond the river - who will bring her to me that I might see and might hear His Word and might do His Command?'
7.9: Lest thou say - 'Who will proceed toward Heaven again and bring down YAH'S Word to me that I might hear and do her?' - YAH'S Word is near to you - hearken - for thou to teach her with thy mouth and give alms by her with thy hand,
7.10: and thou did not hear thy creator YAH unless thou heard His Book - and thou did not love Him nor keep His Command unless thou kept His LAW,
7.11: and thou have that thou might enter toward Gehenna forever - and unless thou loved His Command - and unless thou did YAH'S Accord - Who honoured and exalted thee, separating from all thy kindreds that thou might keep them for truth - thou have that thou might enter toward Gehenna forever.
7.12: He made thee above all - and He crowned thee upon all His kindreds that thou might rule His kindreds for truth by what is due, while thou thought of thy creator's Name Who created thee and gave thee a kingdom.
7.13: There are those persons whom thou punished who wronged thee - and there are those whom thou pardon while thou thought on YAH'S Work - and there are those for whom thou judge by what is due correcting up thy reasoning,
7.14: and do not favour with partiality a face when they argue before thee - as Earth's circle is thy posession - do not accept a bribe that thou might pardon the sinner and wrong the clean person.
7.15: If thou do His Accord - YAH shall multiply thy time in this world for thee - but if thou sadden Him - He will diminish thy time.
7.16: Think on that thou will rise after thou are dead - and that thou will be examined standing before Him over all the work thou worked, whether it be goodly or evil.
7.17: If thou work goodly work - thou will live in the Garden in the Kingdom of Heaven - in houses where righteous kings live and where is Light fulfilled, for YAH does not dishonor thy lordship authority - but if thou work evil work - thou will live in Sheol Gehenna where evil kings live.
7.18: But upon the time thou beheld thy being dreaded and renown - thy warrior's award - thy hanging shield and spear - and upon the time thou beheld thy horses and thy troops beneath thy authority and them who beat the drum and persons who play upon a harp before thee,
7.19: but upon the time thou beheld all this - thou made thy reasoning lofty - and thou stiffened thy neck - and thou did not think of YAH Who gave thee all this honour - however upon the time He told thee - 'Quit all this' - thou did not quit it,
7.20: for thou have totally neglected the appointment He appointed thee - and He shall give thy lordship to another.
7.21: As death shall suddenly come upon thee - and as judgment shall be done at the Resurrection time - and as all man's Work shall be examined - He shall thoroughly investigate and judge upon thee.
7.22: There are none who will honour this world's kings - because He was a True Judge - in judgment time the poor and wealthy will stand together. This world's noble crowns wherein they boast shall fall.
7.23: Judgment is prepared - and a soul shall quake - at that time the work of the sinner and the righteous shall be examined,
7.24: and there are none who shall be hidden, as upon the time a woman has arrived for birthing - and upon the time the life in her belly has arrived for being birthed - like as unto she can not prevent her womb - Earth also can not prevent her lodgers that are within her - they will return,
7.25: and like unto as clouds can not prevent rain lest they take and rain toward the place YAH commanded them - for YAH'S Word has created all bringing from not living toward living - and again YAH'S Word has acquainted all with the grave; and all likewise - after the Resurrection time has arrived - it is not possible that dead persons will not rise.
7.26: Like as unto Moses spoke saying - 'It is by Words that proceed from YAH'S Tongue - yet it is not only by grain that a person is saved'; and YAH'S Word again shall arouse all persons from the graves.
7.27: Hearken - it is known that dead persons shall arise by YAH's Word,
7.28: and again YAH said thus echoing in the Law because of persons who were nobles and kings who do not His Accord - 'As the day has arrived when they are counted for destruction - I shall revenge and destroy them upon the day when judgment is judged and at the time when their feet stumble.' He said,
7.29: and again YAH told persons who know His judgment - 'Know that I am your creator YAH - and that I kill and I save,
7.30: I chastise in the tribulation and I pardon - I lower toward Sheol and again I send forth toward the Garden - and there is none who shall escape from My authority.' He told them.
7.31: YAH said thus because nobles and kings who do not keep His LAW - 'As Earthly kingdoms are passing - and as they pass from morning up until evening - keep My Order and My LAW that you might enter toward the Kingdom of Heaven that lives forever.' He said.
7.32: For YAH's calling to Righteous ones is for glory - and for sinners tribulation - He will make the sinner wretched but will honour righteous ones.
7.33: He will dismiss the person who did not do His Accord - but He will appoint the person who did His Accord.

8.1: Hear me - let me tell thee the way whereby dead persons shall arise - they shall plant a plant and be fertile and grapes shall send forth vines - as YAH shall bring the fruit 'imhibe 'albo - they shall draw wine from it.
8.2: Grasp that the plant thou planted was small - but that she sent forth tips, fruit, and leaves at once.
8.3: YAH gives her roots to drink from Earth and Water - from both.
8.4: But He feeds her wood from fire and wind - the root gives leaves Water to drink - and Earth gives firmness to the wood.
8.5: But the soul that YAH created will bear fruit amidst them - and dead persons arising are likewise,
8.6: as upon the time the soul was separated from the flesh - as each of them themselves have gone - He said - 'Gather souls from the four natures - from Earth and Water - wind and fire'.
8.7: But the Earth nature lived rooted in her nature and became Earth - and the Water nature lived rooted in her nature and became Water,
8.8: and the wind nature lived rooted in her nature and became wind - and the fire nature lived rooted in her nature and became a hot fire.
8.9: But a soul that YAH separates from flesh returns toward her creator - up until He raises her up united with flesh at the time He desires - He places her in the Garden in the place He adores.
8.10: He places righteous souls in houses of Light in the Garden - but that He might send away sinner's souls - He also places them in the house of darkness in Sheol up until the time when He delights.
8.11: As YAH told the prophet Ezekiel - 'Call souls from the four corners - that they might be gathered and be one branch',
8.12: upon the time He spoke in one Word saying thus - the souls were gathered from the four corners,
8.13: and Water nature brought flourishing vegetation - and again fire nature brought fire,
8.14: and again Earth nature brought Earth - and wind nature brought wind,
8.15: and YAH brought a soul from the Garden where He placed it - they were gathered by one Word - and a Resurrection was made.
8.16: And again I shall show thee the example that is close to thee - the day turns to dusk - thou sleep - the night dawns - and thou rise from thy bedding - but as to the time thou slept, it is thy example of death,
8.17: and as to the time thou awoke it is thy example of the Resurrection - but the night when all persons sleep whose characters were dark - for darkness has covered them - is the example of this world.
8.18: But the morning light - when darkness is eliminated and when light is in all the world and when persons arise and forage toward the field - is the dead person's example,
8.19: and this Kingdom of Heaven where man is renewed is like unto this - a dead person's Resurrection is like unto this - as this world is passing - it is the example of night,
8.20: and like as unto David spoke saying - 'He placed His example in the sun' - as the sun shines at the time it rises - it is the example of the Kingdom of Heaven,
8.21: and like as unto the sun shines in this world today - upon the time Messiah comes He shall shine like as unto the sun anew in the Kingdom of Heaven - as He has said - 'I am a sun that does not set and a Torch that is not extinguished' - YAH He is her Light,
8.22: and He shall quickly arouse the dead persons again - I shall bring one example to thee again from thy food that thou sow and whereby thou are renewed - and whether it be a wheat kernel or a barley kernel or a lentil kernel or all man's seeds sown upon Earth - there is none that grows unless it is demolished and rotten,
8.23: and like as unto the person's flesh thou behold - upon the time it is demolished and rotten - Earth eats the body with the skin,
8.24: and upon the time the Earth ate it's body it grew being around a kernel shell - YAH provides a cloud that rains rain where He desires - and roots grow upon Earth and send forth leaves,
8.25: and if the seed was demolished and rotten she can grow - but after she grows she sends forth many buds,
8.26: and by YAH'S Accord fruit is given to those buds that budded - and He clothes its body in husk.
8.27: Behold like unto the measure that the single seed kernel thou sowed abounded - yet the stem and the leaf - the ear and the husk are not counted for thee.
8.28: Do not be a dull one who does not know - and behold thy seed that has abounded - and all likewise - know that dead persons shall receive the Resurrection and they will arise - and their hardship shall be like unto their work.
8.29: Hear me - that if thou sow wheat - it will not grow being barley - nor being wheat if thou sow barley - and make me tell thee again that it will not grow - if thou sow wheat will thou gather barley? If thou sow watercress will thou gather linseed?
8.30: How about from a plant's kinds - if thou plant figs will it ever grow for thee being nuts? How about if thou plant almonds - will it grow for thee being grapes?
8.31: If thou plant the sweet fruit will it grow for thee being bitter? How about if thou plant the bitter fruit - is it possible for it to be sweet?
8.32: How about all likewise - if a sinner died is it possible to arise being righteous in the Resurrection time? How about if a righteous person died - is it possible to arise being a sinner in the Resurrection time? Every one shall receive his hardship like unto his work - yet he will receive his hardship like unto his sin and his handiwork - yet there is none who will be convicted by his companion's sin.
8.33: A highland tree is planted and it sends forth long branches - it will utterly dry up - unless Heaven rained rain, its leaves will not be lush,
8.34: and the cedar will be uprooted from its roots unless the summer rain lights upon it,
8.35: and all likewise - dead persons will not arise unless the dew of blessing lights upon them being commanded from YAH.

9.1: Unless a pardoning rain being commanded from YAH reaches the highland mountains and the regions of Gilboa rain - they will not grow grass for beasts and animals,
9.2: and the mountains of Elam and the mountains of Gilead will not give flourishing leaves for sheeps and goats - nor for oribi and animals in the wilderness - nor for ibexes and hartebeest,
9.3: and likewise - pardoning dew being commanded from YAH does not alight on doubters and criminals who made error and crime a reward beforehand - those dead persons will not arise - and Deemas and Cyprus who worship idols and dig roots and work and plot a thing,
9.4: and they who dig roots and practice sorcery and make persons battle,
9.5: and they who lust having departed from the LAW - and those of Media and Athens who believe in their idols - and they who play and sing for them while they beat violins and drums and strum on harps - they will not arise unless the pardoning dew alights on them being commanded from YAH.
9.6: These are they who will be convicted upon the day when dead persons arise and when Definite judgment is done - yet persons who save themselves and who lust in their own handiwork - they err by their idols.
9.7: Thou wasteful one and dull of heart - does it seem to thee that dead persons shall not arise?
9.8: Upon the time the trumpet is blown by the Angel's Chief Michael's tongue - the dead ones arise then - as thou will not remain in the grave without arising - do not think a thing that is thus.
9.9: Hills and mountains shall be level and shall be a cleared path,
9.10: and the Resurrection shall be accomplished for all fleshly ones.

10.1: However if it were not thus - it is that former persons might be buried in their father's grave beginning from Adam - beginning from Seth and Abel - Shem and Noah - Isaac and Abraham - Joseph and Jacob - and Aaron and Moses - yet why is it that they did not wish that they might be buried in another place?
10.2: Is not it for them to arise together with their kindred in the Resurrection time? How about is it not lest their bones be counted with evil one's and pagan's bones - they who worship idols? for why is it that they did not wish that they might be buried in another place?
10.3: But thou - do not mislead thy reasoning while thou say - 'How will dead persons arise after they are dead - all they who were buried in one grave being tens of thousands and whose bodies were demolished and rotten?'
10.4: And upon the time thou look toward a grave - thou speak this in thy reasoning dullness while thou say - 'A whole fistful of Earth will not be found - how will the dead persons arise?'
10.5: Will thou say the seed thou sowed will not grow? Even the seed thou sowed shall grow,
10.6: and all likewise - the souls YAH sowed shall quickly arise - as He has created man in His Truth bringing from not living toward living - He shall arouse them quickly by His Word that saves - He will not delay His arousing,
10.7: and as He has again returned them from living toward a grave in death - what about it is not possible for Him again to return from death toward Life?
10.8: Saving and lifting up are possible for YAH.

11.1: Arnon perished and her fortress was demolished - as YAH has brought the hardship upon them like unto their evil and the work they worked by their hands - persons who worship the idols in Edom and Zebulon shall be debased at that time - as YAH has petitioned - Who shall convict them all who worked in their infancy and did not relent up until their old age - because of their idols and their evil - Sidon and Tyre shall weep,
11.2: because they worked sin and seducing fornication and worshipped idols - because of this thing YAH shall revenge and destroy them - for they did not live stout in their creator YAH'S Command - and Jerusalem's daughters shall be wretched.
11.3: She lived unshakable in killing prophets and in killing Irie Ites - yet as she did not live stout in the Ten Laws and the Worship - upon the time when dead ones arise - Jerusalem's sin shall be revealed.
11.4: At that time YAH shall examine her in the Nature of His Wisdom - He will revenge and destroy her with all her sin that she worked in her former times - she did not leave off working her sin beginning from her time of youth up until her old age.
11.5: She entered toward a grave and became dust like unto her former fathers who lived wrapped up in their sin - and in the Resurrection time He shall revenge and destroy persons who demolished YAH'S LAW.
11.6: It shall be judged upon them - for Moses has spoken because of their sayings - 'Their LAW chambers - their reasonings - became Sodom's law chambers.'
11.7: And their kindred is Gomorrah - and their law is what destroys - and their work is evil,
11.8: and their law is snake's venom that destroys - and viper's venom that destroys from alongside that.

12.1: Children of Jerusalem - as this thy sin is like unto the sin of Gomorrah and the sin of Sodom - children of Jerusalem - this is thy tribulation that was spoken of by the prophets,
12.2: and thy tribulation is like unto the tribulation of Gomorrah and Sodom - with the abiding thoughts of the law fixed in adultery and arrogance.
12.3: Aside from the fall of adultery and arrogance - showers of forgiveness and humility did not fall from their thoughts - only bribes are the thoughts of their law in abundance - in addition to spilling man's blood and robbing and forgetting their creator YAH,
12.4: and they did not know their creator YAH - apart from their evil work and their idols - and they are pompous in their handiwork - and they lust upon males and upon livestock.
12.5: As their eyes of reason have been blinded lest they discover secrets - and as their ears have been deafened lest they hear and do YAH'S Accord that He loves - they did not know YAH in their work - and their reasoning is like unto the law of the house of Sodom and their kindred - the house of Gomorrah's grapes that bear sweet fruit,
12.6: and if they examine their work - it is poison that kills - for it has congealed in a curse beginning from the day when it was worked - and for it is a grounded foundation at the time of destruction.
12.7: And their house - their thoughts - have solidified in works of sin - as their bodies have become buildings in satan's burning work of sin - their house - their thoughts - never have goodly work,
12.8: and upon the time he was shamed and was purified (by one who is led) it was for chastisement and destruction - and he will establish the persons who drank of the cup and their thoughts - and he will make them those who destroy us - disgusting persons who are separated from YAH,
12.9: for they have lived established in their work that is evil - and he will make them a habitation of devils - and eating what was sacrificed to the idols has started in the House of Israel - and she proceeds toward the high places and the groves,
12.10: and she worships the idols that peoples in her region worship - and gives her daughters and her sons to demons who do not know goodly work apart from evil,
12.11: and they spill clean blood - they gush and spill grapes from Sodom to the idols continually,
12.12: and she glorifys and worships the Dagon that the Philistines worship - and she sacrifices to him from her flocks and her fattened cows - that she might be seen by demons, content that they taught her to sacrifice to them - and in their gushing and spilling the grapes - and that she might do their accord.
12.13: She sacrifices to him that she might be seen by demons, content that they taught her, lest she know her creator YAH Who feeds her always and Who cherished and raised her beginning from her infancy up until her youth - and again up until her age - and again up until her old age when she died,
12.14: and again I shall revenge and convict the satan in the Resurrection time - and as she did not return toward My LAW - and as she did not live established in My Command - her time when she lives in Gehenna shall be up until eternity.
12.15: If they were truly gods - make her idols arise with her and descend toward Gehenna and save her upon the time I vex and destroy her - and upon the time I cut off all the priests of the idols who lust with her.
12.16: Like as unto she made sin and insult upon the holy Items and upon My habitation the Temple - I made Jerusalem wretched by all this.
12.17: When they told her - 'Hearken - you are YAH'S kindred - and this is Israel's creator YAH'S habitation - and the famous country of Jerusalem which is separate and them who are separate - she is where the Name of the Most High YAH rests' - I made her wretched like as unto she saddened My Name that was called in her.
12.18: She boasts in Me that she was My servant and that I was her Lord - she winks upon Me like unto a criminal - yet she is not one who fears Me or does My Accord as if I were her Lord.
12.19: They became an obstacle to her to mislead that they might distance her from Me - yet she is ruled by other idols who do not feed her nor clothe her.
12.20: She offers sacrifice to them - and she eats the sacrifice - and she spills blood to them - and she gushes and drinks from the grapes for them - she smokes up incense to them - and she makes the fragrance of incense smell for them - her idols command her - and she is commanded by them,
12.21: and again she sacrifices her daughters and her sons to them - and as she presents praises to them because of their desire - she is self-satisfied in the thing she spoke by her tongue and in her handiwork.
12.22: Woe to her upon the day when Definite judgment is done - and woe to her idols whom she loves and unites with; and she shall descend with them toward Gehenna beneath Sheol - where the worm does not slumber and the fire is not extinguished.
12.23: Woe to thee wretched children of Jerusalem - for thou have abandoned Me Who created thee and have worshipped different idols,
12.24: and I shall bring the hardship upon thee like as unto equal to thy work - as thou have saddened Me - and as thou have ignored My Word - and as thou did not work goodly work - I shall convict thee toward thy conceit,
12.25: for thou have saddened My Word - and for thou did not live according to My LAW whereby thou swore with Me - that thou might keep My LAW and that I might live with thee in Support and might save thee from all who come against thee - and also that thou might keep My Order that I commanded thee - and I shall ignore thee and will not quickly save thee from the tribulation.
12.26: Thou did not keep all this - and I ignored thee - as I have created thee - and as thou did not keep My Command nor My Word - I shall convict thee in judgment time - and I honoured thee that thou might be My kin,
12.27: and like unto Gomorrah and Sodom was separated from Me - thou was separated from Me,
12.28: and I judged and destroyed them - and like as unto Sodom and Gomorrah was separated from Me - thou are separated from Me - and now like as unto I vexed and destroyed them - I vex and destroy thee - as thou are from the kindred of Sodom and Gomorrah whom I destroyed - I destroy thee - as they whom I created have saddened Me by going toward another man's wife and by lusting without LAW - with animals and males like unto arriving with daughters - I destroy the speaking of their name from this world lest they live in their Irie Ites.
12.29: There is no fearing YAH in their faces beginning from an infant up until an elder - they help satan in all their evil work - yet He does not vex upon each one that they might repent from working her - as their work is evil - they are sated of sin and iniquity.
12.30: All evil work - robbery and arrogance and greed - are prepared in their mind,
12.31: and because of this thing YAH ignored them and destroyed their countries - and they are there that He might burn them up with fire until their deepest roots in the ground perish - they will totally perish until eternity - yet He did not make even one of them remain.
12.32: As they have become sin - they shall wait in destruction forever up until the Day of Advent when Definite judgment is done - for they have saddened Me with their evil work - and I will not pardon them nor forgive them,
12.33: and I ignored them - for thou will not find discernment as I vex and seize thee because all thy work is robbery and sin - adultery and greed and speaking lies - all error work and the obstacle that I do not love - and thou children of Jerusalem who are wretched - upon the day when judgment is done thou will be seized in judgment like unto them.
12.34: I had made thee for honour - but thou debased thyself - I had called thee My possession - but thou became for another.
12.35: I had betrothed thee for honour - but thou became for devils - and I shall revenge and destroy thee like unto thy evil work,
12.36: because thou did not hear all My Word - and because thou did not keep the Command I commanded thee upon the time I loved thee - I shall multiply and bring strong vengeance upon thee - for I am YAH Who created thee - and I shall judge upon all sinners like unto thee - and upon the day when judgment is done I shall bring the hardship upon them like as unto their evil work.
12.37: As thou did not keep My Word - and as thou have ignored My judgment - I shall convict thee with them.
12.38: Woe for you - Gomorrah and Sodom - who have no fear of YAH in your thoughts.
12.39: All likewise - woe to the daughters of Jerusalem upon whom it shall be judged together with thee in the fire of Gehenna - for you will descend together toward Gehenna that was prepared for you - where are no exits forever - and woe to all sinners who worked thy sin.
12.40: As you did not keep My Command nor My Word - thou and she who did not keep My Command nor My Word shall descend toward Sheol together upon the day when judgment is judged.
12.41: But obedient persons who kept My Command and My Word shall eat the possessions that sinners accumulated - and like as unto YAH commanded - righteous persons shall share the loot that evil persons captured - and kind persons shall be totally Irie.
12.42: But wrongdoers and sinners shall weep - and they shall be sad because of all their sin that they wronged having departed from My Command.
12.43: Him who keeps My Word and lives firmed up in My Command - he is who finds My blessing and is honoured alongside Me.
12.44: All persons who keep My Word and live firmed up in My Command shall eat the fatness found from the Earth - and shall live having entered toward the Garden where enter righteous kings who have straight thoughts.

13.1: As they shall be wretched and perish by My wrath upon the time I seize them - woe to the countries of Tyre and Sidon and all the region of Judah who make themselves arrogant today.
13.2: Triumphant YAH says thus - He has said - the devil's child who is totally arrogant shall be birthed from them - the False Messiah who for a Truth is her enemy - who stiffens his neck - who boasts and do not know his creator - and He said - Woe to them - and YAH Who rules all said - I made him an image for My anger that I might be revealed in his Power,
13.3: and this Capernaum and Samaria and Galilee and Damascus and Syria and Athens and Cyprus and all the region of Jordan, they are kindreds who stiffened their necks - who live comfortable in their sin - and to whom death's shadow and darkness have covered - for devils have clouded their minds in sin - and they are conducted to the arrogant devils - and they do not return toward fearing YAH.
13.4: At that time woe to persons who are conducted to demons and who offer sacrifice in their name to them - as they have denied YAH Who created them - they resemble animals without minds - for the False Messiah who forgot YAH'S LAW and is the devil's child shall set up his image in all the places (for he has said 'I am a god') - and he shall be smug in his reasoning - in his handiwork and in robbery and all the sins and perfidy and iniquity - in robbery and all the adulteries that a person works,
13.5: for because it was counted alongside YAH that he works this - the time is known that they work sin.
13.6: The sun shall darken and the moon shall be blood - and stars shall be shaken from Heaven - all the work shall pass by the miracles that YAH shall bring in the Time of fulfillment that He might make Earth pass - and that He might make all pass who live in sin and persons who live within her.
13.7: As YAH has been proud over the creation He created - and as He has quickly made all He loved in one time - the Lord's death shall destroy a small enemy of devils,
13.8: for YAH Who rules all has said - I shall judge and destroy - but after the Advent - devils have no authority,
13.9: and upon the day when he was accomplished by My anger - he shall descend toward Gehenna - for which he makes application and where firm tribulation is - as he will take all who are with him toward chastisement and destruction and perfidy - because I am Who sends forth to Gehenna and Who introduces toward Gehenna - he will descend toward Gehenna.
13.10: As He gives firmness and Power to weak persons - and again as He gives weakness to powerful and strong persons - He makes a powerful one not boast in his Power.
13.11: As He is a Ruler - and as He judges and saves the wronged persons from the person's hands who wrongs them - He will return the cause of the widows and orphans.
13.12: Woe to thee who boast and stiffen thy neck - to whom it seems that I will not rule thee nor judge and destroy thee - for in his boasting and his arrogance he has said - 'I will stretch my throne in the stars and Heaven - and I will be like unto YAH Who is lofty.'
13.13: And like as unto He spoke saying - How you devils fall from Heaven - him who shines like unto a morning star that was created preceding all - woe to thee,
13.14: and thou dared and spoke this in thy arrogance - and thou did not think of YAH Who wholly created thee by His authority - why did thou boast thyself that thou should descend toward Gehenna in the strength of thy mind?
13.15: Thou were debased separate from all the Angels like unto thee - for they praise their Creator with a humbled reasoning because they know that He is Who created them from fire and wind - and for they do not depart from His Command - and for they keep their reasonings from perfidy lest they ever depart from His Command.
13.16: But thou did a strong betrayal in the arrogance of thy mind - thou became a wretched one separate from thy companions - for thou have cherished all the sin and iniquity - robbery and corruption whereby persons who forget YAH'S LAW and sinners like unto thee live - them who are from thy kindred and commit crime like unto thee - and who live established by thy command and thy accord whereby thou teach sin.
13.17: Woe to thee - for the demons thou misled in thy malice and thou will descend toward Gehenna together.
13.18: O you YAH'S children who erred by that misleading criminal devil - woe to you - as you have erred like unto him by the gain that he taught you and that his hosts taught you - you will descend toward Gehenna together - where are no exits forever,
13.19: and formerly when YAH'S servant Moses was there - you saddened YAH by the water where arguments were made and upon Horeb - and by the Amalekites and upon Mount Sinai,
13.20: and moreover upon the time you sent scouts toward Canaan - and upon the time they told you this saying 'The path is far - and the ramparts and the fortresses that reach up until Heaven are firm - and warriors live there' - you vexed that you might return toward the land of Egypt where you worked worrisome work - and you saddened YAH'S Word,
13.21: you did not think of YAH Who protected you from the tribulation - and Who did great miracles in Egypt - and Who led you by His Angel's authority. He would veil you in cloud by day lest the sun burn you and He would shine a column of fire for you by night lest your feet stumble in the darkness,
13.22: and upon the time the army and Pharaoh frightened you - you wholly cried toward Moses - and Moses wholly cried toward YAH - and He lodged in His Angel and kept you lest you meet with Pharaoh.
13.23: But He introduced them toward Jericho in tribulation - YAH led only Israel - for He has said - and there were no different idols with them - but He buried their enemies in the sea at one time - and He did not preserve any who fled from them,
13.24: and He made Israel cross amidst the sea by foot - there was no tribulation that found them arising from the Egyptians - He delivered them toward Mount Sinai - and there He fed them manna forty years.
13.25: And Israel's children saddened YAH continually - He did all these goodly things for them and they neglected to worship YAH.
13.26: They placed evil in their minds beginning from their childhood up until their old age - for YAH'S Mouth has spoken thus in Horeb where the father's genealogies were written - as He has spoken saying - Adam's children's thoughts are ash - and all their works are toward robbery and they run toward evil - there are none from them who love straight work - apart from gathering a person's possessions in violence and swearing in lies and wronging companions and robbing and stealing - they place evil in their hearts,
13.27: and all go toward evil work during the time they live in Life - Israel's children who demolish YAH'S LAW entirely sadden YAH beginning from Antiquity up until the end of the age.

14.1: And upon the time YAH destroyed the children of Cain - of ancient generations - in the destruction of Water because they sinned - He baptised Earth in the Water of the flood - and He cleansed her from all the sins of Cain's children.
14.2: As He has said - I was sad because I created man - He destroyed all wrongdoers - He did not preserve apart from eight persons - He destroyed all - after this He multiplied them and they filled Earth - they shared in their father Adam's inheritance.
14.3: But Noah swore with YAH an oath - they swore an oath with YAH lest YAH again destroy the Earth in a destruction of Water - and lest Noah's children eat what is deceased nor what was located already dead - lest they worship different idols apart from YAH Who created them - and that He might be a Loving father for them - and lest He destroy them at one time in their vain sin - and lest He prevent from them the early and the spring rain - and that He might give to livestock and persons their food at the appointed time - that He might give them the grass and the grain, fruit, and plants - and that they might work goodly work in all that YAH loves,
14.4: and after He gave them this Order - Israel's children saddened YAH by their sin - they did not live under His LAW like unto their fathers Isaac and Abraham and Jacob who did not overthrow their creator YAH'S LAW, 5. and beginning from the small up until the great - those children of Israel did not keep YAH'S LAW and are crooked in their work, 6and whether they be the priests or the chiefs or the scribes - everyone put away YAH'S LAW. 7They do not live settled in YAH'S Order and His LAW that Moses commanded them in a Repeating Law saying - 'Love thy creator YAH in thy complete body and thy complete reasoning.' 8They do not live by YAH'S Order and His LAW that Moses commanded them in the book where the LAW was written saying - 'Love thy companion like unto thy body - and do not worship idols that are different - and do not go toward another man's wife - do not kill a soul - do not steal, 9and do not witness a lie - and be it his donkey or be it his ox - do not love thy companion's possessions nor all that thy brother possesses.' 10However after he commanded them all this - Israel's children who were evil returned toward treachery and sin - robbery and iniquity - toward another man's wife and toward lies and stealing and worshipping idols. 11Israel's children saddened YAH upon Horeb by working a calf that grazes the grass - they bowed saying - 'Hearken - these are our idols who sent us forth from Egypt.' 12And they were proud of their handiwork - they ate and drank and were satiate - and they arose to sing. 13As YAH has told him saying - Thy kindreds whom thou sent forth from the land of Egypt and the house of bondage - they have proceeded from the LAW and wronged - and they worked the image of a calf and bowed to the idol - because of this thing Moses was vexed and descended from Mount Sinai. 14While Moses vexed upon his kindreds - he descended with his confidant Joshua - and upon the time Joshua heard - he said - 'Hearken - I hear warrior's voices in Israel's camp.' 15And Moses told Joshua - 'It is when Israel plays having drunk the unboiled wine - yet as for a warrior's voice - it is not' - and he went and broke their image and completely crushed it up until it was like unto dust - he mixed it within the Water that Israel's children drank beside the mountain, 16and after this he commanded the Levites that they might slay one another because of the sin they worked before YAH. 17They knew that defying YAH surpassed killing their brethren and killing their fathers - and they did like unto as he commanded them, 18and Moses told them - because you saddened YAH Who fed you and cherished you and Who sent you forth from the house of bondage and Who bequeathed for you the inheritance that He swore to your fathers that He might give to them and to their children after them - because of this thing you made YAH Irie.' 19For they go toward sin and an evil thing - and they did not quit saddening YAH there. 20They are not like unto their fathers Isaac and Abraham and Jacob who made YAH Irie with their goodly Work that He might give them what is upon Earth and what He prepared for persons who love Him in Heaven beginning from their infancy up until their youth and up until their old age - they are not like unto Abraham and Isaac and Jacob who made Him Irie with their work that He might give them an Earth of inheritance where Irie Ites are found in this world - and a Garden that makes Irie - prepared for righteous persons in the world hereafter - what He prepared for Abraham and Isaac and Jacob who made YAH Irie when they were in Life and who loved Him - Whom an eye did not see nor an ear hear and Who is not thought of in the heart, 21and their children who denied YAH and were evil and who live satisfied in the sin of their heart - they did not hear YAH'S Command - He Who fed them and cherished them and kept them beginning from their infancy. 22They did not think of YAH - Who sent them forth from the land of Egypt and saved them from brick work and a harsh bondage. 23But they totally saddened Him - and He would arouse foreigners in their area to come upon them - and they would arise upon them in enmity and also quarrel for what they wanted in common.

15.1: And at that time people from Midian arose upon them in enmity - and they aroused their armies upon Israel that they might fight them - and their king's name was called Akrandis - he quickly gathered many armies in CeloSyria and Syria and Damascus,
15.2: and camping beyond Jordan he sent messengers saying - 'and that I might capture your possessions - pay tax toward Israel to me' - he told them - 'But if you do not pay tribute - I will come that I might punish you and might capture your livestocks and take your mares and capture your children.'
15.3: 'I will capture and take you toward a country you do not know - and there I will make you water pourers and wood pickers' he told them,
15.4: 'do not boast while you say - "I am YAH'S kindreds and there is nothing able for Me" - is it not YAH Who sent me that I might destroy you and plunder your money? and is it not I whom YAH sent that I might gather all your kindreds?
15.5: Is there really any salvation that the different godss were able to save the other nations that I destroyed? I captured their mares and their horses and I killed them and captured their children,
15.6: and unless you introduce the tribute that I command you - I will destroy you like unto them' he said - and he crossed Jordan that he might plunder their livestocks and their possessions and capture their wives,
15.7: and after this Israel's children wept a true mourning toward YAH - and from their heart they cried - however they lacked one to help them,
15.8: and because of this thing YAH gave power to the three brethren - and their names are like unto this - and they are Judas, Simon, and Jonathan - whose features were handsome and who were warriors in their Power,
15.9: and the children of Israel wept there - upon the time they heard - it saddened them in their heart - arising from the shout of all the children of Israel - the orphan - and the widow - and their officials and their priests - all Israel's kindred - both daughters and sons - and all children - would weep sprinkling ash upon their heads - and their nobles wore sackcloth.
15.10: But those brethren - who were attractive and comely - went and agreed that they might save them - they counseled saying - 'Let us go and give our bodies to death because of these persons.'
