15.11: Telling one another - 'take heart - take heart' - they went girding their swords upon their waists and seizing their spears in their hands - and they went prepared that they might hold the warrior king to account, 12. and they arrived toward their camp - Simon attacked the warrior while he sat at a dinner table - he cut his neck in one blow while the food was in his mouth; and Jonathan and Judas struck his armies upon the king's left and right by the sword and killed them, 13and upon the time their king was defeated - there entered upon them spears in their companion's hearts - and they all fled and their bows were broken and they were defeated. 14But those brethren who are attractive and comely were saved from death - there is no evil thing that found them - but as YAH has returned chastisement toward the army - they sliced up one another and were depleted. 15They were defeated and dead and they crossed the Jordan - and up until they crossed they cast away all their possessions - and all their money remained - and upon the time Israel's children saw that their enemies fled - they went toward the camp and took both what they plundered and their money for themselves. 16YAH saved Israel doing thus by the brethren and the Maccabees' hand. 17Israel existed a few days while they made YAH Irie. 18But after that they again returned toward their sin - Israel's children neglected worshipping YAH by what is due, 19and He shall again sadden them by nations who do not know them and who will gather their field crops and destroy their grape vineyards and plunder their flocks and slaughter and feed them their livestocks before them, 20and who will capture their wives and their daughters and sons - because it was that they sadden YAH continually - as they are kindreds who demolish the LAW - they will hammer their children before them upon each of their heads - they will not save them.

16.1: They who do this are Tyre and Sidon and they who live beyond the Jordan river and upon the sea coast - Hebron and Gilead - the Jebusite and Canaanite - the Edomite and Girgashite and Amalekite.
16.2: All peoples do thus - who live strengthened in each of their tribes and countries and regions and in each of their works and tongues - and all live strong like as unto YAH made them,
16.3: and there are persons from them who know YAH - and whose work is beautiful,
16.4: and there are persons from them whose works are evil and who do not know YAH Who Created them - and like as unto they worked sin - He ruled them in Syria by king Shalmaneser's hand.
16.5: As he plundered and took Damascus' possessions - and as he shared Samaria's loot that is before Egypt's king - He ruled them in Shalmaneser's hand.
16.6: Gilboa's region and also persons in Persia and Median - Capadocia and Caesarea - who live in the West mountains - in the fortress of Gilead and Pathros that is part of Judah's land,
16.7: and these are who live in that region - and they are kindreds who do not know YAH nor keep His Command - and whose necks are stiff,
16.8: and He shall pay them their hardship like as unto their evil work and their handiwork,
16.9: for Gilead's kindreds and the region of Caesarea and the Amalekites have become one there - that they might destroy YAH'S country that was filled of a Truth - and within which Israel's Creator is praised - Him Who is Most Glorified and conquering - and Whom Angels who are many many in chariots drawn by Cherubim - they who stand before Him - serve with fearing and trembling - and He shall pay them their hardship like unto their evil work and their handiwork.

17.1: Amalekites and Edomites do not worship YAH by Whose authority and rule Earth and Heaven were made - as they are law breakers who do not live in Truth's Work - they do not fear to debase His tabernacle - the Temple,
17.2: and there is no fear of YAH before them - apart from shedding blood and adultery and eating what was strangled and sacrificed to an idol and all that appear to be found dead - and these are scorned sinners.
17.3: They have no virtue nor religion - as they are who hated goodly Work - and as they do not know YAH - and as they do not know Love's Work - apart from robbing a person's money and from sin - and apart from disturbing a person and all hated Work - apart from games and song like unto their father devils taught them - they have no virtue nor religion.
17.4: As he has ruled them with his host of demons - he teaches them all evil Work that is to each of themselves - all robbery and sin - theft and falsehood - robbing money and eating what was beaten and what was found dead - and Work in adultery,
17.5: and he teaches them all that resemble this - and going toward another man's wife - and shedding blood - eating what was sacrificed to an idol and what dies of its own self - and killing a person's soul in violence - and envy and winking and greed and all evil Work that YAH does not love - devils who were their enemies teach them this teaching that he might separate them from YAH'S LAW Who rules all the world.
17.6: But YAH'S Works are innocence and humility - not annoying the brethren but loving a companion - harmonising and loving with all persons,
17.7: do not be hypocrites to give favour to a person's face - and do not be wrongdoers nor robbers nor persons who go toward another man's wife - nor persons who work iniquity and evil Work upon their companion - nor who cajole that they might wrong their companion in violence.
17.8: They sneer and shake their heads and provoke to evil - they discourage to mislead that they might lower them toward eternity's Definite judgment.

18.1: Think upon that thou will go in death toward YAH - in Whose Hand all are - and that thou will stand before Him that He might convict thee before Him upon all the sin thou have Worked.
18.2: As they who are arrogant and evil - and powerful one's children who are not stronger than them - were likewise formerly - because they saw their stature and their Power and their firm authority - they did not care for YAH before them - and they did not know that He is their creator Who created them bringing from not living toward living,
18.3: and when their fathers being like as unto Angels praised upon the Mount with holy Angels - upon the time their covenant misled them - they descended toward this world where Definite judgment shall be done forever.
18.4: As YAH in the Antiquity has created human flesh for them - that it might mislead them because of their reasoning arrogance and might test them as it were that they kept His LAW and His Command - they married wives from Cain's children.
18.5: But they did not keep His LAW - He lowered them toward Gehenna's fire with their father devils; for YAH has vexed upon the offspring of Seth who were wronged by other persons - and persons time diminished because of their sin,
18.6: and they took Adam's children toward sin with them - He lowered them toward Sheol where they shall receive a verdict.
18.7: As persons time has been divided because Seth's children erred by Cain's children - when a persons years were nine hundred in the Antiquity - they returned toward living a hundred twenty years,
18.8: and as they are flesh and blood - YAH said - My Spirit of Support will not always strive upon them,
18.9: and because of this thing my years were divided - for because of my sin and my iniquity - my years have been divided from my fathers who preceded - and when they are in their infancy - they are dying.
18.10: But my father's years had abounded - because they kept His LAW and because they did not sadden YAH.
18.11: But my father's years had abounded - because they vexed upon their daughters that they might teach them - and because they vexed upon their sons lest they abolish YAH'S LAW,
18.12: because they did not demolish YAH'S LAW with their daughters and their sons - because of this thing their years had abounded for true.

19.1: Upon the time Cain's children abounded they worked drums and harps - santee and violins - and they made songs and all the games,
19.2: children who are attractive and comely were birthed for Cain from the wife of the righteous man Abel - whom he killed because of her - for she was attractive - and after he killed his brother he took her as his possession,
19.3: and separating from his father - he seized them and went toward the Qiefaz region that is toward the West - and that attractive one's children were attractive like unto their mother,
19.4: and because of this thing Seth's children descended toward Cain's children - and after they saw them they did not wait one year - and of the daughters they chose wives for themselves.
19.5: As they have taken us toward error together with them because of their error - because of this thing YAH vexed upon us and vexed upon them,
19.6: and devils have cajoled them saying - 'you will become gods like unto your creator YAH' - he took our mother Eve and our father Adam toward his error.
19.7: But it seemed Truth to them in their dullness - they broke YAH'S LAW - He Who created them bringing from not living toward living that they might bow and praise His glorified Name.
19.8: But He - their creator - debased the godhood Adam and Eve made for themselves - and He debased him who is arrogant.
19.9: Like as unto David spoke saying - 'Adam perished by the sinner devil's arrogance' - He abused them - for our father Adam has been convicted upon the devil's arrogance by His true judgment,
19.10: and Seth's children who erred by Cain's children took us toward their sin thus - because of this thing our years that YAH gave us was less than our father's years.
19.11: But they had worked goodly Work - for they had strengthened their hearts in YAH - for they had taught their daughters and their sons lest they depart from YAH'S LAW which they taught them - and there was no evil enemy who approached them.
19.12: But if they worked goodly Work - there was nothing that would benefit them if they did not tell nor teach it to their children.
19.13: Like as unto David spoke saying - 'They did not hide from their children to another child - and teach YAH'S praise - the wondrous miracles He did - and His Power' - there is nothing that benefits them if they did not teach to their children that they might teach to their children to make hearts like unto as they knew - and that they might know and do His Accord - and that they might tell them to trust in YAH'S LAW - and that they might keep His LAW like unto their fathers who made YAH Irie with their beautiful Work,
19.14: and they who were told the Trust from their fathers in their infancy did not transgress His Command - like as unto their fathers learned YAH'S Worship and the Ten Laws from their fathers.
19.15: Their children learned from their fathers that they might work goodly Work and might present praise to their creator - for they have kept His LAW - and for they have loved Him,
19.16: and He shall hear them in their prayer - and He will not ignore their plea - but He is a Forgiver,
19.17: having multiplied His wrath - He shall return it to them - and He would not destroy all in His chastisement.

20.1: My brethren - think - do not forget what they told you formerly - that YAH keeps the true Work of persons who work goodly Work,
20.2: and He multiplies their children in this world - and the speaking of their name shall live established as a goodly thing up until eternity - and their children will not be troubled for bread in this world.
20.3: As He shall contend for them because of them - and as He will not cast them in their enemy's hand - He shall save them from their enemy's hand who hates them,
20.4: and for persons who love His Name - He shall be their Helper in their tribulation time - He shall guard them and pardon them all their sin.

21.1: David believed in YAH - for He has believed in him - and He saved him being a Refuge from the hand of king Saul,
21.2: and as David has believed in Him and kept His LAW from the time when his child Absalom arose - and from the time when the Philistines arose - and from the time when the Edomites and the Amalekites arose - from the time when the one from the four giant Rephaim arose - YAH saved David from all this tribulation that the enemies who disputed with him brought upon him.
21.3: As prevailing is by YAH'S Accord - they were defeated by their enemy's hand - but YAH did not save the evil kings who did not believe in Him.
21.4: And Hezekiah believed in YAH - He saved him from Sennacherib's hand who was arrogant.
21.5: But his child Manasseh was defeated by his enemy's hand - for he did not put his trust in YAH - as he did not put his trust in YAH and as he did not fear YAH Who fully honoured and famed him - they bound and took him toward their country - and yet those enemies who defeated Manasseh were not like unto him.
21.6: At that time He denied him the kingdom He gave him - for he did not work goodly Work before his creator YAH - that his years might abound and that He might dispute his enemy for him and that he might have Power and authority behind and in front,
21.7: for it is better to believe in YAH than in many armies - than believing in horses and bows and shields,
21.8: believing in YAH surpasses - a person who believes in Him shall be established and be honoured and altogether lofty,
21.9: for YAH does not have respect of persons - but persons who do not believe in YAH - who believe in their personal abundance - became of them who depart from the grace and honour that He gives them.
21.10: He shall guard the persons who believe in Him - but He shall make the person ignorant who calls Him ignorant - and as they did not discipline their heart to follow YAH nor keep His LAW - He will not quickly help them in their tribulation time nor in the time their enemies dispute with them.
21.11: But for a person who was disciplined in worshipping YAH and to keeping His LAW - He shall be a Refuge in the tribulation time.
21.12: By destroying his enemy - and by plundering his enemy's livestock - and by capturing his enemy's country - and by raining the yearly rain - and by growing sprouts - and by introducing the grain pile and in the plant fruit,
21.13: and by raining the early and the spring rains - and by making the grass lush - and by giving the rain that rains when needed that thy kindreds beneath thy authority might be Irie - He shall make him Irie.
21.14: He shall make him Irie - that they might eat the enemy's possessions - that they might satiate having eaten the goods they plundered from their enemy - that they might plunder animals and sheeps and cows - and that they might eat at the other one's dinner table - and that they might take their enemy's children captive.
21.15: YAH shall do all this for the person whom He loves - but He will make the person who hates Him for his enemys to take away,
21.16: and He shall bind his feet and his hands and shall cast him in his enemy's hand - and He shall make him for his enemy's derision - and as he has become a blood shedder who demolished YAH'S LAW - He will not make him Irie in his generations,
21.17: and he will not stand in judgment time - and that He might bring the hardship to persons who work sin - He will also give persons who work evil Work hardship because of their sin.
21.18: But it was commanded from alongside YAH to give persons who work goodly Work their reward - that He might keep them in His authority,
21.19: for He is empowered upon all the creation He created that He might do goodly Work and might give them eternal welfare and that they might praise YAH Who created them - and He commanded that they might keep His LAW - apart from only man there are none from all the creations He created that departed from His Command.
21.20: Like as unto YAH commanded all who live strong in each of their Works - they all know and are kept in His LAW.
21.21: But man is emboldened upon YAH Who crowned all upon each of their inventions - upon animals and beasts and upon Heaven birds.
21.22: Be it what is in sea or all upon land - YAH gave all the creation He created to their father Adam - YAH gave them that he might do what he loved - and that they might eat them like unto grain that grew upon Earth - and that they might rule and toil with them - and that be they beasts or animals they might be commanded to man - and He appointed them upon all He created that persons who reigned might be commanded to YAH Who gave them honour and that they might favour Him.
21.23: But if they depart from His LAW He will separate them from the lordship He gave them - as He is Who rules Earth and Heaven - He will give it to him who does His Accord.
21.24: He appoints whom He desires to appoint - but He dismisses whom He desires to dismiss - He kills - He saves - He chastises in tribulation - He forgives.
21.25: There is no other creator like as unto Him - as He is Ruler to all the creation He created - as there is no other without Him - the Creator - in Heaven above Earth nor upon Earth beneath Heaven - there is none who shall examine Him.
21.26: He appoints - He dismisses - He kills - He saves - He chastises in tribulation - He forgives - He impoverishes - He honours.
21.27: He hears persons who beg Him in their plea - He accepts a person's plea who does His Accord with a pure heart; and He hears them in their prayer - and He does their petition for them in all that they beg Him,
21.28: and He makes the great and the small to be commanded to them - all this is their reward upon the hills and mountains and at tree roots and in caves and Earth wells and all their kindreds upon both dry land and sea,
21.29: and for persons who do their creator's Accord all this is their reward - and He will not trouble them from their plenty - and He shall give them their reward in praise,
21.30: and He shall give them the honour He prepared in Heaven for their fathers Isaac and Abraham and Jacob - He shall give them what He prepared for Hezekiah and David and Samuel who did not depart from His LAW and His Command.
21.31: That they might be Irie in His Lordship - He shall give them who served Him beginning from Antiquity the honour He prepared for their fathers Isaac and Abraham and Jacob - to whom He swore to give them an inheritance.

22.1: Please - think on a person's name who works goodly Work - and do not forget their Work.
22.2: Straighten up that thy name be called like unto their name - that thou might be Irie with them in the Kingdom of Heaven - where Light abides that He prepared for nobles and kings who did YAH'S Accord and were righteous,
22.3: and again - know and be convicted of the name of evil nobles and kings - that He shall convict them and revile them alongside man after they die,
22.4: for they did not line up their Work while they saw and heard - and know and be convicted that unless they do YAH'S Accord - He shall judge upon them in the Kingdom of Heaven more than offenders and persons who forgot YAH'S LAW.
22.5: Be kindly - innocent - honest - yet do not thou also walk upon the path with the person who forgot YAH'S LAW - upon whom YAH has vexed because of their evil Work.
22.6: Judge Truth and save the orphan - and the widow from the sinner's hand who robs them.
22.7: Be a guardian like unto his father for the orphan child - that thou might save him from the wealthy one's hand who robs him - and stand for him - and be alarmed upon the time the orphan tears flow before thee - lest thou be alarmed in the sea of fire where sinners who did not enter repentance are punished,
22.8: and straighten up thy feet toward Love and the path of unity - as YAH'S Eyes behold His friends - and as His Ears hear their plea - seek Love and follow her.
22.9: But YAH's Face and His Wrath is toward persons who work evil Work - that He might destroy the invocation of their name from this world - and He will not preserve a person who is near upon ramparts nor high places.
22.10: As I am YAH Who is jealous upon My Godhood - as I am a creator who revenges and destroys persons who hate Me and do not keep My Word - I will not extend My Face of Support until I destroy the person who does not keep My Word,
22.11: and I shall honour persons who honour Me and keep My Word.

23.1: Do not live preserved in Cain's order - who killed his brother who followed him in innocence - it seeming to him that his brother loved him,
23.2: and he killed his brother envying upon his sister - persons who practice envy and iniquity and betrayal upon their companion are like unto Cain.
23.3: But as Abel was innocent like unto a sheep - and as his blood is like unto the clean sheep's blood that they sacrifice to YAH by a pure heart - they went upon Cain's path that is not upon Abel's path,
23.4: for because all the persons who live in innocence are persons whom YAH loves - like as unto the righteous man Abel - they have been innocent ones like as unto Abel - those persons who live secure in Abel's Work love YAH.
23.5: But YAH neglects evil ones - and their Definite judgment makes claim to them upon their bodies - and it is written upon the record of their heart - and upon the time when judgment is judged - they shall read her before man and Angels and before all the creation.
23.6: At that time they shall be shamed - wrongdoers and refusers who did not do YAH'S Accord shall be shamed,
23.7: and an alarming Word shall be given to them that says - Place them in Gehenna where is no exit up until eternity.

24.1: But upon the time Gideon trusted YAH - he defeated the uncircumcised army who were many many in array and tens of thousands and without number like unto the locusts.
24.2: As there is no creator without Me - O nobles and kings - do not believe in strange idols.
24.3: As I am your creator YAH Who sent you forth from your mother's wombs and raised you and fed you and clothed you - why do you feint? How about why do you worship other gods besides Me?
24.4: I did all this for you - what did you give Me? It is that you might live established in My LAW and My Order and My Command and that I might give you your body's welfare - yet what will I want from you?
24.5: YAH Who rules all said thus - He said - Save yourselves from worshipping idols and practising sorcery and discoursing with unclean spirits.
24.6: As YAH'S chastisement shall come upon these who do this - and upon them who hear them and do their accord and are their friends and who live according to their command - save yourselves from worshipping idols.
24.7: As peoples - who do not know you and are not beneficial to you - shall arise upon you - unless you who fear do YAH'S Accord - they will eat the wages wherefore you wearied - like unto His servants the prophets spoke and like as unto Enoch spoke and like as unto Asaph spoke - unless you do YAH'S Accord - they will eat the wages wherefore you wearied.
24.8: Evil persons will come having changed their clothes He said - there is no other law alongside them apart from eating and drinking and adorning in silver and gold - and living conducting sin - all the Work YAH does not love.
24.9: But they are prepared to go toward drink and food - after they were aroused from their slumber beginning from morning up until evening they go toward evil Work; there is misery and tribulation in their path - yet their feet do not Love the right path,
24.10: and they do not know Love and the Work of unity - and there is no fear of YAH in their faces - they are crooked evil ones without religion nor virtue - they are greedy ones who eat and drink alone - they are drunkards - and their sin is without LAW and without measure - they are who go toward seducing - shedding blood - theft and treachery and violently robbing of money from the poor,
24.11: and they are who criticise without Love and without LAW - for they do not fear YAH Who created them - and there is no fear in their faces.
24.12: They do not have shame in the person's face that they behold - and they do not have shame of a grey-hair nor an elder's face - upon the time they hear them say - 'and there is money in this world' - they make it their own money before they see it with their eyes - for there is no fear of YAH in their faces - and upon the time they see it with their eyes it seems to them that they deserve it,
24.13: and the nobles trust in money - they are who eat - as they are hypocrites and as there is no straight thing in their tongues - they do not repeat in the evening what they spoke in the morning,
24.14: for they ignore suffering and the cries of the poor - and their kings hasten to evil - they who provoke a person - he having saved refugees from the hands of wealthy ones who rob them,
24.15: let him save him who was wronged and the refugee - yet make the kings not begrudge justice because of this thing.
24.16: But they are who exact tribute - they are who rob a person's money - and they are law breakers - and as their Works are evil - they are not just when they eat the newborn calf with her mother and a bird with her eggs - they make all them behold and gather their own posessions.
24.17: They love that they might gather for themselves - yet they are not just to the sick and poor ones - and they violently rob the goods of a person who does not have it - and they gather all they found that they might be fattened and are Irie in it,
24.18: for they shall perish quickly like unto a scarab that proceeded from its pit and whose track is not found and that does not return toward its house - and because they did not work goodly Work when they are in their Life - woe to their bodies upon the time YAH vexes and seizes them,
24.19: upon the time YAH neglects them - they will perish at one time as they will be in one chastisement - for He endures there doings allowing them to return toward repentance - and yet He does not quickly destroy them - and they shall perish upon the time when they shall perish.
24.20: But if they do not return toward repentance - He will quickly destroy them like unto former persons who preceded them - who did not keep YAH'S LAW and give His due.
24.21: They are who eat a person's flesh and drink a person's blood - as they prepare and work violence to go toward sin - there is no fearing YAH in their faces ever - and after they arise from their bedding they do not rest to work sin,
24.22: and their Works are drink and food - going toward destruction and sin - that they might destroy many person's bodies in this world.

25.1: As their Works are crooked - and all them who live in satan's misleading Work - YAH Who rules all said - Woe to your body upon the time I vex and seize her.
25.2: But they that do not know YAH'S Work - for they have put it behind them - and they have neglected My LAW,
25.3: and later at the end of the age I shall bring the hardship upon them like as unto their evil measure deserves - like as unto their sin which is written alongside Me - I shall revenge and destroy them upon the day when judgment is judged.
25.4: As I YAH am full from horizon up until horizon - and as all the Creation has been placed under My authority - there are none who escape from My authority in Heaven nor Earth nor depth nor sea.
25.5: I command a snake that is beneath Earth - and I command a fish that is within the sea - and I command birds in Heaven - and I command the desert donkey in the wilderness - for it is all My posession beginning from horizon up until horizon.
25.6: As I am Who works wondrous Works and does miracles before Me - there are none who escape from My authority upon Earth nor in Heaven - there are none who tell Me - 'Where do Thou go? How about what do thou Work?'
25.7: And I command upon Angels and chiefs and hosts - all creation whose name is called are My possession - and beasts in the wilderness and all birds in Heaven and livestock are Mine.
25.8: An east wind arises and makes drought in the west - later in the age the Red Sea shall perish being shaken - arising from YAH - Who shall come toward her - being feared and in eminence,
25.9: for He rules them who have died and persons who remain - and she shall perish being shaken with Sheba and Noba and India and Ethiopia and all limits and all those regions,
25.10: and He watches all in lofty authority and incorruptibility - for His authority surpasses all the authority - and He keeps congregations in His authority,
25.11: and to Him authority belongs more than all other authority - and to Him the Kingdom surpasses all the other kingdoms - and His authority is what rules all the world - for He is able - and there is nothing that fails Him.
25.12: He rules all clouds in Heaven - He grows grass for livestock upon Earth - and He gives fruit upon the buds.
25.13: He feeds to all in each of the kinds like as unto He desires - He feeds all that He created by each of the fruits and each of the foods - and He feeds ants and locusts beneath Earth and livestocks upon Earth and beasts - and for a person who prayed He gives him his prayer - and He does not ignore the plea of the orphan - nor widows.
25.14: As evil person's rebellion is like unto a swirling wind and wrongdoer's council like unto misty fog - He shall rather accept the plea of them who beg toward Him always and clean ones,
25.15: and as their body is like unto a flying bird - and as their comeliness is like silver and gold which are perishable in this world - examination will come to persons who forgot YAH'S LAW yet not their gold - and moths shall eat their clothes,
25.16: and weevils shall destroy the wheat and the abundant barley - and all shall pass like unto the day that passed yesterday - and like unto a word that proceeded from a mouth does not return - the belongings of sinners also are like unto it - and their 'beautiful lifestyle' is like unto a passing shadow - a sinner's money before YAH is like unto a bloody rag.
25.17: But if kind persons are honoured YAH will not ignore them - for they have been honoured while they were kind to poor ones - and they hear justice of sufferers and orphans - YAH will not ignore them - for without neglecting their own children - they honour Him while they clothe the naked from the clothes YAH gave them that they might give to the suffering refugee.
25.18: They do not favour a loyal person's judgment - and they do not keep a hireling's salary - as YAH'S things are Truth and honour like unto a two-edged sword - they will not do iniquity in all their seasons and in their scales and balances.

26.1: But poor ones will reconsider upon their bedding - but if wealthy ones do not accept them - they will be like unto dry wood that has no moisture - and a root will not be fertile unless there is water - and the leaf will not be fertile if there is no root.
26.2: As a leaf serves a flower to be an ornament to fruit - unless the leaf were fertile it will not bear fruit - as man's fulfillment is belief - a person without belief has no virtue.
26.3: If he was strong in belief he worked virtue - and YAH is Irie by a person who works Truth and straight Work,
26.4: and for the person who implores Him - He shall give him his plea and the reward of his tongue - and He will not wrong the true person because of his true Work that he worked.
26.5: As YAH is true - and as He has loved a True thing - He will not justify the sinners without repentance because of the evil Works he worked - and as every person's souls has been captured in His authority because He it is Who rules Earth and Heaven - as He will not favour to the wealthy more than the poor in the time of judgment - He will not justify any without repentance.

27.1: He created having brought all the world from not living toward living - and He only prepared hills and mountains - and He made Earth upon the Water - and lest the sea be shaken He delineated her by sand - for in His first Word YAH has said let Light be created.
27.2: Light was created when this world had been covered in darkness - YAH created all the Creation - and He prepared this world - and He stabilized this world as a true possession that is owned - He said - let evening be dark,
27.3: and again YAH said let Light be created - it dawned and there was Light - and He elevated the upper Water toward Heaven,
27.4: and He stretched it forth like unto a tent - and He solidified it by a wind - and He placed the lower Water within the pit,
27.5: and He shut the sea locked in sand - and He balanced them in His authority lest they drown in Water - and He placed animals and beasts within her - and He placed within her Leviathan and Behemoth who were great beasts - and He placed within her beasts without number - seen and unseen,
27.6: upon the third day YAH created upon Earth plants - all the roots and woods and fruits that bear forth in each of their kinds - and the good Garden for them to behold,
27.7: and He created the good Garden that was both beautiful for them to behold and sweet for them to eat - and He created grass - and all plants whose seeds are found from within them - to be food for birds and livestocks and beasts.
27.8: It dusked - it dawned - and upon the fourth day He said - let Light be created in Heaven called cosmos - YAH having created moon and sun and stars - He placed them in Heaven called cosmos that they might shine in this world and that they might provide them daylight and night,
27.9: and after this the moon and sun and stars alternated in night and daylight,
27.10: and upon the fifth day YAH created all animals and beasts that live within Water and all birds that fly upon Heaven - all that are seen and unseen - all this,
27.11: and upon the sixth day He created livestocks and beasts and others - and having created and prepared all - He created Adam in His Example and His Image.
27.12: He gave him all the animals and beasts He created that he might reign over them - and again - all animals and beasts and all fishes - and Leviathan and Behemoth that are in the sea,
27.13: and He gave him all cows that live in this world and sheeps - the animals unseen and them that are seen,
27.14: and He placed in the Garden Adam whom He created in His Example and His Image - that he might eat and might cultivate the plants and might praise YAH there,
27.15: and lest he demolish His Command - He has said - upon the time when you eat from this Herb of Fig you will die the death,
27.16: and He commanded him lest he eat from the Herb of Fig that brings death - that draws attention to evil and good - that brings death,
27.17: my mother Eve was cajoled by a misleading snake and she ate from that Herb of Fig and gave it to my father Adam,
27.18: and Adam having eaten from that Herb of Fig brought death upon his children and upon himself.
27.19: As he has demolished His Command - and as he has eaten from that Herb of Fig that YAH commanded saying - do not eat from her - YAH vexed upon my father Adam and expelled and sent him away from the Garden - and He gave him that Earth that grows thistle and thorn - that He cursed because of him upon the time he demolished His Command - that he might eat the reward of his weariness having toiled and laboured that he might till her,
27.20: and upon the time YAH sent him forth toward this land - Adam returned toward complete sadness - and having toiled and laboured that he might till the Earth - he began to eat in weariness and also in struggles.

28.1: And after his children lived having abounded - there were from them ones who praised and honoured YAH and did not demolish His Command.
28.2: There were prophets who spoke what was done and what will be done henceforth - and from his children there were sinners who speak lies and who wrong persons - Adam's firstborn child Cain became evil and killed his brother Abel.
28.3: YAH judged judgment upon Cain because he killed his brother Abel - and YAH vexed the Earth because she drank his blood,
28.4: and YAH told Cain - Where is thy brother Abel? - and Cain in his heart's arrogance said - 'Am I my brother Abel's keeper?'
28.5: Abel became a clean man - but Cain became a sinning man by killing the kind man - his brother Abel.
28.6: Again a kind child Seth was birthed - Adam birthed sixty children - there are kind persons and evil persons from them,
28.7: and there are kind persons from them - and there are persons who were prophets and them who were traitors and sinners.
28.8: There are blessed persons who were righteous - who fulfilled their father Adam's accord and all he taught to his child Seth - beginning from Adam up until Noah who is righteous and who kept YAH'S LAW,
28.9: and he sanctioned YAH'S LAW to his children - he told them - 'Guard' - lest they demolish YAH'S LAW - and that they might teach to their children like as unto their father Noah taught them - and that they might keep YAH'S LAW,
28.10: and they lived while they taught their children - future generations after them.
28.11: But satan lived when he spoke to their fathers - having lodged in idols that reached to the grave and that have oaths upon them - and having defeated the persons who consented - and when they did all that satan - who is the teacher of sin - commanded them,
28.12: and they lived when they worshipped the idols like unto their order - up until a righteous man Abraham who fulfilled YAH'S Accord,
28.13: for he had lived established in the LAW beforehand separated from his brethren - and YAH swore an oath with him - having lodged in wind and fire.
28.14: YAH swore to him that He might give him a land of inheritance and that He might give to him children up until eternity,
28.15: and He swore to Isaac like unto him that He might give him his father Abraham's inheritance - and He swore to Jacob that He might give him his father Isaac's inheritance - He swore to him like unto Isaac,
28.16: and He separated their children - who were birthed after them from Jacob - from the twelve tribes of Israel - and made them priests and kings - He blessed them saying - Be blessed and be like the sand of the sea,
28.17: and He gave them their father's inheritance - however while He fed them and loved them - they did not quit disappointing YAH in all things,
28.18: and upon the time when He destroyed them - at that time they would seek Him in worship - and they would return from sin and go toward YAH - for He loves them - and YAH did pardon them,
28.19: for being good to all He created - He did pardon them - and it is because of their father's Work that He loves them - and it is not because of their own Work,
28.20: and He stretches forth His Right Hand in plenty that He might satiate a hungry body - and He reveals His Eye for pardoning that He might multiply grain for food.
28.21: He gives food for crow's chicks and for beasts that beg Him - upon the time they cry toward Him - He will save Israel's children from the hand of their enemys who waited for the time,
28.22: and they will return toward sin again that they might sadden Him - and He will arouse their enemys in their regions upon them - they will destroy them and kill them and capture them,
28.23: and again they will shout toward YAH in mourning and sadness - and there is the time when He sends help and saves them by the hands of the prophets,
28.24: and there is the time when He saves them by prince's hands - and upon the time they saddened YAH their enemies taxed them and captured them,
28.25: and David arose and saved them from the hands of the Philistines; and again they saddened YAH - and YAH aroused upon them peoples to worry them,
28.26: and there is the time when He saved them by Jepthah's hand - and again they forgot YAH Who saved them in the time of their tribulation. As YAH has brought the hardship upon them - He will arouse upon them enemies who are evil who will bring tribulation upon them and utterly capture them,
28.27: and upon the time they were worried by tribulation they were captured and again cried toward Him - and He saved them by Gideon's hand - and again they saddened YAH by their handiwork,
28.28: and again He aroused upon them peoples who brought tribulation upon them - and they returned and wept and cried toward YAH,
28.29: and again He saved them from peoples by Samson's hand - and they rested a little from the tribulation and they arose that they might sadden YAH by their former sin,
28.30: and again He aroused upon them other peoples to worry them - and again they cried and wept toward YAH that He might send help to them - and He saved them from peoples by Barak's and Deborah's hands.
28.31: Again their lived a little season while they worshipped YAH - and again they forgot YAH in their former sin and saddened Him,
28.32: and He aroused upon them other peoples to worry them - and again He saved them by Judith's hand; and having sat again a little season they arose that they might sadden YAH by their sin like as unto formerly,
28.33: and He aroused upon them peoples to rule them - and they cried and wept toward YAH; for He has struck upon his head Abimelech who was a warrior who came that he might fight in Judah's country,
28.34: and He saved them by the children in the area and by Matthias' hand - and upon the time that warrior died his army fled and were scattered - and Israel's children followed and fought them up until Jabbok - and they did not preserve even one person from among them.
28.35: After this they waited a little and arose that they might sadden YAH - and He aroused upon them peoples who ruled them - and again they totally cried toward YAH; and YAH ignored their crying and their mourning - for they had saddened YAH everytime - and for they had demolished His LAW,
28.36: and they captured and took them with their priests toward the country of Babylon,
28.37: and then Israel's children who were traitors did not quit saddening YAH while they worked sin and worshipped idols.
28.38: YAH vexed that He might destroy them one time in their sin - Haman having introduced ten thousand of gold in the king's box - upon the day when it was known - he sowed anger in the king Ahasuerus' reasoning - lest he preserve their children in the Persian country beginning from India and up until Ethiopia upon the time he told him that he might destroy them.
28.39: He did thus - and he wrote a letter where a message was written by the king's authority - and he gave him a seal in his hand that he might deliver toward the Persian country.
28.40: He gave him a seal that he might destroy them all one day when he desired to destroy them like as unto the king commanded - but he commanded that he might reward them with money - the gold and the silver - toward the king's box,
28.41: and upon the time Israel's children heard this thing they wholeheartedly cried and wept toward YAH - and they told it to Mordecai - and Mordecai told it to Esther,
28.42: and Esther said - 'Fast - beg - and all you children of Israel - cry toward YAH in the place where you are.'
28.43: And Mordecai wore sackcloth and sprinkled dust upon himself - and Israel's children fasted - begged - and entered into repentance in the country where they were,
28.44: and Esther was perfectly sad - and being a queen she wore sackcloth - she sprinkled dust and shaved her head - and she did not anoint perfume like as unto Persian queens anoint perfume - and in her deepest heart she cried and wept toward her father's creator YAH,
28.45: and because of this thing He gave her favour alongside the Persian king Ahasuerus - and she made a feast for her father's creator,
28.46: and Haman and the king entered toward the banquet that Esther prepared - and like as unto he desired that he might do unto Mordecai - YAH paid the hardship upon that Haman - and they hanged him upon a tall gallows.
28.47: The king's letter was commanded that they might not harm Israel like as unto they were commanded at the first - and lest they tax them nor rob them nor wrong them nor take their possessions from them.
28.48: And YAH shall pardon Israel doing thus upon the time they enter repentance - it is so that they might love them and honour them in the Persian country where they lived - yet a king's letter was commanded lest they destroy their country nor plunder their livestock,
28.49: and upon the time they sadden Him - He will arouse upon them peoples to worry them - at that time they will weep and cry that He might send help for them and that He might save them from the hands of those who bring tribulation upon them.

29.1: And upon the time the Egyptians also made the children of Israel work by making them work bricks in bondage - and upon the time they added to their Work by removing mud and straw and heating bricks,
29.2: and upon the time they made them work having appointed chiefs upon them who hurried the workers - they cried toward YAH that He might save them from working all of Egypt's bricks.
29.3: At that time He sent for them Aaron and Moses who helped them - for YAH had sent them that they might send forth His kindreds from the rulership of Pharaoh's house - and He saved them from brick Work - because in his arrogance he refused to let Israel go lest they be ruled and offer sacrifice to YAH in the wilderness - YAH has sent them that they might send forth His kindreds Israel from Egypt's king Pharaoh's rulership - and they saved them,
29.4: for YAH neglects arrogant ones - and He drowned Pharaoh in the Red Sea with his army because of his arrogance,
29.5: and like unto him - He shall destroy them who do not work goodly Work in all the kingdoms where He appointed and crowned them - that they who ignore YAH'S Word when they are nobles and kings might fulfill His Accord for Him - and that they might give persons who serve in goodly things their wages - and that they might honour His exalted Name.
29.6: YAH Who rules all said - But if they will straighten up My Kingdom - I will straighten up their kingdom for them.
29.7: Work goodly Work for Me - and I shall work goodly Work for you - keep My LAW - and I shall keep you your bodies - live steady in My LAW - and I shall live in you with truth in your heart.
29.8: Love Me - and I shall love your well-being - be near to Me - and I shall heal you.
29.9: YAH Who rules all said - Believe in Me - and I shall save you from the tribulation,
29.10: do not live divided - as YAH Who rules all loves honest Work - He said - you - approach toward Me - and I shall approach toward you - you persons who are sinners and traitors - cleanse your hands from sin - and distance your heart from evil,
29.11: and I shall distance My anger from you - and I shall return to you in Charity and Forgiveness.
29.12: I shall distance law breakers and enemies who would work iniquity on you - like as unto I saved My servant David from his enemies who met him - from their much malice - and from Goliath's hand who was a warrior - and also from Saul's hand who sought that he might kill him - and from his child Absalom's hand who desired that he might take his kingdom.
29.13: I shall save persons who keep My LAW and fulfill My Accord like unto David - I shall bequeath them honour - and they shall be Irie in the present world and yonder in the world that shall come - I shall crown them upon all that they might be Irie.
29.14: They shall be one with kings who served YAH and were honoured in their beautiful way of Life - like as unto the prophet Samuel served Him in his beautiful way of Life beginning from his infancy - whom YAH - Him being LAW - chose.
29.15: He told him that he might tell Eli who was a servant elder - and when he served in YAH'S tabernacle, the Temple - Samuel's Work also was merciful and loved,
29.16: and upon the time he grew when he served in YAH'S tabernacle, the Temple - He made him to be appointed and anointed - that he might appoint him people and that kings might be anointed by YAH'S Accord. As YAH has loved him that the kindred he chose from Israel's children might be appointed - upon the time he fulfilled YAH'S Accord Who created him - He gave him the anointing of the Kingdom in his hand,
29.17: and when Saul was in his kingdom YAH told His prophet Samuel - Go - and as I have loved Jesse's child David who was birthed from Judah's kin - anoint him.

30.1: I have hated Saul's kin - for he has saddened Me because he violated My Word,
30.2: and I neglected him - for he did not keep My LAW - and I will not crown from his kin again,
30.3: and persons who do not keep My LAW and My Word and My Order like unto him - I shall destroy My Kingdom and My gift from their children up until eternity,
30.4: and as they did not make Me honoured upon the time I made them honoured - I shall destroy them - yet I will not again return to lift them up - though I honour them - as they did not honour Me - I will not make them famous,
30.5: for they did not do a goodly thing to Me upon the time I did a goodly thing to them - and for they did not forgive Me upon the time I forgave them,
30.6: and as they did not make Me a Ruler upon the time I made them rulers upon all - as they did not honour Me upon the time I honoured them more than all - I will not make them exalted again nor honour them - and for they did not keep My LAW,
30.7: and I withheld the gift I gave them - and I will not return the blessing I withheld from them like unto the measure I vexed and swore - YAH Who rules all said thus - He said - I shall honour them who honour Me - and love them who love Me.
30.8: I shall separate them who do not honour Me nor keep My LAW from the blessing I will give them.
30.9: YAH Who rules all said; I love them who love Me - and exalt him who exalts Me - He said.
30.10: As I YAH am Who rules all - there are none who escape My authority in Earth nor in Heaven - for I am YAH Who kills and Who saves and Who saddens and Who forgives.
30.11: As fame and honour are My reward - I honour him whom I love - for I am Who judges and Who revenges and destroys - and I make wretched him whom I hate,
30.12: for I am Who forgives them who love Me and call My Name continually - for I am Who feeds food to the wealthy and to the poor,
30.13: and I feed birds and animals - fishes in the sea and beasts and flowers - I am not Who feeds only man.
30.14: I feed crocodiles and whales - gophers and hippos - and badgers,
30.15: and all that live within Water - all that fly upon wind - I am not Who feeds only man - all this is Mine.
30.16: I am Who feeds all that seek Me by all that is due and proper.

31.1: And the kings do not reign without My Accord - and the lowly are by My Command - yet they are not poor without My Command - and powerful ones are by My Accord - yet they are not strong without My Accord.
31.2: I gave My Love to David and Wisdom to Solomon - and I added years to Hezekiah.
31.3: I diminished Goliath's time - and I gave Power to Samson - and again I weakened his Power,
31.4: and I saved My servant David from Goliath's hand who was a warrior,
31.5: and again I saved him from king Saul's hand and from the second warrior who quarreled with him - and for he has kept My Command - and I saved him from the person's hand who contends and fights him,
31.6: and I loved him - and I love all the nobles and the kings who keep My LAW - as they have made Me Irie - I shall give them dominance and Power upon their enemies,
31.7: and again that they might inherit their father's land - I shall give them the cleansed and shining land of inheritance that I swore to their fathers.

32.1: YAH Who rules all said - and you the nobles and also the kings - hear Me in My Word - and keep My Command - lest you sadden Me and worship like as the children of Israel saddened Me and worshipped strange idols - they whom I kept and saved when I YAH am their creator - YAH Who rules all said - Hear Me in My Word; and all whom I raised and loved and fed beginning from their infancy,
32.2: and whom I sent forth toward Earth's bounty - and whom I fed the fatness found from the Earth giving them plenty - and whom I gave the grape vine and the oil-tree fruit that they did not plant and the clear Water well that they did not dig.
32.3: Hear Me in My Word lest you sadden Me like as unto the children of Israel saddened Me worshipping other gods when I YAH am their creator - He told them - Who fed them the sheep's milk and the honeycomb with the hulled wheat - and Who clothed their clothes with ornamants - and Who gave them all His love,
32.4: and without receiving it from them - I deprived them all they begged Me.

33.1: Like as unto David spoke saying - 'The children of Israel were fed manna that the Angels dropped' - and again hear Me in My Word lest you sadden Me like unto the children of Israel saddened Me worshipping the idols when I am their creator YAH Who fed them sweet manna in the wilderness - He said - I did all this for them that them might worship Me by what is proper and in truth.
33.2: YAH Who rules all said - But they did not worship Me - so I neglected them - they saddened Me and lived in the law of gods that was not My LAW,
33.3: and I shall bring the hardship due upon them like as unto their sin - as they have neglected My Worship and as they did not stand in My counsel and My Order - I neglected them in the sin without measure that they worked by their hands - and I shall lower them toward Gehenna in Definite judgment which is done in Heaven,
33.4: for they did not keep My LAW - and so I will afflict them - and I shall diminish their time in this world.
33.5: If thou be a king - are not thou a man who shall die and be destroyed and tomorrow who shall be worms and dust?
33.6: But today thou boast and are proud like unto a man who will live forever.
33.7: YAH Who rules all said - But thou who seem being well today is the man who will die tomorrow.
33.8: But if you keep My Command and My Word - I shall bequeath thee an honoured country with honoured kings who did My Accord - whose lodgings are Light and whose crowns are beautiful - and whose thrones are silver and gold and whom persons who sit upon them are adorned - He said,
33.9: and they shall be Irie within His country which is a place that is near to persons who worked goodly Work.
33.10: But for persons who work sin - as they did not keep My LAW - said YAH Who rules all,
33.11: it is not merited that they might enter toward that country where honoured kings shall enter.

34.1: Median's kingdom shall perish - but Rome's kingdom shall prevail over Macedonia's kingdom - and Nineveh's kingdom shall prevail over Persia's kingdom,
34.2: and Ethiopia's kingdom shall prevail over 'Iskindriya's kingdom - as peoples shall arise - Moab's kingdom shall prevail over the Amalekites' kingdom,
34.3: and brother shall arise upon his brother - and YAH shall revenge and destroy like as unto He spoke that it might perish.
34.4: Kingdom shall arise upon kingdom - and people upon people and country upon country - He said,
34.5: and divisions shall be made and there shall be destruction - famine - plague - earthquake - drought - as Love has perished from this world - YAH'S chastisement descended upon her,
34.6: for the day has arrived suddenly when YAH shall come - Who frightens like unto lightning that is beheld from the East up until the West,
34.7: upon the day when HIM YAH judges judgment - at that time everyone shall receive his hardship like as unto the weakness of his hand and the strength of his sin - for He has said I shall revenge them upon the day when HIM YAH judges judgment and upon the day when there is no escape - for the day when they are accounted to destruction has arrived.
34.8: At that time YAH shall destroy in Gehenna forever persons who will not live in His LAW - who work sin,
34.9: and them who live in the Islands of the West and Noba and India - Sheba and Ethiopia and Egypt - all persons who live in them,
34.10: at that time they shall know Me that I am YAH Who rules Earth and Heaven - and Who gives to souls My love and honour - and Who saves and Who kills.
34.11: I am Who sends forth the sun - Who sends it toward its setting - Who brings the evil and the good.
34.12: I am Who bring peoples whom you do not know - who slaughter and consume the possessions whereby you are wearied - your flocks of sheep and your cows,
34.13: and they shall capture your children while they smite them before you - and you cannot save them because YAH'S Spirit of Support does not lodge in you - as you did not fear YAH'S Command that you heard - He shall destroy your lavishments and your allotment.
34.14: But a person in whom YAH'S Spirit of Support lodges will know all - like as unto Nebuchadnezzar told Daniel saying - 'I am seen by YAH'S Spirit of Support that lodges in me.'
34.15: And a person in whom YAH'S Spirit of Support lodges will know all - and what is hidden will be revealed to him - and he will know all that was revealed and that was hidden - yet there is nothing hidden from a person in whom YAH'S Spirit of Support dwells.
34.16: But as I am a person who will die tomorrow - my sins that I hid and worked shall be revealed,
34.17: and like as they test silver and gold in the fire - like as there are sinners - later upon the Day of Advent they shall be examined - for they did not keep YAH'S Command.
34.18: At that time all peoples and all Work from the children of Israel shall be examined.

35.1: As YAH afflicts you because you did not judge a True judgment for the orphan child - woe to you Israel's nobles.
35.2: Woe to you persons who go toward a drinking house morning and evening and get drunk - who are partial in judgment - and who do not hear the widow's justice nor the orphan's - who live in sin and seducing.
35.3: YAH told Israel's nobles saying thus - Unless you live in My Command and keep My LAW and love what I love - woe to you - He told them,
35.4: and I shall bring destruction and chastisement and tribulation upon you - and you will perish like unto what beetles and moths eat - and your tracks and your place will not be found - He told them,
35.5: and your country will be a wilderness - and all persons who beheld her formerly shall clap their hands - they shall marvel upon her while they say - 'Was not this country filled of her plenty and all desired of it?; YAH made her thus by the sins of persons who live in her.'
35.6: They shall say - 'As she has made her heart proud - and as she has elevated herself - and as she has stiffened her neck YAH has made her wretched upon Earth - and as she shall be a desert by the arrogance of the persons who live in her - and as thorns have grown upon her with thistles - woe to her.'
35.7: And she grows weeds and nettles - and she became a wilderness and a desert - and beasts shall live within her,
35.8: for YAH'S judgment has settled upon her - and for she shall receive YAH'S judgment Chalice because of her heart's arrogance by sinful persons who live in her - and she became a terror for persons who go toward her.

36.1: Persons of Midian - do not boast - as YAH is there Who shall destroy you - Amalekites - do not stiffen your neck,
36.2: for you will be lofty up until Heaven and you will descend up until Gehenna,
36.3: upon the time Israel formerly entered toward the land of Egypt and Moab and Midian's kingdom He said - do not boast - for it is not due to profess upon YAH that you might be deceitful toward Him.
36.4: Thou Ishmael's kindred - servant child - why do thou set thy heart upon what is not thy inheritance? How about do not thou think that YAH shall judge thee upon the time He arises that the Earth might be judged - upon the day when it is judged upon thee?
36.5: YAH Who rules all said - At that time thou will receive thy hardship like unto thy handiwork - how about why do thou proclaim thy innocence? How about why do thou stiffen thy neck?
36.6: And I shall act upon thee like as unto thou acted upon persons who were not thy kindreds - for thou do what thou love that thou might work sin - and I shall neglect thee in the place where they sent thee.
36.7: YAH Who rules all said - and I shall do thus upon thee - He said - But if thou work goodly Work and if thou love what I love - I also shall hear thee in all that thou entreat,
36.8: and if thou fulfill My Accord for Me - I shall fulfill thy accord for thee - and I shall disturb thy enemies for thee - and I shall bless thy children and thy seed for thee,
36.9: and I shall multiply thy flocks of sheep and thy cows for thee - and if thou live thoroughly in My Command and also if thou do what I love - YAH Who rules all said - I shall bless thee with all thou have in thy hand.
36.10: But if thou do not do My Accord - if thou do not live firmed up in My LAW and My Command - all this tribulation that was told formerly shall find thee - for thou did not endure tribulation resolutely in My Command - and for thou did not live thoroughly in My LAW - and thou cannot escape from My anger that will come upon thee continually,
36.11: and as thou did not love what I loved - when I am Who created thee bringing from not living toward living,
36.12: all this was thine - that thou might kill and heal to do all that thou loved - that thou might build and destroy - that thou might honour and abase - that thou might elevate and debase - and as thou have neglected My Worship and My praise when I am Who gave thee lordship and also honour alongside persons who are beneath thy authority - thou cannot escape from My anger that will come upon thee,
36.13: and if thou do YAH'S Accord and if thou live in His Commands - He will love thee that thou might be Irie with Him in His Lordship - and that thou might be a partaker with persons who inherit the honoured country,
36.14: for He has said - If they abide in Me - I will bequeath them blessing and honour - for I shall make them Irie in the Temple where prayer is prayed - for YAH Who rules all has said - and they shall be loved and chosen like unto a sacrifice,
36.15: do not neglect to do Work whereby benefit is done and a goodly thing that you might cross from death toward Life.
36.16: But persons who work goodly Work - YAH shall keep them in all His goodly Work - that they might be His servants like unto Job whom YAH kept from the tribulation.
36.17: YAH shall keep them in all goodly Work - that they might be His servants to Him like as Abraham whom He saved upon the time he killed the kings - and like unto Moses whom He saved from Canaanite hands and Pharaoh's hand - with whom Abraham lived - and who was also irritating his body evening and morning night and day that they might make Abraham worship idols.
36.18: But when they took him toward the idols that were their dominion - he would endure the tribulation while he refused,
36.19: for Abraham who believed Him beginning from his childhood was for YAH His trusted friend - and while he refused he would worship YAH Who created him.
36.20: As he fully loves YAH - he did not quit worshipping YAH up until he died - and he did not depart from His LAW up until when he died - and he taught his children that they might keep YAH'S LAW,
36.21: and like their father Abraham kept His LAW - they did not depart from YAH'S LAW - like He told to His Angels saying - I have a friend in this world called Abraham - Abraham's children Jacob and Isaac - who are His servants of whom YAH spoke - did not depart from YAH'S LAW.
36.22: YAH Who was praised alongside them and Who rules all said - Abraham is My friend - Isaac is My confidant - and Jacob is My friend whom My heart loves.
36.23: But when He loved the children of Israel - they lived and they continually saddened Him - and He lived and He endured them and He fed them manna in the wilderness.
36.24: Their clothes did not age - for they had been fed manna that is knowledge 'injera - and their feet did not swell.
36.25: But their hearts would distance them from YAH all the time - as they were those who work sin beginning from Antiquity - they had no hope to be saved.
36.26: They became like unto a crooked bow - they did not become like unto their fathers Isaac and Abraham and Jacob who served YAH in their beautiful way of Life - they would constantly sadden Him by their idols upon the high places - they would eat upon the high places and at the caves and the groves.
36.27: They would slaughter a steer - they would offer a sacrifice - and they would be Irie in their handiwork - they would eat the rest of the sacrifice - they would drink the blood of their sacrifice - and they would play with demons while they sang,
36.28: and demons would admire all their games and their songs to them - and they would work their drunkenness and adultery without measure - and they would do the robbery and greed that YAH does not love,
36.29: for Canaan's idols - and for Midian's idols and for Baal - and for Asherah and Dagon and Seraphyon and Artimedes who are Greek idols,
36.30: and for all people's idols in their area - they would offer sacrifice; and all Israel would worship idols like as unto people worship idols with treasure that they see and hear - they would make the games and songs and bluster that people make.
36.31: All Israel's kindreds do likewise - who say 'we will worship YAH' - without keeping His Command and His LAW that Moses told them in Horeb that they might keep YAH'S LAW and might distance themselves from worshipping idols.
36.32: Lest they worship strange gods - apart from their father's creator Who fed them the honey found from manna - who fed them the plantation grain and sent them forth toward the Earth's bounty - and Who fed them the manna.
36.33: Moses commanded them saying 'do not worship' - for He is the creator - and He feeds them who loved Him - and He will not deprive them who loved Him and desired Him.
36.34: But they did not quit saddening YAH - and they would sadden YAH upon the time He made them Irie,
36.35: and upon the time He saddened them - they would cry toward Him - and He would save them from the tribulation that found them - and they would again be totally Irie and would live many years,
36.36: and at that time they would totally return their heart toward sin that they might sadden YAH like unto formerly - and He would arouse upon them peoples in their area that they might destroy them - and they would worry and tax them,
36.37: and again they would truly return and cry toward their creator YAH,
36.38: and He would forgive them - it is because of their fathers - Noah - Isaac and Abraham and Jacob - who served YAH in their beautiful way of Life beginning from Antiquity - to whom He gave up His Oath - yet it is not because of their own Work that He forgave them,
36.39: and He loved persons who kept His LAW loving that they might multiply their children like as unto the stars of Heaven and the sand of the sea.
36.40: But upon the time the dead will arise that are like unto the sand of the sea - they are sinner's souls that will separate from Israel's children and enter toward Gehenna.
36.41: As YAH has told Abraham - Behold toward Heaven at night and count the stars of Heaven if thou could count - likewise as He has told him - Thy children and righteous ones shall shine in Heaven like unto the stars of Heaven - they are like unto stars that shine in Heaven - what they have are righteous person's souls birthed from Israel,
36.42: and again as He has told him - Overstand toward the river's edge and the sea - and behold what is amidst the sand - count it if thou could count - and thy sinner children are likewise - who will descend toward Gehenna upon the time dead ones arise - they are sinner's souls,
36.43: and Abraham believed in YAH - because of this thing it was counted to him being Truth - he found his assurance in this world - and after his wife Sarah aged she birthed a child called Isaac,
36.44: for he has believed that persons who work goodly Work shall arise and go toward the Kingdom of Heaven and live forever - and again he shall find the Kingdom in Heaven.
36.45: But to him he believed that persons who work sin shall go toward Gehenna that live forever upon the time dead ones arise - but that righteous ones who work goodly Work shall reign with Him forever.
36.46: But to him he has believed that it shall be judged forever in truth without falsehood upon persons who work sin - for he shall find Life's Kingdom in Heaven." Give Glory and praise due to YAH the True without falsehood - and the first book that speaks the words of Meqabyan is filled and fulfilled.

1.1: This is a book that describes how Meqabis met with Israel from Mesopotamia Syria and killed them in their region beginning from Jabbok up until Jerusalem - and that he destroyed the country,
1.2: because the persons of Syria and Edom and the Amalekites were one with the Moabite man Meqabis who destroyed the country of Jerusalem - as they camped beginning from Samaria up until Jerusalem and within all her regions - they killed in war only preserving a very few persons who fled,
1.3: and upon the time Israel's children wronged YAH - He aroused the Moabite man Meqabis upon them - and he killed them by a sword,
1.4: and because of this thing YAH'S enemies boasted upon His honoured country - and they blasphemed in their crime,
1.5: and the Ishmaelites and Idumeans camped - as He has sent them because Israel mocked YAH'S Word - they began to revenge and destroy YAH'S country,
1.6: and that Meqabis' country is Ramoth which is part of Moab - and he arose from his country in Power and they pledged also other persons with him,
1.7: and they camped in the Gilboa region that is in Mesopotamia's lot up until Syria that they might destroy YAH'S country - and there he besought the Amalekites and Philistines - he gave them much silver and gold and chariots and horses that they might be one with him in this trespass.
1.8: They came together and crushed the fortress - persons who lived in her shed their blood like unto Water,
1.9: and they made Jerusalem like unto a grain store - and he made a voice heard within her - he worked all the sin Work that YAH does not love - and they also defiled YAH'S country that was filled of praise and honour.
1.10: They gave the flesh of thy neighbour and the body of thy servant as food for the beasts of the wilderness and the birds of Heaven,
1.11: and they robbed the orphans and widows - for without fearing YAH they have done like as unto satan taught them - and as YAH afflicted them Who examines the kidneys and hearts - they even took the fetus out of the pregnant daughter's belly.
1.12: They returned toward their country while they were Irie because they worked evil Work upon YAH's kindreds - and they took the plunder that they captured from the honoured country,
1.13: upon the time they returned and entered toward their houses they made Ites and song and clapping.

2.1: The prophet whom they call Re`ay told him thus: - "Today be Irie a little upon the time when Irie Ites were made - YAH Whom Israel glorified has said that He might revenge and destroy thee in the chastisement - thou who does not doubt.
2.2: Will thou say - 'My horses are swift - because of this I will escape by fleeing'?
2.3: As for me - I tell thee - Those who will follow thee are swifter than eagles - thou will not escape from YAH'S judgment and the destruction that shall come upon thee.
2.4: Will thou say - 'I wear iron clothes - and spear flinging and bow stinging will protect me'?; YAH Who honours Israel said - It is not by spear flinging that I will revenge and destroy thee" He told him - "I shall bring upon thee sickness of heart and sores and rheumatism - sickness that is worse and rougher than spear flinging and bow stinging - yet it is not by this that I shall revenge and destroy thee.
2.5: Thou have aroused My anger - I shall bring sickness of heart upon thee - and thou will lack one who helps thee - and thou will not escape from My authority until I destroy the speaking of thy name from this world.
2.6: As thou have stiffened thy neck - and as thou have elevated thyself upon My country - upon the time I quickly did this thing like unto the wink of an eye - thou will know that I was thy creator - as thou are before Me like unto grass before the wind that the fire devours - and as thou are like unto the dust that the wind scatters and empties upon the Earth - thou are like unto them alongside Me,
2.7: for thou have aroused My anger - and as thou did not know thy creator - I shall neglect all thy kindred - and neither will I preserve him who advanced upon thy fortress,
2.8: and now return from all thy sin that thou worked - if thou return from thy sin and appease in mourning and sadness before YAH - and if thou beg toward Me with a clean heart - YAH will forgive thee all thy sin that thou worked before Me" - he told him.
2.9: At that time Meqabis wore dust and mourned before YAH because of his sin - for YAH had distressed him,
2.10: as His eyes are revealed - as He does not withhold - and as His ears are opened - as He does not neglect - and as He does not make the word He speaks false - and as He quickly accomplishes her at one time - and YAH knew lest He delay the chastisement He spoke by the prophet's Word.
2.11: Meqabis cast his clothes and wore sackcloth and sprinkled dust upon his head and cried and wept before his Creator YAH because of his sin that he worked.

3.1: And the prophet came to Ramoth and told him - for Ramoth is part of Moab near to Syria.
3.2: He dug a pit and entered up until his neck and wept strong tears - and he entered repentance because of his sin that he worked before YAH,
3.3: and YAH told the prophet thus: - Meqabis return from the land of Judah toward Ramoth in Moab - He told him. Tell him - "YAH told thee thus" - Tell him - "He told thee - I YAH Who am thy creator sent thee by My Accord that thou might destroy My country - lest thou say - 'I destroyed the honoured country Jerusalem by the firmness of my Power and the abundance of my army' - yet it is not thou who did this thing,
3.4: for she has saddened Me by all her greed and her treachery and her lustfulness,
3.5: and I neglected and spoiled her by thy hand - and now YAH forgave thee thy sin because of thy children whom thou birthed - it is not because thou who stiffened thy neck said 'I encircled the land of Jerusalem by the strength of my authority.'
3.6: As persons who doubt are not given to enter repentance - do not be a doubter - and now enter into repentance being disciplined in thy whole heart."
3.7: Persons are admired who enter repentance with their whole hearts and who do not again return toward eagerness to sin - that have come to repentance because of their sin.
3.8: Persons are beloved who return toward their creator YAH being disciplined in mourning and sadness - in bowing and many prayers. Persons are beloved who are disciplined and enter repentance - for He has told them - you are My possession who enter repentance - you previously misguided persons who entered repentance.
3.9: He told arrogant Meqabis upon the time he returned toward Him in repentance after he turned - I forgive thee thy sin because of thy fright and thy alarm; for I am YAH thy creator Who brings hardship upon the children for a father's sin up until seven generations if the child work the sin that the father worked - and Who does Charity up until ten thousand generations to persons who Love Me and keep My LAW,
3.10: and now I will establish My Oath with thee because of these thy children whom thou birthed - and YAH Who rules all and Who honours Israel said - I will accept the repentance thou made for thy sin that thou worked.
3.11: At that time he proceeded from the pit and bowed to the prophet - he swore saying - "As I have saddened YAH - make me what thou love - yet make YAH do me thus lest I separate from thee - as we have no Law - we did not live established in His Command like as unto our fathers - thou know what our fathers taught us and that we worship idols,
3.12: for I am a sinner who lived rooted in my sin - who had a stiff neck and an arrogant heart whereby I saddened YAH'S Command - but up until now I had not heard YAH's servant the prophet's Word - and I did not live rooted in His LAW and His Command that He commanded me."
3.13: He told him saying - "As there are none from your kindred before you who trusted in his sin - I know that YAH accepted thy repentance today."
3.14: "But now quit thy worshipping idols and return toward knowing YAH that thou might have true repentance" he told him - he fell and bowed at the prophet's feet - and the prophet lifted him up and commanded him all the goodly Work that is due Him,
3.15: and he returned toward his house doing also like as unto YAH commanded him,
3.16: and that Meqabis returned his body to worshipping YAH - and he destroyed from his house the idols and also the sorcery - persons who worship idols and soothsayers and magicians,
3.17: and those who conducted the morning and evening sacrifice to idols - he would examine the children he captured and brought from Jerusalem in all YAH'S Commands and His Order and His LAW,
3.18: and from the children he captured - he appointed teachers upon his house,
3.19: and again to the babes he appointed wise children to keep the children who were smaller - who before going to sleep might teach them YAH'S LAW that Israel's children should do - Meqabis would hear from the captured children of Israel the Order and the LAW and the Ten Laws - and that the order of the persons of Moab and their shrines that they made were in vain.
3.20: He destroyed their shrines - their idols and their sorcery - and the sacrifice and the grapes sacrificed to the idols morning and evening from the goat kids and fattened sheep flocks,
3.21: and he destroyed his idols whom he worshiped and prayed to and believed in all his own Work while he offered sacrifice afternoon and at noon - for all the priests told him - that it was his idols to whom he did their accord.
3.22: As it would seem to him that they saved him in all that they told him - he would not scorn all the things they told him.
3.23: But then Meqabis quit their Work.
3.24: After he heard the saying of Ra`ay - whom they call a prophet - he accomplished his Work in repentance - as Israel's children would begin to sadden Him - and upon the time He chastised them in their tribulation - as they realised and also cried toward YAH - all Meqabis' kindreds worked goodly Work more than Israel's children in that season,
3.25: but upon the time YAH heard that they were seized and abused by people's hand who brought tribulation upon them and that they cried toward Him - He thought of their father's oath and at that time He would forgive them because of their fathers Isaac - Abraham - and Jacob,
3.26: and upon the time He saved them - they would forget YAH Who saved them from tribulation - and they would return toward worshipping idols,
3.27: and at that time He would arouse upon them peoples who brought tribulation upon them - and upon the time they brought tribulation upon them and saddened them - they would cry toward YAH - as He loved them because they were His Creation - at that time He would be merciful and forgive them,
3.28: and upon the time He kept them - they again returned toward sin that they might sadden Him by their handiwork that was wicked and by worshipping idols in their councils.
3.29: But He would arouse upon them Moabites and Philistines - Syrians - Midians and Egyptians; and upon the time their enemies defeated them - they would cry and weep - upon the time they prevailed upon them and taxed them and ruled them - YAH would arouse princes for them that He might save them at the time He desired.

4.1: And in Joshua's time was a day when He saved them.
4.2: and in Gideon's time was a day when He saved them,
