4.3: and in Samson's time and in Deborah's and Barak's and Judith's time was a day when He saved them - and giving His spirit whether upon his son or upon his daughter - He would arouse for them that they might save them from their enemy's hands who brought tribulation upon them,
4.4: and like as unto YAH desired - He would save them from persons who brought tribulation upon them,
4.5: and they would be Irie in all the Work that He accomplished for them - they would be Irie in the seed of their land and in the multiplying of their flocks in the wilderness and their livestock,
4.6: and He would bless their plants and their livestock for them - for He sees them with the Eye of Mercy - and He would not diminish their livestock upon them - for they are righteous person's children and He would wholly love them.
4.7: But upon the time they were evil in their Work - He would cast them in their enemy's hands,
4.8: and upon the time He destroyed them - they would seek Him in worship - and they would return from sin and march toward YAH in repentance,
4.9: and upon the time they returned in their whole heart - He would atone their sin for them - He would not remember their former sin upon them - for He knows that they are flesh and blood - for they have this world's misleading thoughts upon them - and for they have demons with them.
4.10: But upon the time that Meqabis heard this Order that YAH worked in His worshipping place the Temple - he was absolute in repentance.
4.11: After he saw and heard this - he did not scorn working goodly Work; he did not scorn working all the goodly Work that Israel's children worked upon the time YAH forgave them - and after they trespassed from His LAW - they would weep and would cry at the time YAH chastised them - and again He would forgive them - and they would keep His LAW,
4.12: and Meqabis likewise would straighten up his Work - and he would keep His LAW - and he would live founded in Israel's Creator YAH'S Command.
4.13: At that time after he heard all the Work whereby Israel's children were proud - He was proud like unto them in keeping YAH'S LAW.
4.14: He would urge his kindred and children that they might live rooted in YAH'S Command and all His LAW,
4.15: and he would forbid the order that Israel forbids - and he would hear and keep the Law that Israel keeps - and with other Moabite persons - he would forbid the food that Israel forbids,
4.16: and he would send forth tithes - he would give all that were first birthed and that he owned from his cows and his sheeps and his donkeys - and turning his face toward Jerusalem he would offer the sacrifice that Israel sacrifices.
4.17: He would sacrifice sin and vow sacrifices - a sacrifice whereby benefit is done and an accord sacrifice - and the continual sacrifice,
4.18: and he would give his first crops - and he would gush and pour the grapes that Israel poured - and he would give this to his priests whom he appointed - and likewise he would do all that Israel does - and he would sweeten his incense.
4.19: He built a candlestick and a bowl and a seat and a tent and the four links of rings - and diluted oil for the lamp in the holy of Holies - and the curtain like Israel made in the holy of Holies upon the time they served YAH,
4.20: and like as unto they worked goodly Work upon the time they lived solid in His Order and His LAW and upon the time YAH did not neglect and cast them in their enemy's hands - Meqabis also would work goodly Work like unto them.
4.21: He would pray toward Israel's creator YAH always that He might be his Teacher and lest He separate him from Israel's children whom He chose and who did His Accord,
4.22: and again he would pray to Him that He might give him children in Zion and a house in Jerusalem - that He might give the Heavenly Seed of Virtue in Zion and a Heavenly House of Soul in Jerusalem - and that He might save him from the destruction spoken by the prophet's tongue - that He might accept his repentance in all the mourning he wept before YAH being sad and entering repentance,
4.23: and lest He destroy his children in this world upon him - and that He might keep him in his comings and goings.
4.24: The people and kindreds from Moab beneath Meqabis' authority were Irie that they might believe - for their chief lived completely in straight Work - and they would behold his judgment and fulfill his accord - and they would scorn their country's language and their country's justice - they would overstand that Meqabis' Work surpassed and was straight,
4.25: and they would come and hear of Meqabis' charity and True judgments.
4.26: He had much money - he had daughter servants and man servants and camels and donkeys - and he had five hundred horses that wore breastplates - he would utterly defeat the Amalekites and Philistines and Syrians - but formerly when he worshipped idols they defeated him.
4.27: He prevailed - from his worshipping YAH onward - when he went toward battle there was none who defeated him.
4.28: But they would come in their idol's Power that they might fight him - and they would call their idol's names and curse him - however there were none who defeated him - for he has placed his faith upon his creator YAH,
4.29: and when he did thus and when he defeated his enemies - he lived and he ruled his people in his authority.
4.30: He would revenge and destroy the wronged person's enemy for them - he would judge Truth to an orphan,
4.31: and he would receive widows in their troubled times - and he would give from his food and satiate them who hungered - and he would clothe the naked from his clothes,
4.32: and he would be Irie in his handiwork - and he would give from the money he had without begrudging - and he would give tithes for the Temple - Meqabis died having lived in Irie Ites when he did this.

5.1: And he died leaving small children - and they grew up like as unto their father taught them - they kept their house in Order - and they would keep all their kindred - and they would not make poor ones cry - nor widows nor orphans.
5.2: They would fear YAH - and they would give their alms to poor ones - and they would keep all the trust their father told them - and they would calm the orphans and widows in their troubled times - and they would be as their mother and father - they would free them from the person's hand who wronged them - and calmed them from all the disturbance and sadness that found them.
5.3: They lived only five years while they did thus.
5.4: After this the Selucian king Tseerutsaydan came - he destroyed all their country - and he captured Meqabis' children and destroyed all their villages,
5.5: and he plundered all their possessions - the Selucians lived transgressing in evil Work and sin - in adultery - insult and greed and not thinking of their creator - yet persons who did not live abiding in YAH'S LAW and His Command and who worship idols seized them and took them toward their country.
5.6: They ate what a beast has eaten and the blood and the carcass - and what a scavenger eats and casts - all that YAH does not love - yet they keep no order from all the true Commands written in Horeb.
5.7: They do not know YAH their creator - Who sent them forth from their mother's wombs and fed them by what is due - Who was their Medicine.
5.8: They marry from their aunts and their father's wife - their step mothers - and they go toward robbery and evil things and sin and adultery - yet they have no order in judgment time - and they work all evil Work and they marry their aunts and their sisters and they have no LAW,
5.9: and all their roads are dark and slippery - and their Work is sin and adultery.
5.10: But those Meqabis' children would keep in all their Order - they would not eat what a scavenger eats nor what died of its own - they would not work all the Works that the Selucian children work - for their many Works are evil that were not written in this book - that sinners work - and doubters and criminals - betrayers totally filled of robbery and sin and pagan children.
5.11: All the Work their creator YAH loves is not there alongside them,
5.12: and again they would worship an idol called Belial Fiegor - they would trust it like unto their creator YAH when it was deaf and dumb for it is the idol that a person's hand worked - for it is the person's handiwork that a smith worked who worked silver and gold - that has no breath nor knowledge - and it has nothing that it sees nor hears.
5.13: It does not eat nor drink.
5.14: It does not kill nor save.
5.15: It does not plant nor uproot.
5.16: It does not harm its enemy nor benefit its friend.
5.17: It does not impoverish nor honour.
5.18: It will be a hindrance to mislead the careless Selucians - yet it does not chastise nor forgive.

6.1: YAH's enemy Tseerutsaydan who was arrogant appointed priests who concealed and deceived for his idols.
6.2: He would offer sacrifice to them and pour the grapes to them,
6.3: and it would seem to him that they ate and drank,
6.4: and while it dawned he would give them cows and donkeys and heifers - and he would offer sacrifice morning and evening - and he would eat from that defiled sacrifice,
6.5: and again he would prod and demand other persons that they might sacrifice to his idols - yet it was not that only they do it,
6.6: upon the time they saw Meqabis' children that they were handsome and that they worship their creator YAH - the idol's priests desired that they might mislead them to offer sacrifice and to eat from that hated sacrifice - but these honoured Meqabis' children refused them.
6.7: As they kept their father's command - and as they have stood on working goodly Work - and as they totally fear YAH - it failed them to agree,
6.8: at that time they bound them and insulted them and robbed them.
6.9: They informed the king Tseerutsaydan that they refused to sacrifice and bow to his idols,
6.10: and because of this thing the king fretted - he was upset and commanded that they might bring them - and they brought and stood them before him - and the king told them by his gods - "Sacrifice a sacrifice to my idols."
6.11: And they spoke and told him - "And I will not answer thee in this thing - and I will not offer sacrifice to thy defiled idols."
6.12: He dismayed them by many evil Works - yet he could prevail - for they had disciplined their hearts believing in YAH.
6.13: He flamed a fire and cast them in the fire - and they gave their bodies to YAH.
6.14: After they died they arose and appeared to him at night drawing their swords when he had reclined upon his lordship throne - and he was terrified.
6.15: "My sirs - tell me alright - what should I do for you? do not take my body in death - that I might do all thou commanded me."
6.16: They told him all that is due to him while they said - "Think that YAH is thy creator - and YAH is there Who shall dismiss you from this thy kingdom where thou are arrogant - and Who shall lower thee toward the Gehenna of fire with thy father devils - when we worshipped our creator YAH without iniquity in life that we have wronged thee - and when we bowed to Him in fearing His YAH-ness - like as unto thou burned us in the fire - thou will finish all thy hardship in the same manner,
6.17: for He is Who created all - Earth and Heaven and sea and all that is within her,
6.18: and He is Who created the moon and sun and stars - and He is Who created all the creation - that is YAH,
6.19: for there is no other creator without Him in Earth nor Heaven - for He is Who provides for all - and for there is nothing that fails Him. As He is Who kills and Who saves - Who chastises in tribulation and Who forgives - when we bowed to Him in fearing YAH - like as unto thou burned us in the fire - thou will finish thy hardship in the same manner" they told him.
6.20: "As He is Who rules Earth and Heaven - there is none who escapes from His authority.
6.21: There is none from the creation He created who departs from His Command - apart from thou who are a criminal - and criminals like unto thee whose reasonings thy father satan veiled - and thou and those thy priests and thy idols will descend together toward Gehenna where are no exits up until eternity.
6.22: Thy teacher is satan who taught thee this evil Work that thou might do an evil thing upon us - yet as it is not only thou who does this - you will descend toward Gehenna together,
6.23: for thou make thyself like unto thy creator YAH - yet thou did not know YAH Who created thee,
6.24: and thou are arrogant in thy idols and thy handiwork up until YAH makes thee wretched - He shall convict thee upon all thy sin and iniquity that thou worked in this world.

7.1: Woe to you who do not know YAH Who created you - to thy idols who are like unto thee - and to thee - and you have that you might lament and regret that which did not profit at the time you were ruined being seized in Sheol - and woe to thee - to you who do not keep His Word and His LAW,
7.2: you will have no exit from her up until eternity - thy priests and thou who sacrifice to them like as unto your creator YAH - to thy idols who have no breath nor soul - who will not revenge and destroy him who did an evil thing upon them - nor do a goodly thing for him who did a goodly thing to them.
7.3: Woe to you who sacrifice to them - for they are a person's handiwork where satan lives - lodging there to mislead careless one's reasoning like unto thee - that he might lower you all toward the Gehenna of fire - and the priests who serve demons overseeing you and your idols.
7.4: As you do not know that there is nothing there that will profit you - you are misguided and err.
7.5: As for the beasts that YAH created to be food for you - they are better than you - for besides one death there is no more condemnation upon them.
7.6: But as you will die and receive hardship in the Gehenna of fire where are no exits up until eternity - animals are better."
7.7: Having spoken this - they went and were hidden from him.
7.8: But that Tseerutsaydan was frozen while he trembled - seized by a firm fright - and terror did not quit him up until it dawned.

8.1: Yet he lived falling back into his heart's malice and arrogance,
8.2: and as iron has been called strong - like as unto Daniel saw it upon his kingdom - he entered into people's countries in his area.
8.3: He lived established in evil and all his falsehood and in distressing persons,
8.4: and he completely destroyed what was spoken to him formerly - and he devoured a person's wealth,
8.5: for he is diligent to evil like unto his father devils who stiffened his neck - and he destroyed what remained with his army.
8.6: He says - "My time will become like unto the years of the Sun" - yet he does not know YAH that He was his creator,
8.7: and in his reasoning he thinks that the Sun is sustained from him.
8.8: He arises in Power - his camp in the Tribe of Zebulon's lot and begins a formation in Macedonia - and he receives his food from Samaria - and they give him presents from Samaria.
8.9: He camps in the nomad's region - and he reaches up until Sidon - and he casts a tax upon Acacia - and he elevates his heart up until the flowing sea - and he returns and sends messengers up until India's sea,
8.10: and likewise he elevates his heart up to Heaven.
8.11: He lives wholly in being arrogant and in evil - yet he does not have the ability to humble himself,
8.12: and his paths are toward darkness and slipperiness - and toward crime and being arrogant - and toward shedding blood and tribulation,
8.13: and all his Work is what YAH hates - he does unto robbery and evil and sin which his teacher devils taught him - he makes an orphan child cry - and he is not kind to the poor,
8.14: and he defeated and destroyed the nation's kings by his authority,
8.15: and he ruled the enemy's chiefs - and he ruled many peoples - and he taxed them like as unto he desired.
8.16: Even after he destroyed - he did not stop - there were no persons whom he did not snatch beginning from the Tarsus sea up until the Aegean sea.
8.17: He would bow to idols - he would eat what died of itself - the blood - what a sword bloated and cut - and what was sacrificed to idols - all his Work is without justice - yet he has no justice - as he it was who alarmed peoples beneath his authority - he would tax them with tax like as unto he desired.
8.18: As he does all that he wanted before him - there was no fearing YAH before him - and he lived in malice before YAH Who created him.
8.19: He did not do it like unto his creator - and like as unto he would do an evil thing unto his companion upon the time he vexed and seized him - YAH shall also pay him the same hardship.
8.20: As YAH has said - I shall revenge and destroy sinners who do not live by My Command - that I might destroy their name from this world - like as unto He destroyed peoples who were preceding him - He shall revenge and destroy him upon the time when He destroys,
8.21: and like unto evil persons did evil things - they shall receive their hardship.
8.22: But being commanded from YAH - goodly Work shall follow persons who work goodly Work,
8.23: for like as unto Joshua destroyed the five Canaanite kings in the cave in one day - and like unto he made the Sun stand in Gideon by his prayer that he might destroy their armies - the Sun had stood amidst Heaven up until he destroyed Hebron and Canaan - the Lachish and Eglon and Jerusalem armies - and like unto he killed around twenty thousand persons at one time - and like unto he killed them - and like unto he bound them placing his foot to their neck - and like unto he killed them in the cave by the spear - and like unto he fitted a stone upon them.
8.24: Tribulation like unto this shall find all persons who sadden YAH in their evil Work.

9.1: "O thou weak man who is not YAH - why are thou proud? thou who are seen today being a man and are Earth's ashes tomorrow - and thou will feed worms in the grave,
9.2: for thy teachers are devils who return all person's sin toward themselves because he misled our father Adam - and Sheol will find thee again - and she will find persons who work their sin,
9.3: for in stiffening his neck and making himself proud - like as unto he refused to bow to Adam whom the creator created,
9.4: thou also have refused to bow to thy creator YAH like as unto thy teacher devils did.
9.5: Like unto thy preceding fathers - who do not know their creator YAH in worship - will go toward Gehenna - thou also will go toward Gehenna.
9.6: Like as unto He revenged and destroyed them because of their evil Work that they worked in this world - and like as unto they descend toward Gehenna,
9.7: thou also will descend toward Gehenna like unto them.
9.8: As thou have aroused His anger - and as thou have neglected to worship YAH Who gave thee authority upon the five kingdoms - does it seem to thee that thou will escape from YAH'S authority?
9.9: Thou do not do thus that thou do His Accord - thus He examined thee - but if thou work goodly Work in this world - YAH will accomplish all thy Work for thee - and He will accomplish and bless all the Work thou seized in thy hand for thee - and He will subject thy ancient enemies and the enemies of today for thee.
9.10: Thou will be Irie in thy enterings and thy proceedings and in thy child birthed from thy nature - and in thy flocks and thy fatnesses - and in all Work where thou placed thy hand - and in all that thou thought in thy heart - as authority has been given thee from alongside YAH that thou might do thus and might work and plant and demolish - all will be commanded for thee.
9.11: However if thou will not hear YAH'S Word nor live strong in His LAW - like unto law breakers who were preceding thee - and who do not worship YAH by what is due - and who did not believe in HIS straight LAW - there is nothing whereby thou will escape from YAH'S authority - for YAH'S judgments are Truth.
9.12: All is entirely revealed before Him - yet there is nothing hidden from before Him.
9.13: He is Who granted the king's authority and Who overturned powerful one's thrones.
9.14: He is Who elevates them who were debased and Who lifts up them who fell.
9.15: He is Who looses them who were bound and Who arouses them who died - as grace dew is found from alongside Him - upon the time He desires He shall arouse persons whose flesh was demolished and rotten and was like unto dust,
9.16: and having aroused and judged persons who worked evil Work - He will take them toward Gehenna - for they have saddened Him,
9.17: for they are who demolished YAH'S Order and His LAW - and He will destroy their seed from this world.
9.18: As a righteous person's Work is more difficult than sinner's Work - sinners do not desire that they might live in the counsel of the righteous.
9.19: Like as unto Heaven was distanced from Earth - likewise a righteous person's Work was distanced from evil person's Work.
9.20: But a sinner's Work is robbery and sin - adultery and iniquity - greed and treachery Work - it is being drunk in iniquity and robbing a person's money.
9.21: It is quickly going toward shedding a person's blood - and it is going toward destruction that does not benefit - and it is making an orphan child weep - it is eating blood and what is dead of itself - and it is eating camel and boar flesh - and it is going toward a daughter in her blood before she is cleansed - and toward a daughter pregnant with child.
9.22: All this is sinner person's Work - she is satan's trap that was a wide and prepared path - and that takes toward Gehenna that lives closed up forever - and toward Sheol.
9.23: But the righteous one's path that is very narrow is what takes toward mercy - and innocence and humbleness - and unity and Love - and prayer and fasting - and purity of flesh - toward keeping from what does not benefit - from not eating what a sword bloated and cut and what died of itself - and from going toward another man's wife and from adultery.
9.24: They keep from what was not commanded by LAW - from eating disgusting food and from all hated Work - and from all the Work that YAH does not love - for sinner persons do all this.
9.25: As for righteous persons - they distance from all the Work that YAH does not love.
9.26: He loves them and shall keep them from all their tribulation like unto a sure possession,
9.27: for they keep His Order and His LAW and all that He loves - but satan rules sinners.

10.1: Fear YAH Who created you and kept you up until today - yet you the nobles and kings - do not go upon satan's path.
10.2: Live in the LAW and Command of YAH Who rules all - yet do not go upon satan's path.
10.3: As upon the time Israel's children came toward the Amalekites that they might inherit the lands of Eglon and Canaan and Lachish - Beor's child Balak said to Balaam,
10.4: whom thou curse is cursed - and whom thou bless is blessed - do not go upon satan's road - for he has said - "and I will give thee much silver and gold to honour thee - that thou might curse for me - and having cursed - that thou might destroy for me."
10.5: And Balaam has come making his sorcery reward a resolve - for Beor's child Balak has shown him the place where Israel's children camped,
10.6: for he has done his soothsaying - and for he has offered his sacrifice - and for he has slaughtered from his fattened cows and sheeps - and for he has desired that he might curse and destroy Israel's children.
10.7: He returned a curse toward a blessing - yet YAH did not desire that he might curse them by His Word - do not go upon satan's road.
10.8: "As thou are the kindred that YAH chose - as thou are YAH'S tabernacle that shall come from Heaven - let persons be cursed who curse thee - and let persons who bless thee be blessed" he said,
10.9: upon the time he blessed them before him - after this Beor's child Balak was sad - and he raged and commanded that Balaam might curse them,
10.10: for the kindred that YAH blessed have come toward this country - and Balaam told him - "I will not curse Israel whom YAH blessed."
10.11: And Beor's child Balak told Balaam - "As for me - I had wished that thou might curse for me - thou blessed them before me - yet but thou did not curse them - if thou had cursed for me and said 'Reward me' - as for me - I would have given thee a house full of silver and gold - but thou instead blessed them - thou did not do a goodly thing for me - and I will not do a goodly thing for thee."
10.12: Balaam said - "What YAH told me Speak with my tongue - I will speak it - yet as for me - I can not dare to ignore YAH'S Word.
10.13: Lest I curse a blessed kindred - as YAH shall afflict upon me if I love money - as for me - I do not love money more than my soul.
10.14: As YAH has told their father Jacob - let persons who bless thee be blessed and let persons who curse thee be cursed - lest I curse the blessed Jacob - as for me - I do not love money more than my soul" he said - and as YAH has told him - He who blesses thee are blessed,
10.15: and a person who curses thee unjustly is cursed - accomplish thy path and thy Work that YAH might love thee,
10.16: and do not be like unto former generations who saddened YAH in their sin and whom He neglected - and there are them whom He destroyed in the flood of Water,
10.17: and there are them whom He destroyed by their enemy's hands - bringing enemies who were evil and persons who brought tribulation upon them - and they captured their lords with their priests and their prophets,
10.18: and they delivered them toward a foreign country they did not know - they captured them - and they plundered their livestocks upon them and destroyed their country,
10.19: for they have demolished the honoured country Jerusalem's fences and ramparts - and they made Jerusalem like unto a plowed field,
10.20: and the priests were captured - and the LAW was demolished - and warriors fought in war and fell,
10.21: and widows were captured - as they were captured - they wept for themselves - yet they did not weep for their husbands who died,
10.22: and the children wept - and the elders were shamed - and they did not show respect to neither a grey haired person nor an elder.
10.23: They destroyed all they found in the country - yet they were not kind to beauties nor to them in LAW - as YAH has vexed upon His kindreds upon the time He desired that He might beforehand destroy His house the Temple - they captured and took them toward the country they did not know and toward the nations.
10.24: As they saddened their creator always - because of this thing when YAH neglected Israel's children - YAH made Jerusalem to be ploughed like unto a field,
10.25: for He remembers them because of their fathers - He did not destroy them at once - as He loved their fathers Isaac and Abraham and Jacob who reigned in truth and lived firmed up in the straight LAW before their creator - it is because of their father's righteousness - yet it is not because of their own righteousness that he forgives them,
10.26: and He appointed them honours that were twofold - and they found two Kingdoms - upon Earth and in Heaven,
10.27: and you the kings and the nobles who live in this passing world - like as unto your fathers who lived rooted in Work that is due and who were preceding you likewise inherited the Kingdom of Heaven - and like as unto their names were beautiful for generations - think of them,
10.28: and thou - straighten up thy Work - that He might straighten up thy Kingdom for thee - and that thy name might be called in goodly invocation like unto the righteous kings who preceded thee who served YAH in their beautiful lifestyle.

11.1: Think of YAH's servant Moses who was not upset when he thought over his kindred in his humbleness and his prayer and whom not even one person overcame - and he pleaded toward YAH in his innocence for his sister and brother who backbit him and YAH desired that might destroy them while he said - "As they have wronged Thee - Lord - pardon and do not neglect thy kindreds" - and he atoned their sin for them - yet YAH thought of HIS servant Moses who was not troubled.
11.2: "For I have wronged Thee - and forgive me Thy servant who am a sinner - for Thou are Merciful - and for Thou are a Pardoner - and forgive them their sin."
11.3: And Moses atoned the sin of his sister and brother who backbit him,
11.4: and because of this thing he was called innocent,
11.5: and YAH entirely loved him more than all the priest's children who were his brethren - for He appoints the priests - and YAH made him like unto himself alongside them.
11.6: But He also buried beneath the Earth Korah's children who contended - He lowered them toward Sheol with their livestocks and their tents when they said "we are there - we are there in flesh and soul" - as his creator YAH has loved him - and as he did not depart from His Command - all the words he spoke would be done to him like unto YAH'S Word,
11.7: and if thou walk in YAH'S Command likewise - YAH will do thy accord for thee and will grant thy petition for thee - and He will keep thy Kingdom for thee,
11.8: and Abiram and Korah's children who departed from Moses' command grumbled over him because he told them - "Straighten up your hearts to be ruled by YAH."
11.9: They grumbled saying - "How about are not we Levi's children who work in the priesthood Work in the set-apart Tent?"
11.10: They went and smoked up incense seizing their censers that they might smoke them - but YAH did not accept their plea - and they were burnt by the fire in their censers - and they melted like as unto the wax that melts in the fire - and not even one person remained from them - as He has said - Their censers were hallowed by their bodies being burnt - dedicate their censers into the Tabernacle of YAH'S lodging by YAH'S Command - neither their clothes nor their bones remained,
11.11: because of this thing YAH told Aaron and Moses - Gather their censers toward the Tent - make it be an instrument for My lodging wherefore I prepared all things beginning from outside up until within.
11.12: And he prepared the hallowed Tent instruments - he prepared the rings and the joiners - the Cherubim mercy seat.
11.13: He worked the cups - the curtains - the Tent area grounds for the mobilisation - the altar and the jugs whereby they sacrifice in the set-apart Tent.
11.14: They offered the sacrifice that they sacrificed by their own accord - the sacrifice whereby welfare is made - the sacrifice whereby He atones sin - and the vow sacrifice and the morning and the evening sacrifice.
11.15: All that He commanded to Moses - he commanded them in the set-apart Tent - that they might work Work in her.
11.16: They did not scorn being ruled by their creator YAH - that His Name might be praised by them in the Lawful tabernacle of their creator YAH - Who gave them a promise that He might give to them their father's inheritance - a land that produces honey and milk which He swore to Abraham.
11.17: They did not scorn being ruled by their creator YAH - Who swore to Isaac and settled His Worship by Jacob,
11.18: and Who established by Aaron and Moses the Tent where His Worship is kept,
11.19: and Who settled His Worship for both Eli and Samuel in the Temple and Tent that Solomon worked up until it became YAH'S house in Jerusalem - and up until YAH'S Name became YAH'S house that honoured Israel,
11.20: for she is a supplication - and for she is a sin atonement where sin is negated for them who live in innocence and to the priests,
11.21: and for she is a place for persons who do His Accord where He will hear their prayers,
11.22: and the construction of YAH'S LAW that honoured Israel,
11.23: for she is where sacrifice is offered and where incense is smoked up that YAH Who honoured Israel would be in goodly Fragrance,
11.24: and He would speak being upon the seat where He forgives in the set-apart place - YAH'S Light would be revealed to Jacob's children whom He chose and for friends who live solid in His LAW and His Command.
11.25: But persons who ignore YAH'S LAW will be like unto Korah's children whom the Earth swallowed - and likewise sinners have that they might enter toward Gehenna that has no exits up until eternity.

12.1: You who do not keep the LAW He commanded you in the Tent - woe to you Israel's nobles who also do not do His Accord - yet you do your own accord - and this is being arrogant and prideful - greedy and committing adultery - and drink and being drunk - and swearing in a lie,
12.2: and because of this thing My anger - like as unto chaff is burnt before a fire - and like as unto fire melts the mountains - and like as unto a whirlwind spills the crushed chaff from Earth and scatters it toward Heaven - lest its trace be found in its place - My anger will destroy you like that.
12.3: YAH Who honours Israel said - I shall likewise destroy all persons who work sin - and think of YAH Who rules all and for Whom nothing fails.
12.4: He loves persons who love Him - and for persons who live uprightly in His Command - He will atone their iniquity and their sin for them - do not be dull and stingy of heart by not believing,
12.5: and make your thoughts straight to be ruled by YAH - and believe in Him that you might strengthen your bodies - and I shall save you from your enemy's hand in your time of tribulation,
12.6: and in your time of prayer I tell you - Hearken - I am there with you in Support - I shall save you from your enemy's hand - as you have believed in Me - and as you have done My Command - and as you did not depart from My LAW - and as you have loved what I love - YAH Who rules all said - I will not neglect you upon your tribulation day.
12.7: He loves them who love Him - for He is a Pardoner - and for He is merciful - and He keeps persons who keep His LAW - like unto a trusted possession.
12.8: He turns His anger from them many times - because He is who knows that they are flesh and blood - as He is a Pardoner - He did not destroy all in His chastisement - and upon the time their souls were separated from their flesh - they will return toward their Earthliness.
12.9: As He has created them bringing from not living toward living - they will not know the place where they abide until YAH'S desire that He might bring them from not living toward living - again He separated their souls from their flesh - and the Earth nature returned toward its Earthliness,
12.10: and again His Accord shall bring them from not living toward living."
12.11: But Tseerutsaydan who denied YAH increased being arrogant before YAH - he made himself lofty from the day that he desired unto the time he quit YAH.
12.12: "and my time became like unto the age of Heaven - and I am who sends forth the sun - and I will not die up until eternity" he said,
12.13: and before he finished speaking this thing the Angel of Death whose name is called Thilimyakos arose and struck his heart - he died at that time - as he did not praise his creator - he was separated from his beautiful lifestyle and he perished arising from his abundant arrogance and his evil Work.
12.14: But when the Selucian king's army had camped in the city and the country squares desiring to fight him - at the time he died - they proceeded and destroyed his country - they plundered all his livestock - and they did not preserve an elder who was near and beheld the ramparts.
12.15: They plundered all his money - and they took even his small possessions - and they burned his country in fire and returned toward their own country.

13.1: But these five children of Maccabeus who believed gave their bodies to death refusing to eat the sacrifice offered to idols,
13.2: for they have known that pretending with YAH is worse than pretending with persons - and YAH'S anger worse than the king's anger,
13.3: having known that this world will utterly pass and that the Irie Ites will not live bound forever - they gave their bodies to the fire that they might be saved from the fire in Heaven,
13.4: and as they have known that being made Irie in the Garden one day is better than living many years in this world - and that finding Thy Pardon one day Lord - is better than many years - they gave their bodies to the fire.
13.5: What is my time? Like unto a shadow - like as unto passing wax melts and perishes upon a hot blade - is not it like unto that?
13.6: But Thou Lord live forever - and Thy Ages are not fulfilled - and the speaking of Thy Name is for generations,
13.7: and the children of Maccabeus thought that it seemed right - refusing to eat a disgusting sacrifice they chose believing in YAH,
13.8: knowing that they will arise with persons who have died - and meaning because of YAH - knowing that judgment shall be judged after the Resurrection - because of this thing they gave their bodies to martyrdom.
13.9: You persons who do not know nor believe that the dead will rise - knowing that the Life they find later will surpass from this their passing Earthly Life - arising from these five children of Maccabeus who gave their bodies together to death and whose appearance was handsome - after this they knew there would be a Resurrection,
13.10: because they believed in Him knowing that all shall pass - and because they did not bow to idols - because they did not eat a disgusting sacrifice that does not give Support - they gave their bodies to death that they might find thanks from YAH,
13.11: for because of this thing knowing that He will make them Irie in flesh and soul in a later age - they did not want this world's flavour or consider death in tribulation a serious thing for them - and knowing that the Resurrection will be made in flesh and soul upon the Day of Advent - they gave their bodies to death,
13.12: and knowing that persons who kept YAH'S LAW - with the nobles and the kings who believed YAH'S Word and were righteous,
13.13: shall live reigning for generations and many eras in the Kingdom of Heaven where is no sadness and tribulation nor death - and knowing in their hearts what will be done later - like as unto wax melts amidst a fire - because of this thing they gave their bodies to death,
13.14: believing that their faces will shine seven times more than the sun - and that they will be Irie in His Love upon the time all arise in flesh and soul - they gave their bodies to death.

14.1: But the Samaritans and Jews - the Sadducees who do not believe persons who have died will rise - and the Pharisees quite truly sadden me - and it grabs me to my heart - "we will die tomorrow" the Jews say - "let us eat and drink - we will die tomorrow - there are no Irie Ites which we will behold in the grave."
14.2: But the Samaritans say - "As our flesh will be dust - it will not arise,
14.3: because the soul is invisible like unto wind and like unto another one's voice - behold - she is here - and because she is what they do not call for and is invisible - souls will not arise if the flesh has died - only when the Resurrection has happened will we believe our souls arise.
14.4: But as beasts will eat the body and as worms will eat her in the grave - our flesh is seen alongside all - she will become dust and ashes,
14.5: and those beasts who ate her will become dust - for they have been like unto grass - and for they have become dust like as unto they were not created - and for them a trace will not be found - and our flesh will not arise."
14.6: And the Pharisees say - "we believe that persons who have died will arise - however He will bring and unite souls with a different flesh that is in Heaven - that is not upon Earth - where will decayed and rotten flesh be found?"
14.7: But the Sadducees say - "After our soul proceeds from our flesh - we will not arise with persons who have died - and flesh and soul have no arising after they die - and after we die we will not arise."
14.8: And because of this thing they totally err - and as they speak insult upon YAH'S Lordship - the thing saddens me.
14.9: As they did not believe YAH Who honours them - they have no hope to be saved - however they have no hope to die and arise and be saved.
14.10: O Jews who are blind of reasoning - when thou are whom He created bringing from not living toward living - and scorned like unto spit - will thou make YAH ignorant - Who made thee a person? Will it fail YAH Who created thee in His Example and His Appearance to join uniting thy flesh and thy soul?
14.11: As thou will not escape from YAH'S authority - do not think a thing that is thus - thou will arise without thou desiring - for there is the hardship thou will receive in Sheol where thou were taken at the time thou died - and it shall be judged upon thee without thou desiring,
14.12: for the sin initiated from demons that demons place in thy heart has worked alongside thee from when thou was birthed from thy mother's womb - and to her you worked abundantly during the time thou grew up.
14.13: They placed her in thy body at the time thou died - and she will bring hardship upon them at the time they worked her.
14.14: Like as unto there is sin in the bands of their heart - as there are persons who work sin being captured by her - her kindreds will proffer demons.
14.15: All sinner's souls shall come from Heaven's edge where they are - and thy sin likewise shall admit thee toward Gehenna pulling and bringing thy soul from where thou are,
14.16: and after thy flesh lived separate from thy soul - YAH'S Benevolent dew shall arouse thee being sevenfold like unto our father Adam's flesh.
14.17: Thou who live in the graves - thou also err in thy error - yet make it not seem to thee that thou only mislead the others - thou say - "The Resurrection that dead persons arise is not true" - that they might depart from YAH'S Command and err.
14.18: He shall arouse thee that He might give thee thy hardship like unto thy Work that thou worked - yet who shall quit thee that thou might remain being dust?
14.19: But at that time - whether wind in wind be thy nature - or if Water in Water be thy nature - or if Earth in Earth be thy nature - or if fire in fire be thy nature - it shall come,
14.20: and if the soul that lodged in thee be what has lived in Sheol - she shall come,
14.21: and righteous one's souls that live in the Garden in Ites shall come.
14.22: But thou Jew - Samaritan - Pharisee - Sadducee - will live in Sheol up until it is judged upon thee.
14.23: At that time thou will behold that YAH shall pay thee the hardship like unto thy sin because thou misled persons.
14.24: "Persons who died will not arise - as we will die - let us eat and drink" - and because thou sat in Moses' chair and misled by thy words while thou said - "Persons who die will not arise" - thou will behold that He shall pay thee thy hardship,
14.25: and without thy knowing Horeb's Book - and when thou teach the Book's words - because of this thing thou erred - it would be better had thou remained without learning than thy misleading a person.
14.26: It would have been better if thou did not know the Book's words - when thou promulgate YAH'S kindreds in thy evil teaching and thy worthless words,
14.27: for YAH does not favour any face - and He shall give the grace and glory He prepared for His friends - persons who teach goodly Work - but thou have that thou might receive thy reward like unto thy Work and the things that thou spoke.
14.28: But there is nothing whereby thou will escape from YAH'S authority Who shall judge upon thee - and He has that He might pay thee like unto thy Work - for they whom thou taught and thou together will receive a sentence.
14.29: Know that persons who died shall arise - and if they are persons who kept His LAW they shall arise - and like as unto Earth sends forth grass at the time rain rained - as His Command shall send them forth from the grave - it is not possible for it to remain decayed and rotten.
14.30: Like unto green wood drinks dew and sends forth leaves at the time He sends the rain to Earth - like as wheat bears forth fruit - and like as grain produces buds - it is not possible for her to withhold that she might prevent her fruit if YAH desired,
14.31: and as it is not possible for a daughter who conceived to close and prevent her womb at the time labour has seized her - as it is not possible for her to escape without birthing,
14.32: as dew has descended toward her being commanded from YAH - at that time she shall produce them at one time - yet after she heard YAH'S Word - the grave also likewise cannot prevent the persons gathered alongside her from arising,
14.33: and fleshes shall be gathered in the place where their corpses fell - and the places where souls live shall be opened - and souls shall return toward the flesh where they were formerly separated,
14.34: and at the time a drum is beaten - persons who died shall quickly arise like unto the wink of an eye - and having arisen they shall stand before YAH - and He shall give them their reward like as unto their handiwork.
14.35: At that time thou will behold that thou arise with the dead ones - and thou will marvel at all the Work thou worked in this world - and upon the time thou behold all thy sins written before thee - at that time thou will regret a useless regret.
14.36: Thou know that thou will arise with dead ones and that thou will receive thy hardship like as unto the Work that thou worked.

15.1: But persons who found their reward by their goodly Work shall be Irie at that time - persons who disregarded while they said - "Persons who died will not arise" shall be disappointed at that time at the time they behold dead persons arise with their evil Work that does not benefit.
15.2: That - their Work that they worked shall convict them - and themselves shall know that it convicts them without one living who will doubt them,
15.3: upon the day when judgment and mourning is done - upon the day when YAH shall come - upon the day when Definite judgment is judged - persons who forgot YAH'S LAW shall stand in the place where they stand,
15.4: upon the day when there shall be total darkness - and upon the day when mist is brought - upon the day when flashes are seen and when lightning is heard,
15.5: and upon the day when quakes and fright and heat and sleet frost are formed,
15.6: upon the day when an evil person who worked evil Work receives hardship - and upon the day when a clean person receives his reward like as unto he worked clean Work - and upon the day when persons who forgot YAH'S LAW receive the hardship like as unto a sinner who worked sin - they shall stand in the place where they stand,
15.7: for upon the day when a master is not more honoured than his servant - and upon the time when a mistress is not more honoured than her maid,
15.8: and upon the time when the king is not more honoured than a subject - and upon the time when an elder is not more honoured than an infant - and upon the time when a father is not more honoured than his son - and upon the time when a mother is not more honoured than her daughter,
15.9: and upon the time when a wealthy one is not more honoured than a poor one - and upon the time when an arrogant one is not more honoured than a debased one - and upon the time when the great are not more honoured than the small - she is the day when judgment is judged - for she is the day when they receive sentence and hardship - and for she is the day when all will receive hardship like as unto the sin they worked,
15.10: and for she is the day when persons who worked goodly Work receive their reward - and for she is the day when persons who worked sin receive hardship,
15.11: and as she is the day when persons who found their reward are made Irie - persons who forgot YAH'S LAW shall stand in the place where they stand. Persons who were liars - who devour the Word while they said - "Persons who died will not arise" - they shall behold the Resurrection.
15.12: At that time this world's sinners - who did not work goodly Work in this world - shall weep over their sin that they worked - because sadness found them in agitation,
15.13: and all likewise - kind persons who worked goodly Work - these Irie Ites will not be perfected until eternity - for they have worked goodly Work when they were in this world,
15.14: for they have known that they will arise after they die - and they did not depart from their creator's LAW,
15.15: because they did not depart from His LAW - they shall inherit two welfares - He multiplied their seed in this world - He honoured their children.
15.16: He bequeathed them the Kingdom of Heaven where shall be found the welfare He swore to their fathers at the time when persons who died will arise - and upon the time when rich ones become poor.
15.17: Persons shall weep who worked sin - who do not believe that dead persons will arise - who do not keep YAH'S LAW - and who do not think of the Resurrection Day.
15.18: At that time they will behold the tribulation that shall find them and shall have no ending - and where is no calming nor welfare - and it is sadness that has no rest nor calming of their hearts,
15.19: and a fire that does not perish and worms that do not sleep shall find them,
15.20: and in the place where is their flesh is fire - sulphur - whirlwind - frost - hail - sleet - all this shall rain over them,
15.21: for persons who do not believe that persons who died shall arise - there is the fire of Gehenna upon them.

16.1: Thou - please think of what is upon thy flesh - and the nails of thy feet and thy hands - and the hair of thy head - for they return quickly after the time thou cut them - know the Resurrection by this - that thou have a heart - and that thou have belief and knowledge.
16.2: The nails of thy feet and thy hands and the hair of thy head - thou say - "Where do these come from?" - is not it YAH Who prepared it that they might grow - that thou know the arising that shall be done over thy flesh that is not over a different flesh - that thou might know that thou will arise after thou have died?
16.3: Because thou misled persons while thou said - "There is no Resurrection of the dead ones" - upon the time when dead ones arise thou will receive thy hardship like as unto thou worked sin and iniquity,
16.4: and as even what thou planted now will not remain refusing that it might grow - whether it be wheat or barley - thou will see her at the time the day arrives when thou will receive thy hardship,
16.5: and again - the plant thou planted will not say - "I will not grow" - and be it a fig wood or a grape vine - its fruit and its leaf will not be changed.
16.6: If thou plant grapes - it will not be changed that it might be a fig - and if thou plant figs - it will not be changed that it might be grapes - and if thou sow wheat - it will not be changed that it might be barley.
16.7: All - in each of the seeds - in each of its kinds - each of the fruits - each of the woods - each of the leaves - each of the roots - sends forth fruit having received the Pardoning Dew - a blessing by what is found from YAH - yet if thou sow barley also it will not be changed that it might be wheat,
16.8: and all likewise - that a grave might produce flesh and soul - she shall produce persons like as unto YAH sowed within her - the flesh and soul that YAH sowed shall arise being united - yet persons who worked goodly Work will not be changed into persons who worked evil Work - and persons who worked evil Work also will not be changed into persons who worked goodly Work,
16.9: and at the time the moment arrives when a drum is beaten - persons who died shall arise by the Pardoning Dew found from YAH - persons who worked goodly Work shall arise in the Resurrection of Life - and their reward is the Garden where are Irie Ites that YAH prepared for the righteous persons - where is no tribulation nor disease - and that is the house of clean ones where they will not again die after this.
16.10: But persons who worked evil Work shall arise with a Definite judgment arising - and with the devils who misled them,
16.11: and with his armies - demons who do not desire that even one person might be saved from all of Adam's children,
16.12: they shall descend toward Gehenna that is the edge of darkness - where is weeping and gnashing of teeth - where is no charity nor pardon - and where are no exits up until eternity - that is beneath Sheol forever, for they did not work goodly Work in their Life in this world when they were in their flesh,
16.13: because of this thing it shall be judged upon them at the time when flesh and soul arise being united.
16.14: Woe to persons who do not believe the flesh and soul arise whereby YAH shows His miracles and abundance together,
16.15: and all and each one shall receive his reward like as unto his Work and his handiwork.

17.1: A wheat kernel will not grow nor bear fruit unless she is broken. But if a wheat kernel is broken she will send roots toward Earth - she will send forth leaves - there will be buds - she will bear fruit,
17.2: you know that the one wheat kernel will become many seeds,
17.3: and all likewise - this kernel grows rising up from Water and wind and the dew of Earth - for wheat cannot bear fruit without the sun - but the sun is in place of fire,
17.4: and wind is in place of a soul - and wheat cannot bear fruit without wind - and the Water gives Earth to drink and satiates her,
17.5: and after Earth that was ashes drinks Water - she produces roots - and her tips are lofty upward - she bears fruit according to as YAH blessed her.
17.6: But a wheat kernel is Adam's example - in whom lodged a resonating soul that YAH created - and likewise as grape wood drinks Water and sends forth roots - and the thin roots drink Water,
17.7: for Pardoning Dew found from YAH gives drink to long vine tips - and it sends the Water upward toward the leaf tips - it buds up from the sun's heat - and by YAH'S Accord it bears fruit.
17.8: It shall be a goodly fragrance that makes a heart Irie - and at the time they eat it - it shall satiate like as Water that does not make thirsty and as grain that does not make hungry - and upon the time they immerse it - it will be the cluster's blood,
17.9: and like as unto it was told in Psalms saying - "Grapes make a person's heart Irie" - upon the time they drink it - it makes a person's heart Irie - and upon the time a person who came loose opened his mouth and drank it - he is drunk - he drinks and fills in his lungs - and the blood flows toward his heart.
17.10: As a grape's drunkenness totally misleads - and as it deprives him his mind - it makes the pit and the cliff like unto a wide meadow - and he does not note obstacles and thorns upon his feet and hands.
17.11: YAH did thus upon her fruit and grape wood that His Name might be praised by persons who believe dead persons arise and who do His Accord,
17.12: in the Kingdom of Heaven He shall make persons Irie who believe persons who died will arise.

18.1: You who do not believe persons who died will arise - every where what mistakes you make! and at the time they take you toward the place you do not know - you will regret a useless regret - and because you did not believe the Resurrection - that persons who died shall arise united in soul and flesh - and at the time you will be cast toward Gehenna,
18.2: if you work whether the good or the evil - you will receive your reward like unto your Work - for you have misled the brethren's hearts while you said - "we know that persons who died - who are dust and ashes - will not arise."
18.3: As their death has no exit - and as they have no Power over their chastisement that shall come upon them - and as they were not resolute in their tribulation - because of this thing they mislead their companions - for they have that they might stand in YAH'S Court,
18.4: upon the time He vexes upon them in His wrath they will utterly fear - because they did not know that they were created brought from not living toward living - and they speak YAH'S LAW without knowing - it shall be judged upon them because of all the evil they worked.
18.5: They do not know Gehenna where they will go - for because they were prideful and because they were crooked in their Work - they teach to their brethren like unto their thirsty heart's desire - and they are evil ones who teach a crooked thing while they say - "There is no Resurrection of the dead."
18.6: At that time they shall know that persons who died shall arise - and they shall know that it shall be judged upon them because they did not believe that persons who died arise - that is for all Adam's children,
18.7: for all are Adam's children - and for I have died because of Adam - and for the judgment of death has found me from alongside YAH because of my father Adam's error.
18.8: I will again arise there with my father Adam that I might receive my hardship by my Work that I worked - for the world has been marked to death by my father Adam's ignorance.
18.9: By Adam infringing YAH'S Command - because of this thing I received hardship - my flesh in the grave melted like unto wax - and my body perished,
18.10: and Earth drank my marrow - I perished and my comeliness perished in the grave - and my flesh was buried in the grave - and my beautiful words were buried in Earth,
18.11: and worms proceeded from my shining eyes - and my features perished in the grave and became dust.
18.12: Where is the comeliness of youth - who was attractive - whose stance was handsome and whose words succeeded? How about where is the warrior's strength?
18.13: Where are the king's armies - or how about the noble's lordship? Where is adorning in horses and adorning in silver and gold and adorning in shining weapons? did not it perish?
18.14: Where are the sweet grape drinks - and how about food's flavour?

19.1: O Earth who gathered the nobles and the kings and rich ones and elders and sons and daughters who were beautiful and attractive - woe arising from thee.
19.2: O Earth who gathered persons who were warriors - they who have comeliness - and they who were fine of leg - and they who have hearts and knowledge - and they who spoke words that were beautiful like unto a humming harp and like unto a lyre and a violin beat,
19.3: and they who have a tune that makes Irie like as unto grape drink makes Irie - and they whose eyes shine like unto a morning star,
19.4: and they whose right hands sketch in strength the likeness of a thing like unto they were - and they whose feet were beautiful to behold - and they who run like unto rushing wheels - woe arising from thee.
19.5: O death who separated attractive person's souls from their flesh - woe arising from thee - for thou have been sent by YAH'S Accord.
19.6: As thou have gathered many persons whom YAH produced from thee and returned toward thee - thou Earth - woe arising from thee - I was found from thee - I returned toward thee by the Accord of YAH - I was Irie over thee by YAH'S Accord.
19.7: Thou became a carpet for my corpse - I recurred over thee - and I was buried within thee - I ate thy fruit - and thou ate my flesh,
19.8: and I drank the Water found from thy springs - and thou drank my blood springs - I ate the fruit found from thy Earthliness - and thou ate my body's flesh.
19.9: Like unto YAH commanded thee to be my food - I ate grain from thy Earthliness and comely dew - and thou received the comeliness of my flesh and made it dust for thy food like as unto YAH commanded thee.
19.10: O death who gathered the nobles and the kings who were powerful - woe arising from thee - thou did not fear collecting their famousness and their dread - as YAH Who created them commanded thee - O death - woe arising from thee - and thou did not scorn the sufferer,
19.11: and thou were not nice to persons whose features are beautiful - and thou did not quit powerful ones and warriors - thou did not quit poor nor rich ones - neither kind nor evil ones - neither children nor elders - neither daughters nor sons.
19.12: Thou did not quit persons who think a goodly thing and who did not depart from the LAW - and thou did not quit them who were like unto animals in their Work - who think an evil thing - who were totally beautiful in their feature's comeliness - in their sweet speech and in their words - O death - woe arising from thee.
19.13: Thou did not quit persons whose words were angry and whose mouths were full of curses - thou gathered persons who live in darkness and in light and all their souls in thy places - O death - woe arising from thee,
19.14: and Earth gathered the person's flesh who lives whether in cave or on Earth - up until a drum is beaten and persons who died will arise.
19.15: As persons who died shall arise quickly like unto the wink of an eye by YAH'S Command and upon a drum being beaten - persons who worked evil Work shall receive their hardship in the abundance of their sin by the measure that they worked it - and persons who worked goodly Work shall be Irie.

20.1: And believe me that all my Work that I worked in this world will not remain nor be hidden at the time I stand before Him in fear and trembling,
20.2: and at that time I did not gather provisions for my path - and at that time I will not have clothes for my body,
20.3: at that time I will not have a staff for my hands nor shoes for my feet,
20.4: and at that time I will not know the paths where demons take me - whether it be slippery or smooth - or be it dark - and whether it be thorns or nettles - or whether it be a depth of Water or a depth of a pit - believe me that my Work that I worked in this world will not remain nor be hidden.
20.5: I will not know the demons who take me - and I will not hear their voice.
20.6: As they are black ones - and as they lead me toward darkness - I do not behold their faces,
20.7: and like as unto the prophet spoke saying - "upon the time my soul was separated from my flesh - Lord my Lord - Thou know my path - and they hid a trap upon that path where I went - and I looked returning toward the right - I lacked one who knows me - and I have nothing there whereby I will escape" - as they take me toward darkness - I will not behold their faces.
20.8: As he knows that demons ridicule over him - and as they will lead him toward the path he does not know - his speaking this is because of this - and if he returns leftward and rightward - there is no person who knows him.
20.9: He is alone amidst demons - and yet there is none who know him.
20.10: Angels of Light who are subtle are who are sent toward righteous persons that they might receive their souls - and might take them toward a Light place - toward the Garden - where welfare is found.
20.11: Demons and Angels of darkness are who are sent that they might receive the wicked and might take them toward Gehenna that was prepared for them - that they might receive their hardship by their sin that they worked.
20.12: Woe to sinner's souls who are taken toward destruction - who have no welfare nor rest - nor escaping from the tribulation that found them - nor proceeding from Gehenna up until eternity.
20.13: As they have lived firmed up in Cain's Work - and as they have perished by Balaam's iniquity - and as they have lacked what they will do - woe to sinners - for their pretext to receive interest and presents - that in transgression they might take a foreigner's money that was not their money.
20.14: They shall receive their hardship in Gehenna by their sin that they worked.

21.1: Where are persons who gather a foreigner's money that was not their handiwork nor their money by right?
21.2: For they take a person's money by shrewdness - and they shall be gathered without knowing when the day they shall die will arrive upon them - however they acquire money wrongly from a foreigner,
21.3: for like unto their fathers - they are sinner's kindreds who worry and hold sinners like unto them whether it be by theft or by robbery - and their children will not be Irie by their father's money.
21.4: As they have gathered to them in transgression - and as it is like unto the morning mist and like unto the smoke that the wind scatters and like unto wilting grass - and like unto wax that melts from before a fire - a sinner's glory shall perish like unto that - there are none whom their father's money will benefit - like as unto David spoke saying - "I behold a sinner,
21.5: being honoured and famed like unto an cedar and like unto a cypress - but upon the time I returned I looked for him - I searched and did not find his place" - there is none whom their father's money will profit nor benefit,
21.6: because they gathered a person's money in transgression - it seeming to them that they will not die - like as unto persons who wrong their companions boast - a sinner's destruction is likewise at one time,
21.7: you lazy ones - think that you will perish and that your money will perish with you - and if your silver and your gold abound it shall be rusted,
21.8: and if you birth many children they shall be for many graves - and if you build many houses they shall be demolished,
21.9: for you did not fulfill your creator YAH'S Accord - and if you multiply livestock they shall be for your enemy's capture - and all the money you seized in your hands will not be found - for it has been what was cursed.
21.10: Whether it be in house or in forest - and be it in wilderness or a pasture land - and be it in grape threshingfloor or in grain threshingfloor - it will not be found,
21.11: because you did not keep YAH'S Command - as YAH will not save you with all your household from the tribulation - there shall be sadness upon you arising from all your enemies - yet you will not be Irie in your children birthed from your loins.
21.12: But from His plenty - He will not trouble persons who kept His Order and His LAW - He gives all who desire Him - yet He blesses their children birthed from their loins and also the fruit of their land for them,
21.13: and He makes them rulers over all peoples in their area that they might rule - lest they be who are ruled - and He gives them all His plenty in their pasture land.
21.14: He blesses to them all they hold in their hand - all their fruit fields - and all their livestock - and He makes them Irie in their children birthed from their loins,
21.15: and He does not diminish their abundance upon them - He saves them from all their tribulation and from weariness and illness and destruction - and from their enemies they do not know and from those they know,
21.16: and He will dispute for them in judgment time - and He shall save them from an evil thing and from tribulation and from all who dispute them. In the first time if a priest lived who worked the Tent Work - who kept the LAW and kept the Tent Order and lived firmed up in YAH'S Accord - by the first Order and all the LAW they would give him the tithe and what was firstborn beginning from man and livestock - He would save them from all the tribulation.
21.17: Like as unto Moses commanded Joshua son of Nun - make sanctuary citys in all the land - for those not knowing and for those knowing - up until they are judged in judgment - for whom are convicted and for whom are acquitted,
21.18: if a person lived who killed a soul - he would be measured in the balances there that he might be saved.
21.19: He told them - "Examine in your hearts if he had a quarrel with him formerly - and be it by axe or be it by a stone or be it by wood - as it has fallen from his hand by not knowing - if he says "That person upon whom the object fell died upon me" - examine and save him - if he did it in not knowing let him be saved.
21.20: But if he did it knowing - he will receive his hardship like as unto his sin - and there are none who will pardon him; but if he killed him in not knowing - as he has done it in not knowing - examine and save him lest he die.
21.21: He worked for them that they might distance from all the sin - Moses would work like unto this for Israel's children lest they depart from YAH'S LAW.
21.22: He commanded them that Adam's children - who live established in YAH'S Command from worshipping idols and eating what died of itself and what a sword bloated and cut - and who distances from all evil work - that they might do the LAW and might distance from all that is not right.
21.23: He commanded them lest they depart from the Command He wrote for them in the Tent patterned from Heaven - that they might save their bodies and might find their abode with their fathers.
21.24: As they have been birthed from Seth and Adam who did YAH'S Accord - persons who believed in YAH'S Word and lived established in His Command will be called the children of righteousness.
21.25: As we are Adam's children - as He has created me in His Example and His Appearance that I might work all goodly Work that makes YAH Irie - He will not scorn me.
21.26: As He will not separate His friends - if I work goodly Work - I shall inherit the Kingdom of Heaven where is reward for persons who work goodly Work.
21.27: He loves persons who ask him cleanly - and He hears them in their prayer - and He accepts the repentance of persons who are disciplined and enter repentance - He gives firmness and Power for persons who keep His Order and His LAW and His Command.
21.28: Persons who did His Accord shall be Irie with Him in His Kingdom forever - and whether they be persons who preceded or who arose later - they will present praise to Him beginning from today up until eternity. Give the Glory due to YAH forever - and the second book of Meqabyan arrived and was fulfilled.

1.1: Messiah shall delight the people of Egypt - because He shall come toward them in the later era and He will revenge and destroy devils - who wronged them who were kindly and innocent - and who misled persons - and who hates his Creator's Work.
1.2: He shall revenge and destroy him - He shall return his lordship toward wretchedness and being debased - for he has been arrogant in his reasoning.
1.3: He shall return his lordship toward being debased - for he has said - "As I will enter into the midst of the sea - and as I will proceed toward Heaven - and as I will behold the depths - and as I will grasp and seize Adam's children like as unto bird's chicks - who is it who is loftier than me?
1.4: Because I entered into their hearts that I might distance them from the straight LAW of YAH - as I will strengthen persons who live in this world who did not do YAH'S Accord - there are none who will depose me from my authority" he said,
1.5: "for I will be the reason to guide them toward a path that is smooth to go toward Gehenna with me.
1.6: Persons who loved Him and kept His LAW hate me because of this thing - but persons who departed from their Lord's LAW and who erred will come toward me and love me and keep my oath - as I will make their hearts evil and change their thoughts lest they return toward their creator YAH - they will do my command like as unto I commanded them,
1.7: and at the time I show them this world's riches - I will mislead their reasoning from straight LAW - and upon the time I show them beautiful and attractive daughters - I will distance them by these from straight LAW,
1.8: and upon the time I show them shining jewels from India and silver and gold - I will distance them by this also from straight LAW that they might return toward my Work,
1.9: and upon the time I show them thin clothes and red silk and coloured silk - and linens and white silk - I will distance them by this also from straight LAW - and I will return them toward my thoughts - upon the time I multiply money and livestocks like unto sand and show them - by this also I will return them toward my Work,
1.10: and upon the time I show them jealousy done in arrogance because of daughters and because of anger and quarrels - by all this I will return them toward my Work,
1.11: and upon the time I show them signs - I will lodge in their brethren's hearts - and I will place a sign specific to them within their hearts - and I show them word signs and mislead them,
1.12: and for persons in whom I lodged myself - I will show them signs - and be it in a star's gait - or be it in clouds proceeding or in fire flickering - or be it in the cries of beasts and birds - as they are my house - I will place signs in their hearts upon them by all this.
1.13: They will speak and give signs to their companions - and like unto what the soothsayers told them - I will precede and be a sign for them.
1.14: I will preform their word signs for them - that persons who examined them might be misled - and that they might give a wage for magicians - and that they might tell to their companions saying - 'There are no seers like unto so-and-so and so-and-so for whom it is done like as they spoke - and who knows prophecy - and who separates good and evil - and for whom all is like as they spoke - and for whom it is done like unto their word.'
1.15: I will be Irie upon the time they speak this - that persons who perish and err by me might abundantly abound and that Adam's children might perish - for YAH has debased me from my rank because of their father Adam - upon me saying 'I will not bow to Adam who is lower than me.'
1.16: And I will take toward destruction all his children who live in my command - I have an Oath from YAH Who created me - that all persons whom I mislead might descend toward Gehenna with me,
1.17: and upon the time He multiplied His anger upon me - and upon the time He commanded that they might bind and cast me toward Gehenna - upon the time my creator commanded saying thus - I interceded with my Lord - I interceded before Him while I said - 'As Thou have vexed upon me - and as Thou have admonished me by Thy chastisement - and as Thou have chastised me by Thy wrath - Lord my Lord - adjourn me that I might speak one thing before Thee.'
1.18: And my Lord answered to me saying - Speak - I will hear thee - at that time I began my plea toward Him saying - 'After I was debased from my rank - make the persons whom I mislead be like unto me in Gehenna where I will receive tribulation,
1.19: and make them be for Thy Lordship who refused me - who did not err by me - who did not keep my command - that they might do Thy Command and might fulfill Thy Accord and might keep Thy Word - upon the time they did not err by me like unto I misled them having refused like as unto I taught them - and upon the time Thou desire - make them take the crown Thou gave to me.
1.20: Give them the crown of the authorities called satans who were sent with me - seat them upon my throne upon Thy Right that was a wilderness from me and my hosts,
1.21: and make them praise Thee like as unto Thou love - and make them be like unto my hosts and like unto me - because Thou hated me and loved them who were created from ashes and Earth - as my authority has perished - and as their authority has been lofty - make them praise Thee like as unto Thou love.'
1.22: My Lord answered to me saying - As thou have misled them while they see and while they hear - if thou mislead them without them loving My Order - make them be to thee like unto thy accord and like unto thy word.
1.23: If they quit the Book's Word and My Command and come toward thee - and if thou mislead them while their destruction also saddened Me - make them receive tribulation in Gehenna like unto thee - He told me,
1.24: you will receive tribulation in Gehenna up until eternity - yet you will have no exits from Gehenna up until eternity - to them whom thou misled nor for thee.

2.1: But I shall bequeath thy throne in lordship to them whom it failed thee to mislead - like unto My servant Job - YAH Who rules all said - I will give the Kingdom of Heaven to persons whom it failed thee to mislead.
2.2: “But I instigate Adam's children in all things - if it is possible for me to mislead them - I will not quit them lest they enter into goodly Work - for I provoke all Adam's children - and I sweeten this world Irie Ites to seduce them.
2.3: Be it by loving drink and food and clothes - or by loving material things - or by withholding and giving,
2.4: or be it by loving to see and - or be it by loving of physical caress - or be it by multiplying arrogance and possessions - or be it by loving dreams and slumber,
2.5: or be it by multiplying drunkenness and drink - or be it by multiplying insults and anger - be it by speaking debates and useless disputes,
2.6: or be it by quarrels and by backbiting their companion - or be it by coveting this world's daughters who are attractive - or be it by smelling perfume fragrance that intoxicates them.
2.7: I hate them by all this lest they are able to be saved - I distance them from YAH'S Law that they might enter with me toward the destruction whereby I was debased from my rank."
2.8: And the prophet told him - "Thou who destroy persons - perish - upon the time thou departed from YAH'S Law and committed crime in thy heart's conceit and thy arrogance - and by saddening thy creator and not worshipping thy creator in the strength of thy heart - will thou thus be arrogant upon YAH'S Creation?
2.9: At the time thy creator distressed thee - He debased thee from thy rank because of thy evil Work - why do thou take Adam toward sin - him whom his creator created from the Earth - whom He made like as unto He cherished - and whom He placed for His praise?" he told him.
2.10: "At that time thou - who are subtle and was created from wind and fire - was arrogant in saying 'I am the creator'.
2.11: At the time thou boasted - as YAH has beheld thy evil Work and thou have denied YAH with all thy hosts - He created Adam who will praise Him in thy stead - that he might praise His Name without diminishing.
2.12: As thou have made thyself prouder than all the Angel's hosts who are like unto thee - because of thy arrogance YAH created Adam with his children that they might praise YAH'S Name because of the lack of praise which thou were to praise with thy hosts whom He scorned,
2.13: and because of this thing YAH destroyed thee separating from all other chief Angels like unto thee - and thy hosts created in one charge with thee - and thou - you proceeded and erred from YAH'S praise because of your useless heart's arrogance and because of the stiffness of your neck - and you were arrogant unto your creator - and not upon another,
2.14: because of this thing He created Adam from Earth that He might be praised by corrupted persons - and He gave him a Command and Law saying do not eat from the fig fruit lest you die,
2.15: and He appointed him over all the creation He created - He notified him saying - do not eat from one fig fruit that brings death - lest thou bring death upon thyself - yet eat fruit from all the woods amidst the Garden,
2.16: and upon the time thou heard this Word - thou lodged treacherously in him arising from the lie thou spoke in thy tongue to Eve who was brough from Adam's side bone.
2.17: Thou misled Adam who was clean - in base treachery that thou might make him a Law breaker like unto thee,
2.18: at the time thou misled Eve - who was created being like unto an innocent dove and who did not know thy malice - thou made her betray by thy plot and thy crooked word - and after thou misled Eve who was created from Adam beforehand - she also went and misled YAH's creation Adam who was created from Earth beforehand,
2.19: and thou made him betray in confusion but not by arrogance - and thou made him to deny - that he might deny his creator's Word - and thou destroyed Adam in thy arrogance,
2.20: and in thy malice thou distanced him from his creator's Love - and by thy reason thou sent him away from the Garden where Irie Ites are - and by thy hindrance thou made him quit the Garden food,
