2.21: for beginning from Antiquity thou have quarreled with the innocent creation Adam that thou might lower him toward Sheol where thou will receive hardship - and that thou might send him away from the Love that brought him and created him from not living toward true living - and by thy falsehood thou made him covet a taste from the Garden,
2.22: But while he is Earthly - He will make him a complex Angel who heaps praises on his creator in his flesh and his soul and his reasoning,
2.23: and He created many thoughts for him - like as unto harp's praise in each of their styles.

3.1: But He created one thought for thee - that thou might revere while thou were sent toward Gehenna where thy creator sent thee.
3.2: But Adam was given five thoughts that were evil and five thoughts that were goodly - ten thoughts,
3.3: and again he has many thoughts like unto the waves of the sea - and like unto a whirlwind that scatters dust lifting up from Earth - and like unto the sea waves that shake - and arising from him unnumbered thoughts in abundance in his heart like unto unnumbered rain drops - Adam's thoughts are like unto that.
3.4: But thy thoughts are one - as thou are not fleshly - thou have no other thought.
3.5: But thou lodged in the heart of the snake - in evil deception thou destroyed Adam who was one branch - and Eve heard the snake's words - and having heard - she did like as unto she commanded her.
3.6: After she ate a fig fruit - she came and misled YAH'S first creation Adam - and she brought death upon him and upon her children because she infringed her creator's Command.
3.7: They proceeded from the Garden by YAH - by His true judgment - He comforted them in the land where they were sent by their children birthed from their loins and by their crops brought from the Earth - yet He did not distance them from the Garden altercation,
3.8: and upon the time thou expelled them straight from the Garden - that they might plant plants and have children to be comforted and to renew their hearts in the Earth's fruit that the Earth prepared from her Earthliness - and that they might be reassured by the Earth's fruit and the Garden's fruit that YAH gave to them.
3.9: YAH gave them woods more lush than the Garden woods - and Eve and Adam - whom thou sent away from the Garden upon them eating - were totally calmed from sadness.
3.10: As YAH knows how to calm His creation - their hearts are comforted because of their children and because of the crops brought from the Earth.
3.11: As they have been sent toward this world that grows nettles and thorns - they settle their thoughts on Water and grain.

4.1: The Lord has that He might redeem Adam - and He shall shame thee - He will save the sheep from thy wolf's mouth.
4.2: However thou will go toward Gehenna dragging with thee the persons whom thou ruled.
4.3: Persons who kept their creator YAH'S Law shall be Irie with their creator YAH Who hid them from evil Work that He might make them His reward - and that they might praise Him with honoured Angels who did not infringe their creator YAH'S Law like unto thee.
4.4: But YAH - Who chose and gave thee more than all Angels like unto thee that thou might praise Him with His servant Angels - withheld from thee a lofty throne in thy arrogance.
4.5: But thou became famous and were called one who coveted godhood - and thy hosts were called demons.
4.6: But persons who love YAH shall be His kindred like unto honoured Angels - and the Serafim and Cherubim who praise Him stretch forth their wings and praise without slackness.
4.7: But in thy arrogance and thy dullness thou destroyed thy acclaim that thou might not praise Him continually with thy host and thy kindreds created in thy likeness.
4.8: Lest the praise of YAH - Who created thee making a tenth tribe - be diminished at the time thou neglected the praise of YAH Who created thee - it having seemed to thee that it was not possible for Him to create a creation like unto thee - and lest the praise of YAH Who created thee be diminished at the time thou were separated from thy brethren in unity - He created Adam in thy stead.
4.9: But in thy heart's arrogance thou neglected the praise of YAH Who created thee - and He vexed upon thee - He ridiculed thee - and He bound and banished thee in Gehenna with thy hosts also.
4.10: He brought Soil from Earth with His glorified Hands - and adding fire and Water and wind - He created Adam in His Image and His Likeness.
4.11: He appointed him over all the creation He created in His authority - that His praise might be filled by the praise which thou would not praise Him - Adam's praise became one with Angel's praise - and their praise was equal.
4.12: But in thy stiffness of neck and thy arrogance thou were debased from thy rank - and having departed from YAH'S Lordship Who created thee - thou destroyed thyself.
4.13: Know that His praise was not diminished - for YAH has created Adam to praise Him in his wise counsel lest His YAH-ness praise be diminished,
4.14: for He knows all before it is done - and He knew thee before He created thee that thou would transgress His Command - and there is an advocate hidden alongside Him before He created the world - at the time thou denied Him - He created His servant Adam in His Image and His Likeness.
4.15: Like as unto Solomon spoke saying - 'Before the hills were created and before the world completed being created - and before the spirit of the foundations of the Earth were created,
4.16: and before He established the foundations of the hills and mountains - and before this world's Work firmed up - and before moon and sun light shone - before times and stars were known,
4.17: and before daylight and night alternated - and before the sea was delineated by sand - before all the created creation was made,
4.18: and before all beheld now was seen - before all the names called now were called - He created me' - Angels like unto you and thou and His servant Adam were in YAH'S reasoning.
4.19: He created Adam that His glorified Name might be praised upon the time thou mutinied - and that He might be praised by His corrupted servant Adam who was created from Earth at the time thou were arrogant,
4.20: for being in Heaven YAH hears poor one's pleas - and He loves corrupted person's praise.
4.21: He loves to save having lodged in persons who fear Him - yet as He does not regard the horse's Power - and as He does not desire moving to the lap of a concubine - YAH shall ignore arrogant one's works,
4.22: and they shall moan while they cry because of their sin that they worked.
4.23: It failed thee to plead in repentance.
4.24: But Adam who was created from Earth returned in repentance while he wept before YAH because of his sin.
4.25: But in thy stiffness of neck and thy heart's arrogance thou did not know Love's Work and thou did not know repentance - it failed thee to plead before thy creator YAH in repentance and mourning and sadness.
4.26: But that Adam who is ashes and Earth returned toward repentance in mourning and sadness - and he returned toward humbleness and Love's Work.
4.27: But thou did not humble thy heart and thyself for YAH Who created thee.
4.28: As for Adam - he debased himself and pleaded upon the iniquity which he wronged Me - he was not proud.
4.29: As thou have produced crime - it was found from thee - yet it is not Adam who produced that error - in thy arrogance thou took him with thee toward thy destruction.
4.30: Before He created you both - as He has known you that you were sinners - and as He has known your Works - He knows that this that was done was in thy heart's arrogance.
4.31: But He returned that Adam - who was without arrogance or malice - in repentance - mourning and sadness,
4.32: for a person who wrongs and does not plead in repentance has multiplied his iniquity more than the first - but in thy heart's arrogance it failed thee to plead in repentance - but a person who pleads and weeps entering repentance before His creator YAH,
4.33: he enters repentance in truth - and he discovers Work whereby he will be saved that he might fear his Lord's Heart - and he pleads before his creator - for he has pleaded before Him in bowing and much repentance - and arising from the earlier tribulation the Lord shall lighten his sin for him lest He distress His servant - and He will forgive him his former sin.
4.34: If he does not return toward his former sin and if he does this - this is perfect repentance - Adam did not neglect to think of his Creator nor to implore his Creator YAH in repentance.
4.35: And thou - plea in repentance toward thy creator YAH - and do not wrong others because they are flesh and blood - for YAH Who created them knows their weakness - and do not wrong the persons He created by His authority,
4.36: and after their soul is separated from their flesh - their flesh shall be dust up until the day that YAH desires.

5.1: Know YAH Who created thee - as YAH has created thee in His Image and His Likeness when thou are but Earth - do not forget YAH Who brought thee up and saved thee and Whom Israel glorified - He placed thee in the Garden that thou might be Irie and might reap the Earth,
5.2: at the time thou transgressed His Command - He sent thee away from the Garden toward this world that also He cursed because of thee - that it may grow nettles and thorns,
5.3: for thou are Earth - and for she is Earth - for thou are dust - and for she is dust - for thou are Soil - and for she is Soil - for thou are fed the grain from her - and for thou will return to her - for thou will be Soil up until His desire that He might raise thee - and for He shall examine thee in the sin that thou worked and in all the iniquity.
5.4: Know what thou will answer Him at that time? - think of the good and evil thou worked in this world - examine whether the evil would abound or whether the good would abound - try.
5.5: If thou work a goodly thing - it is a goodly thing for thee that thou might be Irie upon the day when persons who died will arise.
5.6: But if thou work evil Work - woe to thee - for thou will receive thy hardship like as unto thy handiwork and like as unto thy heart's evil - for if thou work an evil thing upon thy brethren and if thou do not fear YAH - thou will receive thy hardship,
5.7: and if thou betray thy brethren and if thou call YAH'S Name and swear in lies - thou will receive thy hardship like as unto thy Work - woe to thee,
5.8: and thou tell thy false thing to thy companion simulating Truth - but thou know that thou spoke a lie,
5.9: and thou persuade the persons with thee thy false thing simulating Truth - and thou multiply false things that are not True - and thou will receive thy hardship like as unto thy sin - thou deny thy companion while thou tell thy companion 'I will give thee' what thou will not give him,
5.10: and at the time thou said 'I will give' in thy pure heart - demons make claim to thee like as unto dogs - and they make thee forget all - and if thou withhold or if thou want that thou might give - they do not know the person for whom they gather - yet as He has said - They shall fatten - this world's money appetizes thee that thou might fatten thy wealth which will not benefit thee and that thou will not eat,
5.11: and again - as He has said - Adam's liar children make a balance false - as for them - they go from robbery toward robbery - this world's money appetizes thee.
5.12: O persons - do not place hope in distorting scales and balances - and in stealing a person's money - and in acquiring a person's money in transgression - and in infringing your companion's money - and in stealing his field - in all the lies you do for your own profit that is not for your brethren.
5.13: If you do this you will receive your hardship like as unto your Work.
5.14: O persons - be fed by your handiwork that is straight - yet do not desire robbery - do not long that you might rob and consume a person's possessions without justice - by what is not yours,
5.15: and if you eat it - it will not satiate you - upon the time you die you will leave it for another - yet even if you fatten - it will not benefit you,
5.16: and if your money abounds - do not distort your heart - as sinner's money is like unto the smoke that proceeds from a griddle and the wind takes it - better than much sinner's money is a little money accumulated in Truth.

6.1: Think of the day when you will die - upon the time your souls are separated from your flesh - and upon the time you leave your possessions to another - and upon the time you go upon the path you do not know - think of the tribulation that shall come upon you,
6.2: and the demons that will receive you are evil - and their features are ugly - and they are frightening in their splendour - and they will not hear your words - and you will not hear their words,
6.3: and because you did not do your Creator YAH'S Accord - they will not hear you in your plea at the time you beg them - because of this thing they will utterly frighten you.
6.4: But persons who fulfilled YAH'S Accord have no fear - for demons fear them. But demons shall ridicule sinner's souls over them.
6.5: But righteous person's souls shall be Irie over Angels in Irie Ites - for they shall totally make them Irie because they scorned this world - but angels who are evil shall receive sinner's souls.
6.6: Accepting Angels shall receive kind persons and righteous one's souls - for they are sent from YAH that they might soothe righteous one's souls - as Angels that are evil are sent from devils that they might ridicule over sinner's souls - demons shall receive sinner's souls.
6.7: Sinners - woe to you - weep for yourselves before the day when you die will arrive upon you - upon the time you reach toward YAH,
6.8: enter repentance in the day that is before your time passes - that you might live in Irieness and Ites without tribulation nor disease - yet as after you die your time will not return that has passed - weep.
6.9: Lest sin be upon you as a vain accord that distances from YAH - in your assessment let a want to be lavished and rich food and Irie Ites be found not in you - as a body that is satiated without measure will not think of YAH'S Name - a devil's richness shall lodge over that - yet as the holy Spirit will not lodge in it - make loving the Irie Ites not be found in you.
6.10: Like as unto Moses spoke - Moses having said - "Jacob ate and was sated and fattened and tall and wide - and YAH Who created him was separated from him,
6.11: and his lifestyle distanced from YAH" - as a body that is sated without measure nor moderation will not think of YAH'S Name - make loving Irie Ites not be found alongside you - as belly satiety without measure is being like unto a boar and like unto a wandering horse - make drinking and eating without measure and lust not be found in you.
6.12: But a person who eats in measure shall live founded in YAH'S Support - and he shall live straight like unto the horizon and like unto a tower that has a stone fence; a person who forgot YAH'S Law shall flee without any one chasing him.
6.13: A righteous person shall live being respected like as unto a lion.
6.14: But persons who do not love YAH will not keep His LAW - and their hearts are not straight,
6.15: and YAH shall bring sadness and alarm upon them when they are in this world - and being seized in trembling and fright - and being seized in tribulations without number by their possessions being snatched - being bound by their hands in chains by their master's hands,
6.16: lest them be who rested from the tribulation - and lest their lifestyle be in Irie Ites - lest they rest when they are in alarming tribulations that are upon each of themselves - He shall bring sadness and alarm upon them.

7.1: But like unto David who spoke saying - "I believe in YAH - I will not fear having said - 'What could a person do to me?'" - there is no fright and alarm upon persons who believe in YAH,
7.2: and again like as unto he spoke saying - "If warriors surround me - I believe in Him - I ask YAH one thing - I seek it" - persons who believe in Him have no fright upon them - a person who believes in Him shall live in Life forever - and he will not fear the appearing of an evil thing.
7.3: Who is the person who is ashamed believing in YAH? how about who ignored Him for a reward?
7.4: As He has said - I love him who loves Me - I shall honour him who glorifies Me - I shall keep him who returns toward Me in repentance - who is the person who is ashamed believing in Him?
7.5: Judge Truth and respect the widow's plea - save them that YAH might save you from all that oppose you in an evil thing - keep them - as a righteous person's children are honoured - they are given to make things profitable - and yet He shall save your children after you - for they will not be troubled for bread.

8.1: Job believed in YAH - as he did not neglect to praise his creator YAH - YAH saved him from all the tribulation that the devils - Adam's children's enemies brought upon him - he said - "YAH gave - YAH withheld - all has happened like as unto YAH decreed upon me - and make YAH'S Name to be praised by all upon Earth and in Heaven" - yet as he did not sadden his heart - YAH saved him,
8.2: and at the time YAH beheld Job that his heart was cleansed from sin - He received him in much honour,
8.3: and He gave him possessions that abounded more than his possessions that preceded - for he had faithfully endured his tribulation - and He cured him from his wounds because he endured all the tribulation that arrived upon him,
8.4: and if you - like as unto him - endure the tribulation arising from demons sent toward you - you will be admired,
8.5: endure the tribulation - that YAH might be for you a fortress of Refuge from persons who hate you - and that He might be a fortress of Refuge for your children's children and for generations after you - do not sadden your heart arising from the tribulation that comes upon you - believe in Him - and He shall be a fortress of Refuge for you.
8.6: Ask Him - He will hear you - make hope - and He will forgive you - ask Him - and He will be a father for you.
8.7: Think of Mordecai and Esther - Judith and Gideon and Deborah and Barak and Jepthah and Samson,
8.8: and other persons like unto them who were disciplined for belief in YAH and whose enemies did not defeat them,
8.9: for YAH is True - and for He does not have respect of persons - but persons receive hardship who crave that they might work sin upon themselves - all persons who fear Him and keep His LAW shall keep themselves - and He shall give them respect and honour.
8.10: He shall make them Irie in their proceeding and their entering - in their Life and their death - and in their arising and sitting - for He saves - and He covers,
8.11: for He saddens - and He pardons,
8.12: for He makes poor - and He honours - He makes wretched - and as He honours - He makes them Irie.

9.1: And whether it be what is in Heaven - or whether it be what is upon Earth - and be it either subtle or stout - everything in all His dominion lives in His Order.
9.2: There is nothing that departs from YAH'S Law and His Order - Who created all the world - be it an eagle's track that flies in Heaven - He commands it toward its destination where He wishes,
9.3: and He commands a snake's path that lives in a cave toward where He wishes - and a log's path that goes upon the sea - apart from only YAH there is none who knows its path,
9.4: and apart from only YAH - there is none who knows the path where a soul goes at the time it is separated from its flesh - be it a righteous' or a sinner's soul.
9.5: Who knows where it will turn - that it would turn in the wilderness or upon a mountain? or that it would fly like unto a bird - that it would be like unto Heaven's dew that alights upon a mountain,
9.6: or that it would be like unto deep wind - or that it would be like unto lightning that carves out it's path,
9.7: or that it would be like unto stars that shine amidst the deep - or that it would be like unto sand upon a seashore that is piled amidst the deep,
9.8: or that it would be like unto the strong foundations of the deep - or like unto a wood that gives her beautiful fruit that grew by a Water spring,
9.9: or that it would be likened unto the reed that the heat of the sun burns - and that wind lifts and takes toward another place where it did not grow - and whose trace is not found,
9.10: or that it would be like unto the morning cloud whose trace is not found - who knows YAH'S Work? who are His counsellors? how about with whom did He counsel?
9.11: As YAH'S Thoughts are hidden from persons - who will examine and know His Work?
9.12: As He has created Earth upon Water - and as He has supported her fast - there is none who examines and knows YAH'S Counsel or His Wisdom - and He created Heaven in His perfect Wisdom and supported it in winds - and He stretched forth the lofty firmament like unto a tent.
9.13: He commanded clouds that they might bring rain upon Earth - and He grows grass - and He grows fruits without number to be food for persons - that I might believe in YAH and be Irie in unity.
9.14: YAH is Who gives Adam's children the Irie Ites all the fatness and all the satiety - YAH is Who gives that they might satiate and praise YAH Who gave them fruit from Earth,
9.15: and Who dressed them in beautiful robes - Who gave them all the desired plenty - the Irieness and the Ites that are given for persons who fulfill YAH'S Accord.
9.16: He gives being respected and honoured in the house He has prepared and in the Kingdom of Heaven for their fathers who keep YAH'S Law.
9.17: He gives being respected and honoured in the place He has prepared and in the Kingdom of Heaven for their fathers who lived stable in His Worship and His LAW - and who did not depart from His LAW - whom He famed and raised that they might keep His Order and His LAW - and I behold what YAH does for His friends in this world by weakening their enemies and by keeping their bodies.
9.18: I behold that He gives them all they ask of Him and that He fulfills their accord for them - do not depart from YAH - and fulfill YAH'S Accord,
9.19: do not depart from His Command and His LAW - lest He vex upon you and lest He destroy you at once - and lest He vex and smite you in the tribulation from where you lived formerly - lest you depart from your father's Order where you were formerly - and lest your lodging be in Gehenna where are no exits up until eternity.
9.20: Keep your Creator YAH'S Law - when your soul is separated from your flesh He might do goodly Work for you at the time you stand before Him,
9.21: for the Kingdom of Earth and the Kingdom of Heaven are His - and the Kingdom and the means are for Him - and being merciful and pardoning are only for Him.
9.22: As He makes rich and He makes poor - as He makes wretched and He honours - keep YAH'S Law,
9.23: and David spoke because of Him while he said - "Man seems vain - and his years pass like unto a shadow."
9.24: He spoke because of Him saying - "But Lord - Thou live forever - and the speaking of Thy Name is for generations."
9.25: And again he said - "Thy Kingdom is all this world's Kingdom - and Thy Rulership is for generations." - Thou returned a kingdom to David taking from Saul.
9.26: But there is none who will appoint thee - there is none who can dismiss - Thou behold all - yet there is none who can behold thee,
9.27: and Thy kingdom will not perish forever for generations - there is none who will rule Him - but He rules all - He beholds all - but there is none who behold Him.
9.28: As He has created man in His Image and in His Likeness that they might praise Him and might know His Worship in pure heart without doubt - He examines and knows what the kidneys kindle and what the heart sparked.
9.29: Yet they bow to stone - to wood - and to silver and gold that a person's hand worked,
9.30: and they offer sacrifice to them up until their sacrifice smoke ascends toward Heaven - that their sin might come before YAH - but yet they refuse to worship YAH Who created them - He shall accuse them because of all their sin that they worked in worshipping their idols.
9.31: They learned bowing to idols and all stained Work that is not right - soothsaying by stars - sorcery - worshipping idols - evil accord - and all the Work that YAH does not love - yet they do not keep YAH'S Command that they learned.
9.32: As they did not wish to worship YAH that they might save their bodies from sin and iniquity by His servants the Angels and by the bounty that they praise before YAH - they work all this in lacking goodly Work,
9.33: and at the time they all arise together from the graves where they are buried and where their bodies perished - their souls shall stand empty before YAH - and other souls will stand in the Kingdom of Heaven prepared for righteous persons.
9.34: But sinner's souls shall stand in Gehenna - and at the time the graves are opened - persons who died shall arise - and souls shall return toward the flesh that they were separated formerly.
9.35: Like as unto they were birthed in their nakedness from their mother's belly - they shall stand in their nakedness before YAH - and their sins that they worked beginning from their youth up until that time shall be revealed.
9.36: They shall receive their sin hardship upon their bodies - and whether there is little or much sin - they shall receive their hardship like as unto their sin.

10.1: For the blood of the soul given from YAH shall lodge in them like as unto it lodged in them formerly - and if you do not believe that persons who died shall arise - hear that His creations shall arise at the time the rain descends without being birthed from their mother nor father,
10.2: and He commanded them formerly by His Word that they die,
10.3: and their flesh being decayed and rotten and again renewed - they shall arise like as unto He desires,
10.4: and again at the time the rain descends and at the time it sated the Earth - they shall live having arisen like as unto they were created formerly.
10.5: As they who are everliving in bloody soul and who live in this world and they whom Water produces have been created - Him having said - Make them be created - and as YAH'S authority lodges upon the Water - she gives them a bloody soul by His authority and by His Word.
10.6: As they are created by His authority and by His Word without a father nor mother - thou blind of reasoning who says "Persons who died will not arise" - if thou have knowledge or Wisdom - how will thou say persons who died will not arise by their creator YAH'S Word?
10.7: As persons who died - who were ashes and dust in graves - shall arise by YAH'S Word - as for thou - enter repentance and return toward thy faith.
10.8: Like unto His Word spoken formerly - they shall arise by the Pardoning Dew brought from YAH - and that Word shall change all the world and arouse the persons who died like as unto He desired,
10.9: and know that thou will arise and stand before Him - and make it not seem to thee in thy dullness of heart that thou will remain in the grave.
10.10: It is not thus - thou will arise and receive thy hardship like as unto the correct measure that thou worked - whether it be goodly or evil - yet make it not seem to thee that thou will remain - for this Day is the day when they will receive hardship,
10.11: and in the Resurrection time thou will receive thy hardship by all thy sin that thou worked - thou will accomplish thy sin hardship that was written beginning from thy youth up until that time - and thou have no reason that thou will pretext upon thy sin like unto this world's Work that thou might deny thy sin.
10.12: Like as unto thou made thy false word truth before thee - and like as unto thou made the lies that thou spoke truth - thou have no reason that thou will pretext like as unto this world's Work,
10.13: because it was that she knows upon thee all thy evil Work thou worked - and because it was that she will reveal upon thee before her creator YAH - as YAH'S Word shall lodge upon thee and speak upon thee - thou have no reason upon what thou pretext.
10.14: Thou will be shamed there because of the sin that thou worked - it is that thou might be thanked with persons who are thanked over their beautiful Work - yet lest thou be shamed before man and Angel upon the day when judgment is judged - quickly enter repentance in this world before thou arrive toward there.
10.15: Persons who praise YAH with Angels shall receive their reward from their creator without shame - and they shall be Irie in the Kingdom of Heaven - however unless thou work goodly Work when thou are in thy flesh in Life - thou have no fortune with righteous ones.
10.16: As thou were not prepared when thou had knowledge and when thou had this world where thou could enter repentance - there shall be a useless regret upon thee - for thou did not give a morsel to the hungry when thou had money,
10.17: and for thou did not clothe the naked when thou had clothes - and for thou did not save the wronged when thou had authority,
10.18: for thou did not instruct the sinner when thou had knowledge - that he might return and enter repentance - and that YAH might forgive him his sin that he formerly worked in ignorance - and for thou did not fight with demons who quarreled with thee when thou had Power that thou were able to prevail,
10.19: and for thou did not fast nor pray when thou had strength that thou might weaken the Power of weakness that was upon thy flesh - and that thou might subject thyself to Rightness and not favoring the flesh,
10.20: that is not favoring Irie Ites when it is in this world in beautiful drink and sweet food - and that is not adorning in thin clothes and silver and gold,
10.21: and as thou did not fast nor pray when thou had strength that thou might subject thyself to Rightness that is not adorning in honoured jewels of India called emerald and phazyon - there shall be a useless regret upon thee - this is not a person's ornament that is right.
10.22: As for a person's ornament - it is purity - Wisdom - knowledge - loving one another by what is right without envying nor jealousy nor doubting nor quarrels - while thou loved thy companion like unto thyself,
10.23: and without thy doing an evil thing upon a person who did an evil thing upon thee - it is loving one another by what is appropriate - that thou might enter toward the Kingdom of Heaven that is given to persons who endure the tribulation - that He might give thee the honoured Kingdom of Heaven and thy reward upon making hope in the Kingdom of Heaven in the Resurrection time with honoured persons in knowledge and Wisdom,
10.24: and do not say "After we die we will not arise" - for devils cut off hope of persons who speak and think this - lest they be saved in the Resurrection time - they will know that they have hardship upon them at the time the Advent arrives upon them - in the Resurrection time persons will be totally sad who worked sin in not knowing that He might atone their sin over them - for they did not believe in Him that they will arise upon that Day,
10.25: because of this thing they shall be reproached like unto the measure of their evil Work that they worked in this world - and they shall see the Resurrection that they denied whereby they will arise together in flesh.
10.26: They shall weep at that time because they did not work goodly Work - it would have been better for them if they wept in this world - lest they be who weep in Gehenna.
10.27: If I do not weep in this world by my accord - demons will make me weep without my accord in Gehenna - if I do not enter repentance in this world - I prepare worthless and useless cries and mourning in Gehenna.
10.28: Prepare goodly Work - that you might cross from death toward Life - and that you might go from this passing world toward the Kingdom of Heaven - and that you might behold the Kingdom of Heaven's Light that surpasses any light in this world.
10.29: Refuse Irie Ites that are in this world - that thou might be Irie without measure in the Kingdom of Heaven in Irie Ites that are not perfected beginning from today up until eternity with persons who believe persons who died will arise. Give Glory and praise due to YAH forever - and the third book that speaks the words of Meqabyan are fulfilled.
